jobs.title: Product Cost Specialist - Operations, Lund
jobs.description:
If you would like to become a part of a great team with highly skilled and motivated professionals, working in an innovative and developing environment, continue reading! We are growing and are now looking for a Product Cost Specialist to join our team within Manufacturing Capacity and Cost.

Who is your future team?
Axis Manufacturing Capacity and Cost team is a great contributor to our company's success by developing our base of manufacturing partners and specifically secure cost competitiveness and constant improvements to our purchase costs. Your responsibility will be to ensure the right cost on Axis products through finding opportunities and driving cost reductions from our contract manufacturers, in close collaboration with your colleagues.

Who are we looking for/Who are you?
We believe you are analytical and have a great eye for details, at the same time you easily see the bigger picture from a holistic perspective. You are ambitious, self-driven and very result oriented. You thrive in collaboration with others and see the benefit of working towards common goals. You are open and your communication skills help you in reaching your goals. We see that you are curious and persistent in the work to make sure that the area of responsibility is delivered. Discussions and negotiations with internal as well as external partners are something that you enjoy, as part of your collaboration skills.

This position is very important as you will have great opportunity to affect a significant part of Axis total cost and by this, have the opportunity to affect and make a big difference to our business and continued success.

What you'll do here as Product Cost Specialist

    Be responsible for negotiating and approving product cost quotations from Axis contract manufacturers throughout the product life-cycle.
    Be responsible for identifying and driving cost reduction activities towards our contract manufacturers by analyzing quotation data and having good understanding of all relevant cost drivers.
    Work in close cooperation with our contract manufacturers to achieve timely implementation of Axis negotiated component prices in product quotations.
    Analyze and maintain product and component database from internal and external sources and create a benchmark to be used in price reduction activities with contract manufacturers.
    Support RFQ process for new products and provide input to our product development organization regarding product cost structure and different cost drivers.
    Follow-up and optimize different parameters affecting purchase cost of components at our contract manufacturers, such as order quantities, demand changes and delivery terms.
    Contribute and give input to process- and IT- tools improvements within area of responsibility, independently or in collaboration with other relevant functions.
    The position will mean some travels abroad.

You have:

    A degree in Industrial Economy or Business Administration.
    Minimum 5 years of supply chain/sourcing experience from international manufacturing companies.
    Proven record of at least 2 years of business negotiations.
    Experience from analyzing big amounts of data.
    Excellent MS Office skills.
    Excellent skills in English, both orally and in writing.

It's good if you have experience from working in ERP systems and if you have knowledge about business culture in different parts of the world, it will benefit you greatly in your future role.

What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle.

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:
Axis Career Hub
Life at Axis blog  
Engineering at Axis blog
Innovation at Axis

Ready to Act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!

In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Johan Ahlberg, Manager Manufacturing Capacity & Cost at +46 46 272 1800

jobs.title: Postdoc in Veterinary Microbiology
jobs.description:
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated veterinary microbiologist for a 2-year part-time postdoc position starting around 1st January 2027. The new postdoc is expected to contribute to the scientific and teaching activities of the research group One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) within the section of Veterinary Clinical Microbiology. Additionally, the postdoc will be responsible for defined scientific and management activities within the project SOA36 - Designing best veterinary practices to reduce antimicrobial and antiparasitic use (BEST-VET), funded by the European Partnership on Animal Health and Welfare (EUPAHW). These responsibilities include supporting the project Chair in the day-to-day coordination and management of the consortium, as well as planning and conducting research aimed at reducing antimicrobial use in pigs through improved diagnostic and treatment protocols for key endemic bacterial diseases, and active involvement in the development of clinical guidelines for prudent antimicrobial use in pig medicine, with a particular focus on developing evidence-based guidelines using the GRADE approach. Through these activities, the postdoc will contribute to strengthening antimicrobial stewardship and promoting evidence-based best practices in veterinary medicine.

Information on the department and the section can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk/.

Our research
The postdoc will be part of the OHAR research group led by Prof. Luca Guardabassi. Our research is characterized by two focus areas:

  • Development of diagnostic tests and methods to reduce and rationalize antimicrobial use in animals.
  • Optimization of veterinary antimicrobial use to minimize selection and spread of antimicrobial resistance.
For more information, please check the OHAR homepage One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) – University of Copenhagen

Your job
You are a highly qualified veterinary microbiologist with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. You will be required to be physically present in the laboratory to contribute to ongoing research projects and oversee experiments conducted by PhD, MSc, and BSc students. As part of the EU project BEST-VET, you will contribute to selected work packages and expert groups, including WP1 (Reduction of drug use in pigs), WP7 (Environmental impact of antimicrobial/antiparasitic drugs and phage therapy), Expert Group 1 (Phages and their environmental impact), Expert Group 3 (Standardization of sampling, metagenomics & analytical methods) and Expert Group 5 (Clinical guidance). You will be responsible for coordinating and following up on SOA36 activities related to these work packages and expert groups. You will also act as a key point of contact between the project management, work package leaders and expert groups. Your project management responsibilities will further include supporting the organisation of Management Board meetings, following up on project activities and deadlines, and maintaining the SOA36 SharePoint and associated project documentation. As part of the position, you will undertake a one-year training programme in evidence-based guideline development using the GRADE approach and subsequently contribute to the development of evidence-based clinical guidelines for veterinary medicine.

Profile
We are seeking a highly qualified scientist with a strong track record of independent research in veterinary bacteriology and experience in international collaborative research project coordination, as well as in the supervision and teaching of veterinary and postgraduate students.

Essential experience and skills:

  • A MSc degree in Veterinary Medicine
  • A PhD in Veterinary Microbiology or a closely related field
  • Previous postdoctoral experience
  • Outstanding publication record in relation to career stage
  • Excellent scientific writing and oral communication skills
  • Experience in supervising PhD, MSc, and BSc students
  • Experience in the coordination and management of collaborative research projects
  • Experience with bacterial whole-genome sequencing and genomic data analysis
  • Knowledge of key concepts in antimicrobial stewardship
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Research experience in antimicrobial resistance
  • Experience in metagenomics
  • Experience in routine bacteriological and mycological diagnostics
  • Experience in preparing research proposals and applications for external funding
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories that are fully equipped to perform traditional and molecular microbiology, including omics.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 per week.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

Questions
For further information please contact Luca Guardabassi (lg@sund.ku.dk).

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Please include

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans

  • Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers

Interviews are expected to be held in weeks 44-45 (26th October – 5th November 2026).

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

In this role as a Solutions Architect (SA) for Cohere in the Southern Europe region, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s business across France, Spain, Italy and the wider European region. You will partner with account executives, our partner ecosystem and executive leadership to help the region's leading enterprises and public institutions adopt AI securely and at scale, building on Cohere's success with organisations in defence, financial services, Telecommunications, Energy and the public sector.

SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits:

  • Technical experts in the field

  • Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues

  • Product evangelists of Cohere technology

  • Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI

Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products.

In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers.

You will own the customer's technical narrative end to end, from discovery and architecture to pilot results and business case, and bring structured customer feedback back to our Product and Engineering teams.

A typical day at Cohere might include:

  • Leading the technical talk track on customer calls.

  • Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments.

  • Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology.

  • Working with customer executives to prioritise use cases, define success metrics and build the business case for AI adoption.

  • Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots inside their stack

  • Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere.

  • Collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure our offering matches the customers’ needs.

  • Working closely with our partners to develop a strategy for enabling and accelerating their customers.

This might be for you if you have some of the following:

  • 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles where you both built and advised, such as consulting data scientist, forward deployed engineer or deployment strategist, or solutions architect, taking AI or data solutions from executive problem framing to production.

  • A passion for Agentic AI, and a practical understanding of where LLMs deliver value in production, and where they don't.

  • Solid grounding in ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, retrieval etc.) and the ability to design evaluation frameworks for customer pilots.

  • Excellent communication skills - you can toggle seamlessly between presenting to CEOs, and getting in the weeds with technical audiences.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and can put high-impact structure and processes in place where none exist.

  • Comfortable working with Python and Assistive Coding tools

  • Preferred: Fluency in French, Spanish or Italian

  • Must have: Professional fluency in English (business and technical)

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

Vi søker en serviceinnstilt kundebehandler til et engasjement innen bilutleie. Stillingen passer for deg som trives med direkte kundekontakt, har god struktur og liker en variert arbeidshverdag der ingen dager er like.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Rovaniemelle
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Spécialiste en conseil organisationnel, en amélioration des performances commerciales et en optimisation de l'expérience client grâce à l'informatique et à l'IA, VO2 Finance propose une expertise digitale à la fois technologique, méthodologique et sectorielle – incluant le financement, les marchés de capitaux, les opérations front, middle et back office, les systèmes d'information bancaires et la réglementation.

 

CONTEXTE

Dans le cadre du renforcement des dispositifs de contrôle de notre client bancaire sur le périmètre Front Office / Risques, vous intégrerez l'équipe chargée d'assurer la conformité et la sécurité des opérations sur les marchés financiers.

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous prendrez la responsabilité du périmètre de la surveillance des événements externes à la banque (hors SI) susceptibles d'être qualifiés d'abus de marché (MAR) et devant faire l'objet de déclarations réglementaires. Vous jouerez un rôle référent pour la direction et l'ensemble des parties prenantes.

 

DESCRIPTIF DE LA MISSION

Au quotidien, vous piloterez le sujet en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Risques, Métiers, IT et la Direction autour des axes suivants :

  • Surveillance des événements externes : Identifier, analyser et cadrer l'ensemble des flux et données externes hors SI présentant des suspicions d'abus de marché (MAR).

  • Analyse de flux et réconciliation : Cartographier les schémas de flux de données complexes, concevoir et exécuter les schémas de réconciliation dans une approche stricte orientée Risque.

  • Déclarations réglementaires : Valider les dossiers et formaliser les notifications de suspicion destinées aux régulateurs, en garantissant le respect des contraintes de temporalité.

  • Exploration, Manipulation & Modélisation de données : Traiter et croiser d'importantes volumétries de données (Python, SQL, Excel) pour identifier les anomalies et optimiser les règles de détection.

  • Coordination & Posture : Interagir directement avec les équipes IT pour faire évoluer le dispositif et apporter un rôle de conseil/référent auprès de la direction.

 

Livrables à produire (liste non exhaustive) :

  • Schémas de réconciliation des données et cartographies de flux externes.

  • Fiches d'analyse d'incidents complexes et dossiers de déclaration de suspicion pour le régulateur.

  • Tableaux de bord de suivi des alertes, indicateurs de temporalité et cartographies de risques.

  • Documentation fonctionnelle, préconisations techniques pour l'IT et comptes-rendus d'analyses.


Profil recherché 🔎

  • Formation : Bac+5 (École d'ingénieurs ou Master spécialisé en Finance/Data).

  • Expérience : 8 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Analysis appliquée aux marchés financiers (environnement Front Office et/ou Risques).

  • Expertise métier : Maîtrise approfondie des activités de marché, des mécanismes de réconciliation et de la réglementation sur les abus de marché (MAR).

  • Compétences techniques : Maîtrise avancée de Python, SQL et Excel pour le traitement et la modélisation de données complexes.

  • Soft Skills : Excellente capacité d'analyse, posture affirmée pour rassurer le management, leadership et aisance relationnelle pour challenger les équipes IT et métiers.

  • Langues : Anglais courant (environnement international).

jobs.title: Operational Purchaser
jobs.description:
We are now looking foran enthusiastic Operational Purchaser to join our team in Vaasa, Finland. In accordance with our hybrid work model, you will be able to work partially remotely. This role is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract.



What will you be doing?

In this role, you will be responsible for spare parts purchasing, managing the entire process from requirement to delivery. Your goal will be to ensure the timely and cost-effective delivery of goods, supporting smooth operations and enhancing customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate has experience with purchasing or logistics, preferably in the spare parts business. Technical understanding is beneficial for effectively managing customer requests and supplier communications. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills are essential, as you will work closely with your team in a fast-paced environment to deliver the best possible service experience for our customers.



Your responsibilities for the role include, but are not limited to:

Preparing and executing the purchase order process.


Proactively following up on purchase orders and handling supplier invoices.


Managing supplier claims efficiently.


Developing and improving ways of working in cooperation with operations support and process development.


Fostering teamwork within the team and building commitment.


Collaborating with relevant internal and external stakeholders.


Executing purchase orders, monitoring orders, confirming details, and rescheduling as necessary.


Monitoring and reporting on supplier performance.


Maintaining material and logistics data in relevant systems within the defined area of responsibility.


Coordinating the delivery of goods and logistics information with internal and external stakeholders.


Expediting the delivery of goods to ensure on-time delivery and cost efficiency.


Coaching suppliers and internal stakeholders as needed.


Continuously improving operative logistics activities.




The following will enable you to succeed in this role:

M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Engineering or similar educational background


Few years of experience in purchasing, logistics, or transportation, preferably in the spare parts business


Basic understanding of supply chain management, inventory planning, customs data and product compliance


Technical understanding to effectively manage customer requests and supplier communications, ability to read and understand technical drawings and specifications, understanding of Wärtsilä products and solutions


Proficiency in SAP, MS Office tools, and Supplier Portal


Team-player mindset, enabling seamless collaboration both within the team and across different departments, to achieve common goals


Excellent stakeholder management skills to build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders


Proactive and result-oriented mindset


Strong problem-solving and analytical skills


Flexible approach and ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment


Effective communication and negotiation skills


Fluent English and Finnish language skills, both written and spoken







Contact and next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

For further questions, please reach out to Antti Tuomisto, Team Leader, Material Management, through antti.tuomisto@wartsila.com with any questions related to this position (only for questions from direct job applicants, applications through email will not be recorded or responded to).

jobs.title: Service Instructor
jobs.description:
**Come Work With Us as a Service Instructor in Commercial Cleaning Services in Joensuu**

Are you a cleaning services professional interested in a coordinating role where you can support your team's daily work and help ensure high-quality service delivery? With us, work is carried out responsibly as part of a reliable team.

As a Service Instructor, you will work under the supervision of a manager and play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at customer sites. You will work responsibly and ensure that all tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with agreed quality standards and operating procedures. You will act as a key link between employees, management, and customers, supporting your supervisor in daily operations. However, the position does not include formal supervisory responsibility.

Customer service plays a central role in this position, and success requires a customer-oriented mindset and strong communication skills. In your role, you will directly influence the customer experience and the smoothness of customer relationships, making active collaboration, clear communication, and a solution-focused approach essential.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

- Ensuring the quality of daily cleaning operations, planning work allocation, and using resources in a cost-conscious manner

- Continuously developing operations together with your supervisor and actively contributing improvement ideas

- Guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- Customer cooperation and communication

- Regular participation in practical cleaning work


**We expect you to have:**

- Experience in cleaning work and knowledge of commercial cleaning services

- The ability to guide and support a work community in everyday situations, promote an equal and respectful work atmosphere, and provide clear feedback

- Strong organizational skills and a proactive attitude

- A customer-focused approach and positive mindset

- The ability to work under pressure and solve problems effectively

- Fluent spoken and written Finnish language skills

- A valid work permit if you are not a Finnish citizen

- A valid driver's license and access to a car, as the work area is extensive and the role requires travel between sites

- Previous experience in team guidance or supervisory roles and/or relevant industry education will be considered an advantage


**What we offer:**

- A permanent full-time employment contract, 37.5 hours per week

- Shifts primarily on weekdays in early morning hours starting from 6:00 a.m. Flexibility to work different shifts, including weekends when needed, is appreciated

- A start date to be agreed upon together

- Comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding Path and N-Clean Academy

- Fair employment terms, a safe working environment, and support for employee wellbeing

- Competitive compensation according to the collective agreement for the property services industry: €2,235/month (or €13.88/hour for part-time positions)


**Equality and Responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and with respect, and we do not tolerate discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and are committed to maintaining a safe and healthy work community.

**Did You Know?**

At N-Clean, people enjoy working. Our employee eNPS score is an outstanding **55**. This is reflected in our daily work through mutual respect and a genuine commitment to succeeding together.

N-Clean has achieved success in the HUMAN POWER competition for several years, demonstrating our long-term commitment to developing a people-centered and responsible working life. In 2024, we were selected as Finland's Most Human-Centric Workplace. In 2025, we placed third in the competition and also achieved third place in the Most Human-Centric Working Life Initiative category. This recognition reflects our people-centered recruitment approach, where meeting people, appreciation, and a great candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do.

**Join Our Top Team!**

Applications are accepted only through the application form available on our website.

jobs.title: Primary School Learning Assistant
jobs.description:
Reports to: Primary School Vice Principal

Our vision

To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.

Our mission

Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.

Description/Purpose

To support excellent education for primary school students from early years through grade 5. Working hours 40 hours per week, excluding half an hour lunch break.

Duties/Responsibilities

Classroom Responsibilities (8.30-15.30)

    Provide instructional support for the classroom teacher.
    Encourage student engagement and participation.
    Offer help and individual attention to students who need support.
    Lead small group discussions and/or activities.
    Give feedback to the classroom teacher regarding students' learning.
    Assist in keeping the general class organized.
    Be an active and contributing member of the School Faculty.
    Actively contribute to the operational needs of the school.
    To undertake duties as required, including before-school and end-of-day duties, break duties, lunch support, and additional support in other year groups as required.
    Foster a supportive and inclusive classroom environment.
    Substitute for the class teacher when the teacher is not in school (Remunerated with the initial teacher salary rate for those hours).

After-School Care / After-School Activities Duties (15:30-16:30/17:30 )

    Encourage student engagement and participation.
    Offer help and individual attention to students in need.
    Lead small group discussions and/or activities.
    Assist in keeping the general classroom environment in order.
    Foster a supportive and inclusive classroom environment.

Other Duties

    Greeting students and parents as they arrive at school.
    Monitoring students and ensuring their safety.
    Escorting students into the school in the crosswalk.
    Ensuring corridors are calm and students are in the correct location.

Break/Lunch Duties

    Collecting students from the corridor, as required.
    Monitoring students and ensuring their safety.
    Helping the play leaders with their duties, as required.
    Ensuring students exit the building calmly and quietly.
    Ensuring students return to class promptly.

Traffic Duties

    Monitoring traffic flow and keeping the crossing paths clear of parked vehicles.
    Ensuring students exit the building calmly and aid them in crossing the road safely.
    Greeting students and parents as they leave school.

Qualifications, Attributes, and Experience

    The ability to work with young children.
    Excellent communication skills.
    The ability to establish rapport with adults and students.
    A sense of humour.
    The ability to work effectively in a team.
    A pleasant and friendly personality.
    A sound IT ability.
    The ability to function effectively under pressure.
    The ability to show initiative and work independently.

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer:

As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation.

Contract details:

Type of contract: Fixed-term position covering parental leave

Time allocation: 100%

Start date:  November 16th, 2026

End date: June 11th, 2027

Salary:

Individually negotiated.

Application:

Last day for application: October 19 th, 2026.

We only accept applications in English and from certified candidates.

SIS holds the right to offer the position as soon as a viable candidate is found.

jobs.title: Kohde-esihenkilö
jobs.description:
**Tule meille kohde-esihenkilöksi Joensuuhun**

Haluatko johtaa omaa tiimiäsi ja vastata palvelun sujuvuudesta asiakaskohteessa? Meillä työ tehdään vastuullisesti osana luotettavaa tiimiä. Etsimme energistä ja vastuullista esihenkilöä, joka nauttii ihmisten johtamisesta ja arjen organisoinnista sekä haluaa rakentaa arvostavaa ja toimivaa työyhteisöä.

Tehtävässä vastaat kohteesi päivittäisestä toiminnasta, palveluliiketoiminnan johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä, henkilöstöjohtamisesta sekä asiakasyhteistyöstä kansainvälisessä ja ihmisläheisessä ympäristössä. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät käytännön arjen johtaminen, palvelun sujuva ja laadukas toteuttaminen yhdessä tiimin kanssa, ttoiminnan kehittäminen ja taloudellinen vastuu sekä muutosten vieminen käytäntöön ja työskentely arvojemme mukaisesti.

Tehtävä sopii sinulle, olitpa jo kokenut esihenkilö, puhtausalan **osaaja/nouse tähti/ammattilainen** tai uutta suuntaa urallasi etsivä alanvaihtaja.

**Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa**

- kohteen toiminnan, laadun ja asiakastyytyväisyyden johtaminen

- henkilöstön johtaminen, rekrytointi, perehdyttäminen, työvuorosuunnittelu ja työkyvyn tukeminen

- asiakassuhteiden johtaminen ja kehittäminen, lisämyynnin edistäminen sekä uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistaminen

- kohteen talouden, budjetin ja resurssien seuranta sekä kannattavuuden kehittäminen

- toiminnan tavoitteellinen kehittäminen, riskien tunnistaminen ja turvallisen työympäristön varmistaminen

- raportointi keskeisistä tunnusluvuista ja palvelun sujuvuudesta

- osallistuminen tarvittaessa suorittavaan siivoustyöhön


**Odotamme sinulta**

- soveltuvaa koulutusta ja kokemusta kiinteistö- tai palvelualalta

- kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai tiimin ohjaamisesta

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä motivoida, kehittää ja valmentaa tiimiä sekä johtaa tiimiä oikeudenmukaisesti ja johdonmukaisesti

- asiakaslähtöistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

- kykyä suunnitella ja kehittää toimintaa kustannustehokkaasti sekä johtaa muutoksia arjessa

- valmiutta vastata oman kohteesi toiminnasta ja tuloksesta

- riittäviä digitaalisia taitoja työvälineiden ja järjestelmien käyttöön

- positiivista, vastuullista ja tavoitteellista asennetta sekä liiketoimintalähtöistä ajattelua

- ajokorttia

- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen suullista sekä kirjallista taitoa


**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsuhteen, 37,5 tuntia viikossa

- työsuhde alkaa yhdesä sovittuna ajankohtana, kuitenkin viimeistään 2.11.2026

- työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti arkiaamuisin

- kilpailukykyisen palkan, noin 2500-2800 €/kk kokemuksestasi riippuen

- kattavan perehdytyksen uudistetulla Onboarding-polullamme sekä N-Clean Academyssä ja henkilökohtaisen tuen työn aloitukseen

- mahdollisuuden kehittyä esihenkilötehtävissä ja rakentaa urapolkuasi osana kasvavaa organisaatiota

- turvallisen ja arvostavan työympäristön

Nykypäivän autokauppaa tehdään vahvasti myös verkossa, joten haemme tyyppiä, joka uskaltaa laittaa itsensä likoon, heittäytyä videolle ja hyödyntää sosiaalisen median kanavia myynnin sekä oman asiantuntijabrändinsä rakentamiseen.

jobs.title: Tenure-track position in Archaeology
jobs.description:
About the position 

A tenure-track position (tenure-track in a postdoctoral position and tenured as associate professor) in Archaeology is available at The Department of Archaeology, Conservation and History (IAKH), University of Oslo. IAKH comprises the three disciplinary fields of archaeology conservation and history. The archaeology section has nine academic faculty positions, each with teaching and research components. The section’s research profile and teaching program are internationally oriented and span archaeologies of the Stone Age to the present. The announced position is focused GIS, statistics and Mesolithic archaeology in Scandinavia.

The announced tenure-track position starts as a full-time postdoctoral position (SKO 1352) for a period of six years, including a 25 % component devoted to teaching and administrative duties. These duties include obtaining basic pedagogical qualifications. A formal midterm evaluation will be held in the fourth year of this period, and the candidate will receive feedback on performance relative to the requirements for the six-year tenure-track period. Toward the end of the six-year period, the candidate will be evaluated for a tenured position as associate professor (SKO 1011). During the final assessment, the candidate’s research performance will first be assessed by an expert (adjudication) committee within the candidate’s subject area. Subsequently, the candidate will be interviewed by an internal interview committee assessing the full range of criteria in the contract of employment.


More about the position 

Applicants apply with a research project GIS, statistics and the Mesolithic in Scandinavia to be carried out in the initial six years period. In the application letter, candidates should also describe long term plans for building an international research group, for future development of the teaching in Stone Age Archaeology, for contributing to the public dissemination of research, and for developing their own academic career. 

The contract of employment will specify results, requirements, and criteria regarding academic production, public dissemination, research leadership and teaching that the candidate must fulfil during the six-years period to be favourably evaluated for a tenured position. According to the Regulations on appointments to tenure-track positions, with supplementary provisions for UiO, the contract of employment will also specify the criteria for the midterm and final assessment of competencies and milestones. Candidates will also be evaluated on personal suitability and ability to contribute to academic citizenship, both during the initial hiring process and during the mid-term and final evaluations. The contract of employment will further outline the Department’s obligations in supporting the candidate’s research as well as offering academic mentorship, guidance and training. 

Make sure to follow the description of required results necessary in order to be eligible for the tenured position as associate professor.


Requirements 
  • PhD or equivalent academic qualifications within archaeology of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, with a clear profile in GIS and statistical analysis, granted within the past five years (excluding documented parental and sickness leaves) 
  • Thorough knowledge of the material culture of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia 
  • Demonstrated ability to handle large datasets, geographical information systems and theoretical perspectives on archaeological methodology/practice 
  • Experience in handling of archaeological data using high-end digital tools for quantitative and/or qualitative analysis 
  • Experience with interdisciplinary research approaches within the environmental humanities and/or crossing over to natural sciences 
  • Documented pedagogical skills (either a teaching course certificate or based on teaching experience), see how to document your pedagogical skills 
  • Documented potential for project acquisition • Interest and ability in leadership and administration 
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language 
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the position 

To be eligible, candidates must have submitted for final evaluation or defended their doctoral dissertation within five years preceding the application deadline. In the former case, the appointment will be contingent upon the successful defence of the thesis. Someone who has been employed for more than one year in an ordinary postdoctoral position at the University of Oslo cannot be employed in a postdoctoral position on tenure-track terms.


In the evaluation of the applications, emphasis will be placed on:
  • The research project’s scientific merit and contribution to GIS-based and statistical approaches to the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, including the applicant’s academic and personal ability to carry out the project 
  • The applicant’s long-term plans for building and leading an international research group and successfully join in academic collaboration within and across disciplines, including plans for obtaining external research funding 
  • Academic qualifications and academic production. Originality and quality of publications will be weighted more heavily than quantity 
  • Interest in and motivation for teaching, ability to inspire and provide guidance to students, and potential to teach university-level courses about Stone Age Archaeology and within Archaeology more generally 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration, including collaborative skillsExperience with and potential for popular dissemination and public outreach 
  • Academic citizenship, personal suitability and potential to contribute to a positive working environment and the long-term development of teaching and research at the Department 

In the evaluation of the qualified candidates the full range of these criteria will be explicitly addressed and assessed. Academic quality, development, potential and breadth will be prioritised in this order. 

The appointed candidate should demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages.


We can offer you 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 000 to 677 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


Application

Your application must include: 

  • Application letter describing the applicant’s qualifications and motivation for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (including list of education, previous and current positions, teaching experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activities) 
  • List of publications 
  • Project description (3 - 5 pages, maximum 14,000 characters. See Template for project descriptions) 
  • A realistic progress plan for all six years, including activities beyond the postdoctoral research project itself, such as teaching, professional development and project development 
  • Two writing samples (e.g. two chapters from the PhD dissertation or two academic articles) 
  • Copies of educational certificates 

Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language), either in the original or in translation. 

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system, jobbnorge.no. Applicants with education from non-Norwegian universities must attach an explanation of their grading systems.


Selection procedure

As the first step in the evaluation process, a Selection Committee will assess all applications and invite the most qualified applicants to submit a teaching portfolio and academic works (up to 7 publications) for expert assessment. Academic texts, except for the two writing samples, shall therefore not be enclosed with the initial application. Applicants who are invited to submit academic works are asked to select three works, published within the last 5 years, to be considered as most relevant for the position. In longer publications (monographs), applicants should specify the most relevant pages. Applicants are also asked to submit a teaching portfolio of 3-6 pages documenting educational certificates, competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own practice and learning vision is anchored in the principles of Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL). 

Finally, the most highly ranked candidates will be invited for at least one interview and trial lecture. Ranked candidates will be asked to provide a list of 3 reference persons (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). References are contacted after the interviews.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of archaeology, conservation and history (IAKH) is comprised of three disciplines which in different ways study the past.The department has internationally oriented archaeologists, the only conservation program in Norway and the biggest group of historians in Scandinavia. The department has close to 100 employees, including non-permanent research fellows. The study programs span archaeology from the Stone Age to the Middle Ages, object and paintings conservation, and history from Antiquity to the present age.

Vi søger en stabil og ansvarsbevidst medarbejder til en fast weekendstilling med rengøring og kørsel mellem forskellige erhvervslokationer på Midt- og Vestsjælland.

Stillingen er på 8-8,5 timer hver lørdag og 8-8,5 timer hver søndag, i alt 16-17 timer om ugen.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt kl. 07.00–15.00, men arbejdet kan efter aftale også planlægges til tidligere eller senere på dagen.

Om jobbet

Din arbejdsdag starter og slutter i Dianalund, hvorfra du kører en planlagt rute mellem forskellige erhvervslokationer.

Der køres blandt andet til områder omkring Roskilde, Holbæk, Sorø og Slagelse.

Al kørsel i forbindelse med arbejdet foregår i firmabil, som benyttes på hele ruten fra start i Dianalund og frem til arbejdsdagens afslutning i Dianalund.

Jobbet består cirka af:

  • 65 % kørsel mellem de forskellige lokationer

  • 35 % rengøring på erhvervslokationerne

Rengøringsopgaverne består af almindelig erhvervsrengøring, herunder blandt andet rengøring af toiletter, gulve og fællesarealer samt opfyldning af forbrugsvarer.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har gyldigt kørekort kategori B

  • Er stabil, mødepligtig og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Kan følge en fast rute og arbejdsplan

  • Er grundig og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Er komfortabel med, at en stor del af arbejdsdagen foregår bag rattet

  • Kan arbejde fast både lørdag og søndag

Erfaring med rengøring er en fordel, men ikke et krav, da oplæring vil blive givet.

Vi tilbyder

  • Gode løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

  • En fast weekendstilling på 16-17 timer om ugen

  • Fast arbejde hver lørdag og søndag

  • Firmabil til al kørsel i forbindelse med arbejdet

  • Mulighed for fleksibel placering af arbejdstiden efter aftale

  • En selvstændig arbejdsdag med stor frihed under ansvar

  • Variation mellem kørsel og praktiske rengøringsopgaver

  • En planlagt og overskuelig rute

  • Grundig oplæring ved opstart

  • Et job med faste rammer og mulighed for et længerevarende samarbejde

  • Mulighed for ekstra timer efter behov og aftale

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på stabilitet, kvalitet og godt samarbejde

Arbejdstid: Lørdag og søndag, som udgangspunkt kl. 07.00–15.00
Arbejdsområde: Midt- og Vestsjælland
Start og slut: Dianalund
Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig, så send gerne en kort ansøgning med lidt information om dig selv, din arbejdserfaring og hvornår du kan starte.

English

Permanent Weekend Job Saturday and Sunday – Driving and Cleaning – Dianalund / Central and West Zealand

We are looking for a reliable and responsible employee for a permanent weekend position involving cleaning and driving between various commercial locations across Central and West Zealand.

The position is 8-8.5 hours every Saturday and 8-8.5 hours every Sunday, for a total of 16-17 hours per week.

Working hours are generally 07:00–15:00, but the schedule can also be arranged to start earlier or later in the day by agreement.

About the job

Your working day will start and finish in Dianalund, from where you will drive a planned route between different commercial locations.

The route includes areas such as Roskilde, Holbæk, Sorø and Slagelse.

All driving related to the job is carried out in a company vehicle, which is used throughout the entire route from the start of the working day in Dianalund until the route is completed back in Dianalund.

The job consists approximately of:

  • 65% driving between the different locations

  • 35% cleaning at the commercial sites

The cleaning tasks include general commercial cleaning, such as cleaning toilets, floors and common areas, as well as refilling consumable supplies.

We expect that you

  • Have a valid Category B driving licence

  • Are reliable, punctual and responsible

  • Are able to work independently

  • Can follow a planned route and work schedule

  • Take pride in delivering good-quality work

  • Are comfortable spending a large part of the working day driving

  • Are available to work regularly on both Saturdays and Sundays

Previous cleaning experience is an advantage, but not a requirement, as training will be provided.

We offer

  • Good salary and employment conditions

  • A permanent weekend position of 16-17 hours per week

  • Regular work every Saturday and Sunday

  • A company vehicle for all driving related to the job

  • Flexibility in scheduling working hours by agreement

  • A high degree of independence and responsibility

  • A varied working day combining driving and practical cleaning tasks

  • A planned and manageable route

  • Thorough training when you start

  • Stable working conditions with the possibility of long-term employment

  • Possibility of additional hours when available and agreed

  • An informal working environment focused on reliability, quality and good cooperation

Working hours: Saturday and Sunday, generally 07:00–15:00
Working area: Central and West Zealand
Start and finish location: Dianalund
Starting date: By agreement

If this position sounds like a good fit for you, please send us a short application with some information about yourself, your work experience and when you would be available to start.

jobs.title: Keikkalaiseksi Teeritien palvelukotiin Lieksaan (lähihoitaja, sosionomi, sairaanhoitaja)
jobs.description:
Etsitkö joustavaa ja elämääsi sopivaa tapaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä? Me Honkalampi-säätiössä haemme nyt keikkalaisia **ohjaajan tehtäviin**Polvijärvelle, Kurjenpolven palvelukotiin. Taustaltasi voit olla esimerkiksi lääkeluvallinen **lähihoitaja, sosionomi tai sairaanhoitaja.**

Teeritien palvelukoti tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista 18 aikuiselle tukea tarvitsevalle henkilölle, joiden tuen tarpeen taustalla on esimerkiksi kehitysvamma. Meillä jokaisen arki rakentuu osallisuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja oikeudesta elää oman näköistä elämää. Huolehdimme turvallisesta ympäristöstä, jossa vuorovaikutus ja monipuoliset kommunikaation keinot ovat keskiössä. Haluamme, että kotimme on paikka, jossa jokainen tulee kuulluksi, ymmärretyksi ja kohdatuksi omana itsenään. Meillä koti on koti.

**Millaista työ on?**

Ohjaajana tuet ja mahdollistat asukkaidemme arkea heidän omien toiveidensa, tarpeidensa ja tavoitteidensa mukaisesti. Työhösi kuuluu hoitotyötä ja hyvinvoinnin tukemista sekä asukkaiden avustamista arjen askareissa, kuten kodinhoidossa, kaupassa käynnissä ja ulkoilussa.

Lisäksi suunnittelet ja toteutat yhdessä asukkaiden kanssa heidän toiveistaan lähtevää yhteistä toimintaa, joka voi olla esimerkiksi liikkumista, leivontaa, pelaamista, retkiä, digitaitojen harjoittelua tai ihan vain yhdessä olemista ja jutustelua.

Keikkalaisena toimit ohjaajan sijaisuuksissa tarpeen mukaan. Keikat voivat olla äkillisiä ja lyhyitä poissaolojen tuurauksia, mutta tarjoamme myös pidempiä sijaisuuksia ensisijaisesti keikkalaisillemme. Voit itse päättää, mitkä keikkapyynnöt hyväksyt.

**Millaista työkaveria etsimme?**

Etsimme kehitysvamma-alasta kiinnostuneita, ihmisläheisiä ja vastuullisia keikkalaisia. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja työyhteisötaitoja sekä valmiutta ottaa vastaan sijaisuuksia myös lyhyellä varoitusajalla. Odotamme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa sote-alan koulutusta (esim. lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, sosionomi) tai vähintään 2/3 alan opinnoista suoritettuna

- lääkehoidon koulutusta ja voimassa olevia lääketenttien suorituksia

- voimassa olevaa sote-ammattikorttia

- tartuntatautilain 48 § mukaista rokotesuojaa

- hygieniapassia ja elintarviketyötä tekevän terveydentilaselvitystä.


Valitun työntekijän tulee esittää voimassa oleva rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkua.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- joustavan, elämääsi sopivan tavan tehdä töitä keikkalaisena

- Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisen tuntipalkan (kelpoisuusehdot täyttävän ohjaajan palkkaluokka G20C)

- huolellisen perehdytyksen keikkalaisen tehtäviin

- kokeneen ja helposti lähestyttävän esihenkilön ja työyhteisön tuen.


Pääset osaksi ainutlaatuisten asukkaidemme arkea, saat arvokasta kokemusta kehitysvamma-alalta ja ympärillesi ammattitaitoiset työkaverit - meillä et jää yksin.

**Näin haet meille töihin**

Täytä hakemuslomake nettisivuillamme:https://www.honkalampi.fi/avoin-hakemus/

Lisätietoja tehtävistä voit kysyä osoitteesta rekrytointi@hl-s.fi .

Voit tutustua asumispalveluiden arkeen Facebookissa: @Honkalampi Asumispalvelut tai Instagramissa: @honkalampiasumispalvelut .

_Honkalampi on yhteiskuntavastuullinen yritys, jonka tavoitteena on pykälää parempi maailma. Käytämme taloudelliset voittovaramme asiakkaidemme palveluiden kehittämiseen ja yhteiskunnallisten haasteiden ratkaisemiseen. Tutustu meihin lisää osoitteessa www.honkalampi.fi ._

_Honkalammen asumispalvelut on savuton työpaikka._

jobs.description:

Production Manager (Manufacturing) Employer: Durnin’s Fruit and Veg T/A Ninrud Limited Location: Batestown, Drumconrath, Navan, Co. Meath, Eircode: C15 Y2TA Contract: Full-time, Permanent Hours: 39 hours per week Salary: €36,605 per annum Vacancies: 1 We are seeking an experienced Production Manager to lead the manufacturing and processing operations in our busy fruit and vegetable production facility. Key Responsibilities: • Manage the daily running of the production line, including potato processing, fresh vegetable preparation, packing and prepared produce operations • Plan production schedules, oversee manufacturing processes and maintain high standards of product quality and presentation • Ensure full compliance with food safety and hygiene regulations (HACCP and BRCGS standards) • Control stock, costs, waste and overall profitability of the production operation • Lead, train and motivate the production team • Deliver efficient, high-quality output to support our retail, catering and wholesale customers Person Specification: • Previous experience in a Production Manager or Manufacturing Manager role (ideally within food processing or fresh produce) • Strong knowledge of food safety standards (Level 2/3 Food Hygiene essential; experience with HACCP/BRCGS preferred) • Good leadership and team management skills • Commercial awareness and the ability to drive efficiency and productivity • Flexible with availability, including weekends If you are passionate about fresh produce manufacturing and delivering quality from field to fork, we’d love to hear from you. To apply: Please send your CV to James@durninsfruitandveg.ie

jobs.title: Norwegian or Swedish speaking insurance sales agent (Norwegian market)
jobs.description:
Do you like to challenge and are you fluent in Norwegian and/or Swedish and have a profound understanding for the Norwegian market?
- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Norwegian sales department at Nordiccom!

Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen and we are still growing. Our Norwegian team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on our sales team, who’s responsible for selling insurance solutions to existing customers in the financial sector. All sales are made over the phone.

We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.

It is not a requirement for you to have experience with insurances prior to applying for this job, but we would prefer it if you have experience with selling over the phone. It is important to us that our employees deliver the highest quality of service, which is why we provide thorough training, ensuring that you are ready to meet any challenges and deliver good results while feeling comfortable in your new role.


Qualities we highly value from you:

- An energetic personality with a “can do”-attitude, who knows how to smile through the phone

- Confidence and the ability to work as part of a team

- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people

- A competitive and result-oriented mindset

- Fluent in Norwegian (English language skills are also an advantage)

- Huge plus if you have experience working with tele sales/telemarketing from a previous job
 

What you can expect from us:

- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes

- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment

- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction

- Helpful and motivated colleagues

- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city.

- Office located in the heart of Copenhagen

 

Who are we and what do we do?
Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Norwegians, Finns and Swedes. Nordiccom consists of about 150 employees divided into different teams. In Nordiccom, we emphasize professionalism, and it is important that we thrive when we are at work. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

If this sounds interesting to you, please don't hesitate to send your resumé and an application marked "Norwegian sales agent".

jobs.title: Syddansk Erhvervsakademi søger en international koordinator
jobs.description:
SEA har fået mulighed for at øge optaget af internationale studerende i de kommende år og søger derfor en International Koordinator, der kan være med til at løfte denne opgave.

Om jobbet

Som International Koordinator får du en central rolle i arbejdet med at rekruttere og fastholde internationale studerende, og du skal sammen med det internationale team arbejde på at gøre hele SEA mere internationalt orienteret over de kommende år.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

· Rekruttering og optag af internationale studerende

· Kontakt med internationale samarbejdspartnere

· Sikre at de internationale studerende får et godt studieliv på SEA

· Koordinering af internationale aktiviteter

· Hjælpe internationale studerende ind på det danske arbejdsmarked

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

· har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund

· arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

· trives i samarbejde med andre

· kommunikerer klart og professionelt, både mundtligt og skriftligt på dansk og engelsk

Vi tilbyder

Hos SEA bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads i udvikling, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og engagement går hånd i hånd. Vi tilbyder:

· et spændende og meningsfuldt job med stor kontaktflade i ind og udland

· et uformelt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger

· en organisation i bevægelse med plads til idéer, initiativ og udvikling

· frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge egne opgaver

· en arbejdsplads, hvor vi lykkes gennem samarbejde og medansvar

Ansættelsesvilkår

Du bliver ansat efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og den relevante faglige organisation. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende regler, herunder principperne om Ny løn.

Ansættelse er betinget af, at der foreligger tilfredsstillende straffeattest ved ansættelsen.

Tiltrædelse

Tiltrædelse er efter aftale.

Arbejdssted

Dit primære arbejdssted er SEA i Esbjerg.

Yderligere oplysninger

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Vicerektor, Søren Haahr Jensen på 41775701

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag via job@s-e-a.dk senest 12. oktober 2026.

 

Har du spørgsmål? Kontakt Søren Haahr Jensen:

Send en email
Ring på +45 41 77 57 01

Mangfoldighed

Alle interesserede, uanset alder, køn, race, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold, der har de fornødne kvalifikationer, opfordres til at søge. Ansættelse er betinget af, at der foreligger tilfredsstillende straffeattest ved indgåelse af ansættelse.

jobs.title: Forklift Driver (trukkikuski) to Föglö, Åland Islands for the Fish Industry, Permanent Position ,
jobs.description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for a forklift driver for a permanent position in the natural paradise of Föglö, Åland Islands (a temporary position is possible if desired).

The job involves operating a forklift in various stages of production and storage, such as moving products, loading and unloading cargo, and ensuring the smooth flow of materials in the production area. The forklift in use is a counterbalanced electric forklift (brand: Linde). The work requires good precision, initiative, and the ability to operate safely in a busy environment. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. You will also drive the forklift on a slightly sloped yard. If necessary, you can also participate in other production-supporting tasks. At Kalaneuvos, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
We are looking for a communicative person who is capable of working independently and is not afraid to take initiative. Previous experience in operating a forklift is a requirement for this job. You will receive comprehensive training on the specific forklift model and the work environment. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: full-time: 37.5h/week
- Salary: approx. 13-14.50 EUR/h, depending on experience
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt
- Start date: flexible according to agreement
- The role has possibility to advance into bigger role

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has K-extra, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two- or three-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Kalaneuvos:
Kalaneuvos is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Haemme nyt trukkikuskia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen luonnonhelmaan Ahvenanmaan Föglön saareen (halutessasi määräaikaisuus on mahdollinen).

Työtehtäviin kuuluu trukin käyttö tuotannon ja varaston eri työvaiheissa, kuten tuotteiden siirtäminen, kuormien lastaus ja purku, sekä materiaalivirran sujuvuuden varmistaminen tuotantoalueella. Käytössä oleva trukki on vastapainoinen sähkötrukki (merkki: Linde). Työ vaatii hyvää tarkkuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä toimia turvallisesti kiireisessä ympäristössä. Työskentelytilat ovat viileät, noin +2 – +6°C, joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Ajat trukkia myös hieman kaltevalla pihalla. Tarpeen mukaan voit osallistua myös muihin tuotantoa tukeviin työtehtäviin. Kalaneuvoksella pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todellakin yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa "työperhettä".

Kenelle työ sopii?
Etsimme kommunikaatiotaitoista ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää henkilöä, joka ei pelkää tarttua toimeen. Aiempi kokemus trukin käytöstä on vaatimuksena tälle työlle. Saat toki kattavan perehdytyksen kyseiseen trukkimalliin sekä työympäristöön. Työ sopii luonnon läheiselle henkilölle, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella, saaristomaisemissa. Puhuthan englantia, jotta kommunikaatio työporukassa sujuu ongelmitta.

- Työtunnit: täydet tunnit: 37,5h/vko
- Palkkaus: n. 13-14,50eur/h, kokemuksen mukaan

Tietoa työskentelypaikkakunnasta ja käytännön järjestelyissä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupungin palveluita: saarella on K-extra, kirjasto ja kuntosali, ja muutoin kaupungin palvelut löytyvät esim. Maarianhaminasta, 35min lauttamatkan ja 30min ajomatkan päästä. Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka on lähellä majoitusta ja Maarianhaminaan pääsee bussilla. Kalaneuvos on Suomen kalateollisuuden suurin toimija ja alan edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, kalatukkukaupassa, kalan tuonnissa ja viennissä sekä kalankasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuoden ajan panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin sekä henkilöstön hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändin alta löytyy laaja valikoima herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja/sairaanhoitaja
jobs.description:
Etsimme ammattitaitoista, luotettavaa ja asiakaslähtöistä lähihoitajaa tai sairaanhoitajaa tuntityöhön. Työvuoroja tarjotaan asiakastarpeen mukaan.

Työ sisältää monipuolisia hoito- ja asiakastyön tehtäviä asiakkaiden yksilöllisten tarpeiden mukaisesti, kuten hoitoa, ohjausta ja tukemista sekä hyvinvoinnin ja toimintakyvyn edistämistä. Tehtäviin kuuluu myös asiakaskirjausten tekeminen, raportointi ja yhteydenpito asiakkaan, toimiston sekä mahdollisen hoitotiimin kanssa.

Asiakastarpeen mukaan työhön voi sisältyä myös laskimoverinäytteiden ottamista. Toivomme hakijalta näytteenottoon soveltuvaa koulutusta ja käytännön osaamista laskimoverinäytteiden ottamisesta.

Tehtävään soveltuvaa lähihoitajan tai sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa, erinomaista suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa sekä vastuullista ja itsenäistä työotetta. Työ tapahtuu asiakkaiden luona, joten oman auton käyttö työtehtävissä on välttämätöntä.

**Työaika ja palkkaus**

Työ sijoittuu pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin klo 8.00–18.00 väliselle ajalle. Työvuoroja voi tarvittaessa olla myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin. Työ on osa-aikaista tuntityötä, ja työvuoroja tarjotaan tarpeen mukaan. Työsuhteessa noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa. Palkkaus määräytyy yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.

Työtehtäviin voi sisältyä työskentelyä lasten, iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa. Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää työtehtävien edellyttämät rikosrekisteriotteet.

jobs.title: Metsäkoneasentaja
jobs.description:

Etsimme osaavaa ja motivoitunutta metsäkone- tai raskaskoneasentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Haemme tiimiimme uutta ammattilaista keväällä vapautuneeseen tehtävään. Työssä vastaat metsä- ja raskaan kaluston huolto-, korjaus- ja vianhakutöistä. Työtä tehdään sekä korjaamolla että tarvittaessa kenttä- ja maasto-olosuhteissa. Tehtävä tarjoaa monipuolisia teknisiä haasteita sekä mahdollisuuden itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen työskentelyyn.

Odotamme sinulta:

\- Auto-, raskaskalusto- tai koneasentajan koulutusta tai vastaavaa käytännön kokemusta

\- Kokemusta metsäkoneista, raskaasta kalustosta tai niiden käytöstä

\- Kykyä lukea ja tulkita sähkö- ja hydrauliikkakaavioita

Lisäksi arvostamme metsäkoneenkuljettajan taustaa, suoritettua varusmiespalvelusta sekä halua oppia ja kehittää omaa osaamista.

Tarjoamme:
