jobs.title: Elektriker
jobs.description:
Vil du være med og sikre at noen av regionens viktigste bygg fungerer hver eneste dag?

Stavanger kommune forvalter distriktets største og mest varierte eiendomsportefølje – fra skoler, barnehager og helsebygg til kulturbygg, bydelshus og historiske eiendommer i gamle Stavanger. Hos oss får du jobbe med en av landets mest spennende bygningsporteføljer, i et fagmiljø som stadig vokser i takt med økende tekniske krav.

Seksjon Byggdrift, som ligger under Bymiljø og utbygging (avdeling Eiendom), består av enhetene Renhold, Drift, Fag og Bolig. Seksjonen har ansvar for daglig drift og vedlikehold av kommunens bygg og boliger, og jobber tett opp mot brukere, tjenester og kommunens øvrige fagmiljøer.

Nå styrker vi laget og søker deg som har teknisk kompetanse, serviceinnstilling og et ønske om å bidra til trygge og godt fungerende bygg for innbyggere og ansatte.

Hos oss vil du få muligheten til å:

  • Arbeide i et fagmiljø med sterk kompetanse og høy aktivitet
  • Bidra til kvalitet, framdrift og godt samarbeid på tvers av fag
  • Sikre at oppdrag blir utført med riktig kvalitet, koordinering og dokumentasjon
  • Følge opp tekniske installasjoner, drift, avvik og servicearbeid
  • Sørge for at lover, forskrifter og interne standarder blir etterlevd
  • Skape gode opplevelser for brukere, ansatte, samarbeidspartnere og oppdragsgivere

Vi ser etter deg som ønsker å jobbe i et profesjonelt miljø med stort ansvar og tydelig samfunnsnytte. Her er det rom for utvikling, spesialisering og å være med på å forme framtidens kommunale byggdrift.  


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Kvalitetssikre avvik og utbedre feil/ mangler
  • Utførelse av arbeidsoppgaver for Fagenheten
  • Reparasjon og test i verkstedavdeling
  • Være en god kollega, være åpen, inkluderende og aktivt ivareta arbeidsmiljø 
  • Utvikling av fagområder
  • Ansvar for at oppgaver gjennomføres/ dokumenteres iht. gjeldene lover og forskrifter
  • Være en rollemodell
  • Aktivt delta i utvikling og forbedring
  • Utstrakt samarbeid med fagleder, faggruppene og virksomhetene
  • Rapportere til Gruppeleder
  • Dele kompetanse og læring  
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagarbeider skal ha fagbrev som elektriker Gr.L
  • Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE

Arbeidsspråket i Stavanger kommune er norsk. Dersom du har et annet morsmål enn norsk, må du dokumentere at du har språkferdigheter tilsvarende B1. Gjelder ikke søkere med et skandinavisk språk som morsmål. 

Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er nær og inkluderende, tar vare på dine kolleger, samarbeidspartnere og innbyggernes behov
  • Du er åpen for andres kunnskap, ønsker å lære og deler av din kunnskap
  • Du er nyskapende og utviklingsorientert, utforsker nye muligheter og løsninger, tør å prøve og feile, evner å forandre for å forbedre
  • Du er profesjonell og har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • Du er selvstendig og strukturert, løsningsorientert og tenker helhetlig på tvers av sektorer og fag
  • Du har gjennomføringskraft og evner å prioritere
  • Du har god IT-kompetanse og systemforståelse
  • Du har fokus på kvalitet, bærekraftige løsninger og gode økonomiske resultater 
Vi tilbyr
  • Varierte og meningsfulle prosjekter i en av regionens mest spennende og komplekse eiendomsporteføljer
  • Et sterkt og støttende fagmiljø der vi løfter hverandre, deler kompetanse og spiller hverandre gode
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet kombinert med ansvarsfulle og utviklende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med kolleger som har solid erfaring, høy faglighet og et ekte engasjement for bygg og tekniske tjenester
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP
  • Arbeidstid etter avtale
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, både faglig og personlig – vi tilrettelegger for at du lykkes og når dine karrieremål
  • Lønn etter: Stillingskode: 751714
  • Ansettelser foretas fortløpende

Vi ber om at godkjente vitnemål/karakterutskrifter og attester lastes opp som vedlegg til den elektroniske søknaden. Dersom du ønsker å reservere deg fra oppføring på offentlig søkerliste, må dette begrunnes i søknadsskjema. Opplysningene kan bli offentliggjort selv om du har bedt om å ikke bli oppført på søkerlisten, men du vil bli varslet før søknadsfristens utløp, dersom ønsket om reservasjon ikke tas til følge.

jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper til automatisering og forretningsudvikling
jobs.description:
Bliv driftschefens højre hånd hos Holstebro Vægtservice.

Vi har vejet Danmark siden 1977, alt fra fisk til fyldte lastbiler. Nu bygger vi virksomheden op på ny: mere digital, mere struktureret og klar til vækst. 

Til det søger vi en studerende, der vil arbejde tæt sammen med driftschefen om at udvikle forretningen. Vejen fra idé til handling er kort, og ansvaret er større, end studenterjobs normalt byder på. Du er også velkommen til at bruge HOVA som case i dit semesterprojekt, bachelor eller speciale.

Det praktiske

8 til 15 timer om ugen, tilpasset dit semester. Timeløn efter kvalifikationer.

Forventet start hurtigst muligt. Typisk 1 til 2 faste dage i Holstebro, resten aftaler vi, når du kender dit skema. Vi ligger cirka 30 minutter fra Herning ad motorvejen.

Din første opgave

Når du er sat ind i virksomheden, bliver din første opgave at undersøge, hvordan vi kan effektivisere og måske automatisere processen omkring salg af labels til kunder. Herfra er du med til selv at pege på, hvilke processer vi lettest kan effektivisere og få mest værdi ud af.

Opgaverne

  • Udvikle webshop og hjemmeside: oprette produkter, forbedre indhold og skabe mersalg

  • Producere SoMe-indhold, der viser, hvad vi laver

  • Drive igangsatte initiativer helt i mål

  • Undersøge og præsentere processer og struktur, så forretningen kan skalere

  • Teste og bygge automatiseringer med AI, Make eller N8N, og finde ud af, hvad der faktisk virker


I starten fokuserer vi mest på de tre første, men løbende udvikles dit ansvarsområde, som du starter og udvikler dig.

Du kommer også med teknikerne ud til kunderne for at se hvad vi laver og giver en hånd på værkstedet, når fx. ordrer skal pakkes. 

Hvem er du?

  • Du læser fx BDE eller ITKO i Herning, eller noget der ligner

  • Du er nysgerrig og arbejdsom, og du får ting færdige, ikke kun startet

  • Du tør træffe beslutninger og stå på mål for dem

  • Du behøver ikke kunne kode, men AI skal vække din nysgerrighed. Kender du Make eller N8N, er det et plus

  • Du behøver ikke vide noget om vægte. Det kommer.

Det får du

  • Reelt ansvar: egne projekter og direkte samarbejde med driftschefen. Dine beslutninger kan ses i forretningen, ikke i et slidedeck

  • Fleksible timer: timetallet følger dit semester, og der er plads til at skrue ned op til eksamen

  • HOVA som case: brug os i semesterprojekter, bachelor eller speciale

  • Læring på tværs: strategi, drift, salg, marketing og teknik i samme uge

  • En arbejdsplads, ikke kun en skærm: opgaverne løses primært hos os i Holstebro, men fleksibilitet er en nøgleværdi, og vi finder en model, der passer med dit studie

Hvorfor Holstebro Vægtservice?

Vi er et lille team, og i dag en del af VF Stålindustri. Vores kunder spænder fra

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja
jobs.description:
**Henkilökohtainen avustaja Tampere ja lähikunnat**

Tulisitko sinä töihin Spesiolle **henkilökohtaisen avun**pariin? Olemme hyväksytty palvelusetelituottaja Tampereen alueella henkilökohtaisen avun piirissä. Tehtävään ei ole koulutusvaatimuksia, hyvällä asenteella pärjää pitkälle.

**Spesio – Omanlainen elämä**

Tarkoituksenasi on tukea asiakasta niin, että hän pystyy elämään mahdollisimman itsenäistä arkea ja omanlaista elämää. Tehtävänäsi on avustaa asiakasta sellaisissa tavanomaisissa päivittäistoiminnoissa, joista asiakas ilman vamman tai sairauden tuomaa rajoitetta suoriutuisi itsenäisesti. Näihin saattaa sisältyä muun muassa avustamista pukeutumisessa, henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa, vaate- ja ruokahuollossa, kodinhoidossa tai kodin ulkopuolisissa toiminnoissa, kuten kaupassa käynnissä, ulkoilussa ja harrastuksissa. Käynnit saattavat sisältää asiakkaan siirtoja ja nostoja eli edellytämme hyvää fyysistä peruskuntoa.

Asiakaskäynnin tarkemman sisällön sekä keston määrittelee asiakkaan tarve. Arkipäivien lisäksi käyntejä voi olla myös illalla sekä viikonloppuisin. Asiakassuhteet ovat pääosin pitkäaikaisia, joten tiedämme, kuinka tärkeää on, että avustajan ja asiakkaan kemiat kohtaavat.

**Me teemme työtä aina asiakkaan hyvinvointi edellä ja olemmekin siinä melkoisen hyviä: sisäpiirissä olevat sanoisivat, että pykälää parempia!** **Lupaammekin sinulle:**

- mahdollisuuden tehdä työsi hyvin ja asiakasta kunnioittaen


- työyhteisön, jossa saat rohkeasti olla oma itsesi


- lähiesihenkilön tuen


- monipuolisen työnkuvan


- työehdot yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan


- palkkaluokka on G16A eli palvelusvuosista riippuen 12,79–14,06 €/h (+TES:n mukaiset lisät)


**Sinä:**

Haemme lämminhenkistä ihmistä, kenelle asiakkaan hyvinvointi tulee ykkösenä. Toivomme, että sinulla olisi aikaisempaa kokemusta erilaisten ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä. Tutkintoa tärkeämpää on palvelualttius sekä hyvät kommunikointitaidot. Ajokortti ja oma auto katsotaan eduksi, mutta ne eivät ole välttämättömiä. Tehtävään otettavan henkilön on esitettävä rikosrekisteriote, koska työ sisältää vammaisten ja ikäihmisten kanssa työskentelyä.

Kerrothan jo hakemuksessasi toiveistasi ja mieltymyksistäsi (esim. työajat, asiakasryhmät, sijainti, erityisosaaminen), jotta voimme kohdistaa sinulle mahdollisimman hyvin sopivia asiakkuuksia.

Otamme sinuun yhteyttä, kun profiiliasi ja hakemustasi vastaava asiakkuus löytyy.

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan pykälää parempaa maailmaa**

Spesio on toiminut sosiaali- ja hyvinvointipalvelualalla pitkään, jo yli 20 vuotta. Työntekijöitä meillä on tällä hetkellä yhteensä reilut 700 ja toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Tampereella, Kuopiossa ja Joensuussa. Palvelutarjontaamme kuuluu henkilökohtainen apu, vammaisten kotihoito, vammaisten päivätoiminta, lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu sekä kotiin vietävät palvelut yksityisasiakkaille.

Me haluamme, että kaikilla on mahdollisuus omanlaiseensa elämään, ja uskomme että omalla työllä voimme tehdä maailmasta paremman paikan. Jos uskot samaan ja haluat tulla mukaan, laita meille hakemus. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palveluesihenkilö Suvi Sokka-Lehtinen p. **040 357 1119**

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager - Logistics
jobs.description:
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.



Your opportunity

At Boliden, we believe that great results are created through collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement. Guided by our values of Care, Courage, and Responsibility, we work together to create a sustainable future. As a Sourcing Manager – Logistics, you will contribute to the development of Boliden's transport and logistics network, working closely with colleagues and suppliers across Europe and supporting logistics activities connected to Boliden's operational sites and business locations.

This role combines commercial thinking, relationship building, and analytical skills to create efficient and sustainable logistics solutions. Whether your background is in sourcing, logistics, supply chain, procurement, or a related field, you will have the opportunity to develop your expertise in an international environment and support Boliden's long-term ambitions.

We offer a collaborative environment where your contribution will have a direct impact on future generations. Together, we are working towards our vision of becoming the world's most sustainable and respected metal supplier.



Who you will work with

You will report to the Head of Logistics and be part of a team of seven dedicated logistics professionals within Group Logistics. In this role, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across Boliden’s organization, as well as with external logistics providers and strategic partners.

The position is preferably based in Sweden or Finland at one of our operational sites. Regular travel to Boliden sites will be required, along with occasional visits to other company locations.



What you will do

Boliden manages a large and complex logistics network involving the transportation of products, raw materials, by-products, and project cargo across multiple locations and transport modes.

As a Sourcing Manager – Logistics, you will be responsible for selected transport categories and logistics solutions across the Boliden Group, supporting flows to, from, and between Boliden's operations.

In this role, you will:

    Lead sourcing activities, tenders, and contract negotiations for transport and logistics services.
    Build and maintain strong relationships with logistics providers, suppliers, and strategic partners.
    Monitor transport markets and identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, service, and sustainability.
    Drive initiatives related to safety, sustainability, quality, and continuous improvement across logistics flows.
    Support logistics projects, including network optimization, transport mode selection, and supply chain development.
    Collaborate with stakeholders across the business and follow up supplier performance through KPIs and business reviews.
    Contribute to emissions reduction, responsible sourcing, risk management, and the development of Group Logistics strategies and processes.
    Travel regularly as part of the role, approximately 2-4 days per month.



What you bring

You have experience working with sourcing, procurement, supplier management, logistics, supply chain, or a related business area and are motivated by building relationships and creating business value. We are open to candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience and believe this role can be an excellent opportunity for someone looking to take the next step in their career.

We place great importance on personal qualities. You are curious, proactive, and motivated to learn. You enjoy building networks and collaborating with stakeholders across different functions and cultures. You work in a structured manner, manage changing priorities effectively, and have the confidence to make well-founded decisions based on facts and analysis. You demonstrate integrity, take responsibility for your actions, and act as a role model in ethical matters.

We believe you have:

    A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Procurement, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Economics, or a related field. Relevant vocational education (YH) and/or practical experience are also considered valuable.
    Strong analytical skills and an interest in data-driven decision-making.
    An interest in supplier management, sourcing, negotiations, and logistics.
    Fluent English skills, both written and spoken. Proficiency in Finnish and an additional Nordic language is considered an asset.
    A valid EU Category B driving licence, as the role involves regular travel to Boliden's sites.





Why work with us

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.



Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.



Want to know more about the position?

Contact hiring manager, Alexander Lindfors, Alexander.Lindfors@boliden.com.

Questions about the application are answered by our Talent Acquisition Partner, Pernilla Åkerblom, Pernilla.Akerblom@boliden.com, +46 73-023 69 61.

For union information, please contact Mats Lindblom, SACO, +46 73-350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70-541 83 93 or Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910-77 40 09.

We welcome your application no later than October 18, 2026

As part of Boliden’s qualitative recruitment efforts and systematic safety work, background checks will be included in the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Associate Senior Lecturer in Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

Luleå University of Technology is currently in a phase of expansion and is undertaking an initiative to strengthen research and education in cybersecurity by establishing a new research group in the field. This initiative builds upon the university's successful computer science environment—which includes several strong research groups—offering excellent opportunities for synergy. We therefore place great importance on research and the development of methods to protect various types of Internet-connected systems. These systems range from small sensors to large-scale control systems, such as those used for critical infrastructure. The research spans the spectrum from in-depth technical studies to applied research conducted in collaboration with industry and society.

The cybersecurity group at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering, Luleå University of Technology, is now seeking an Associate Senior Lecturer to contribute to our activities.

Subject description

Cyber Security focuses on technical security aspects as well as protection of systems that are connected to the Internet and include protection of software, data, and hardware.

Duties

As an Associate Senior Lecturer, you will be involved in the university's education—particularly our newly launched Master's programme in cybersecurity, but also undergraduate and doctoral-level courses where applicable. In addition, the role includes pedagogical development and research within one or more of our profile areas: AI security, memory-safe programming, cloud security, OT security, blockchain applications, security and resilience in 5G/6G networks, and security culture and innovation, based on your own research interests and ongoing research projects.

Qualifications

To meet the requirements for the appointment as associate senior lecturer, the applicant:

    must have been awarded a doctoral degree or must have a foreign degree considered equivalent to a doctoral degree.

Primary consideration should be given to someone who has been awarded a doctoral degree within five years of the application deadline for employment as an associate senior lecturer. However, someone who has been awarded a doctoral degree or achieved corresponding competence at an earlier date may also be considered if there are special grounds. Special grounds are sick leave, parental leave or other similar circumstances.

Assessment criteria

The following assessment criteria apply to this position:

    scientific expertise
    other assessment criteria.

Other assessment criteria:

    the degree of expertise required for qualification
    administrative proficiency that is of value in view of the subject matter and the duties included in the appointment
    the ability to collaborate with the wider community
    the ability to communicate research and development work
    the ability to teach in Swedish within a maximum of three years (the university offers language training if needed)
    doctoral degree obtained no more than five years prior to the application deadline

Currently, the majority of employees within the subject Cybersecurity are men and therefore we encourage applications from women.

In case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions of this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.

Period of employment

For this employment, an employment period of four years applies.

Promotion to senior lecturer

An associate senior lecturer shall, upon application, be promoted to senior lecturer and a position until further notice. If the applicant is qualified for a position as senior lecturer and in an examination is deemed suitable for such a position, is determined in accordance with the assessment criteria set out below:

In the examination, it is required that the associate senior lecturer has completed higher education pedagogical education corresponding to 7.5 credits or has acquired corresponding knowledge in another way.

During the employment period, the associate senior lecturer must also independently, to a considerable extent and with high quality, contribute to the university's research and demonstrate good pedagogical skills.

Information

Location for this position is Luleå or campus Skellefteå.

For further information about the position, please contact Professor and Head of Subject name, +46 910-585364, mailto:karl.andersson@ltu.se or Division Manager and Professor Kåre Synnes, +46 920-491507, mailto:kare.synnes@ltu.se

Application

We prefer that you apply for this position by clicking on the apply button below and attach the requested application documents including diplomas (certified and translated into Swedish or English), pedagogical self-reflection and publications, research plan, etc. We prefer that applicants follows the https://www.ltu.se/download/18.27fd965b18df224ef099841d/1710402295167/EngelskaAns%C3%B6kningsmall.pdf. Other

jobs.title: Vi søger pumpechauffør til Unicon i Avedøre eller Herfølge
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med store maskiner, tage ansvar på komplekse byggeprojekter og være den, der får betonen sikkert frem til målet?

Hos Unicon søger vi en pumpechauffør til vores team i Avedøre eller Herfølge. Har du den rette erfaring, tekniske forståelse og motivation, hjælper vi dig eventuelt med det nødvendige kørekort og de relevante certifikater til et job, hvor du både får udfordringer og kommer hjem hver dag. I videoen nederst kan du se eksempler på det udstyr, du skal køre og betjene.

Du kan naturligvis være Pumpechauffør i dag, men du kan lige så godt være uddannet maskinfører eller have tilsvarende erfaring. Du kan også være i entreprenørbranchen, betonbranchen eller landbruget. Det vigtigste er, at du trives med store maskiner, kan tage ansvar og bevare overblikket, når opgaverne bliver komplekse.

 

Du får ansvar for en af byggepladsens vigtigste opgaver

 

Som pumpechauffør hos Unicon er du specialist på byggepladsen. Du arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger, betonchauffører, byggeledere og kunder for at sikre, at støbningen bliver gennemført sikkert, effektivt og i den rigtige kvalitet.

Du er med til at sikre, at betonen bliver leveret og pumpet i den rette hastighed, så støbningen forløber som planlagt, og kunden får det resultat, der er aftalt. Det kræver både teknisk forståelse, gode samarbejdsevner og evnen til at træffe beslutninger, når forholdene ændrer sig.

Som pumpechauffør kører du pumpebilen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen. Her placerer du udstyret sikkert – ofte under trange forhold – og opsætter pumpen, så den passer til den konkrete opgave. Når støbningen går i gang, betjener du det avancerede pumpeudstyr og fungerer som kundens sparringspartner på pladsen.

Unicon er markedsleder i Danmark, og du bliver en del af projekter, der sætter varige spor i samfundet – fra boligbyggeri og infrastruktur til større erhvervs- og anlægsprojekter.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Din vej til jobbet kan være forskellig, men vi forestiller os, at du opfylder mindst ét af disse kriterier:

  • Uddannet maskinfører eller tilsvarende erfaring

  • Erfaring med beton- og støbearbejde

  • Erfaring med større maskiner og processer fra f.eks. landbrug eller industri

  • Erfaring med kraner, entreprenørmateriel eller andet teknisk udstyr

  • Relevant erfaring fra entreprenør- eller byggebranchen

Lige så vigtigt er det, at du:

  • Trives med ansvar og selvstændige beslutninger

  • Har en god teknisk og mekanisk forståelse

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret og serviceminded

  • Kan bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt

  • Arbejder sikkert, struktureret og løsningsorienteret

Stort kørekort og EU-bevis er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du den rette profil, tilbyder vi den nødvendige oplæring samt mulighed for at opnå relevante kørekort og certifikater.

 

Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

 

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne udstyr og spændende arbejdsopgaver

  • Mulighed for at få relevante kørekort og certifikater gennem Unicon

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og en unik holdånd

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

En arbejdsform med frihed, ansvar og gode muligheder for afspadsering

 

Som pumpechauffør arbejder du ikke efter et traditionelt 7-15-skema.

Når en større støbning er i gang, bliver vi på pladsen, til opgaven er løst. Derfor vil du opleve perioder med lange arbejdsdage og en del overarbejde. Til gengæld får du både den løn, der følger med, og gode muligheder for at opspare afspadsering – ofte i form af hele fridage.

Mange af vores pumpechauffører sætter pris på friheden og variationen i jobbet. Nogle dage er kortere, andre længere, men fælles for dem alle er, at man arbejder sammen om at få opgaven sikkert i mål.

Hvis du trives med ansvar, variation og tanken om at gøre arbejdet færdigt frem for at kigge på klokken, vil du passe godt ind hos os.

 

Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

 

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig – også selvom du ikke opfylder alle kravene på papiret.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Ib Jepsen på telefon 2484 0935.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Om Unicon

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

jobs.title: Postdoc in industrial systems with a specialization in automation
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Engineering Sciences brings together a large part of the University’s Bachelor of Science in Engineering and Master of Science in Engineering programmes in fields such as energy engineering, mechanical engineering, robotics, building engineering, environmental engineering and industrial systems. The department conducts internationally recognised research focusing on future energy and industrial systems. Collaboration with industry and society is central to developing sustainable, resource-efficient and competitive solutions for the society of tomorrow.

Employment information





Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years



Period of employment/Start date: As agreed



Scope: Full time



Number of positions: 1



Closing date for application: 26 october 2026



Campus location: Eskilstuna



School: Teknikvetenskap



Position description

The purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years.

The position consists mainly of research in which the candidate is expected to independently plan and carry out scientific studies in the area of smart and portable automation. The position will be conducted within the framework of the research profile MARC (Mälardalen Research and Competence Centre for Future Manufacturing), which means that the work will take place in close collaboration with industry partners and other researchers within the profile.

Within MARC, the research focuses on future sustainable and flexible production systems, where smart and portable automation plays a central role. The candidate is expected to contribute to the development of new methods, technologies, and prototypes for portable and reconfigurable automation, as well as explore how these solutions can be integrated into industrial environments with requirements for flexibility, quality, and resource efficiency. jobs.title: Senior Quality Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

Imagine owning the quality backbone of an aerospace company moving at full speed. While innovation accelerates around you, you ensure every design and every process meets the highest standards without slowing the momentum. As the Engineering Quality Manager, you will ensure that our engineering Organisation (including the Design Organization (DO)) maintains compliance with applicable standards and best practices (like EASA Part 21 Subpart J, EN9100). You’ll lead the development and oversight of our quality system, manage design supplier qualification and monitoring, drive internal and external audits and continuous improvement across all design, qualification and certification activities.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

  • Be responsible for establishing, documenting, developing and managing the Quality System and for ensuring that it continues to comply with regulatory requirements and business needs.
  • Support and guide our Engineering departments in the definition and implementation of efficient processes.
  • Oversee design supplier qualification, categorization, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Maintain and enhance the quality system, including document control, change management, and compliance monitoring
  • Monitor compliance of internal processes with established industry standards and certification authority requirements (such as EN9100, EASA Part 21J and required military standards).
  • Plan, conduct, and document internal and external audits in line with established processes.
  • Track and follow up on audit findings and corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and external auditors (e.g., EASA, MoD), and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and quality standards are met.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years in military or civil aviation or aerospace quality and compliance, or other highly quality driven industries such as automotive, energy with hands-on experience in the aviation industry
  • Experience with supplier quality management.
  • Track record in leading quality investigations, undertaking root cause analysis, developing corrective action plans, and ensuring the effectiveness of actions undertaken.
  • Audit training/certification or experience setting up  ISO 9001, AS9100, AQAP2110 quality systems required.
  • Familiarity with EASA Part 21 Subpart J and industry certification standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, STANAGs).
  • Strong communication, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills

Who You Are

You are naturally detail obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture. You combine regulatory sharpness with practical engineering judgment and you know when to challenge and when to enable. Calm under pressure, you bring structure to complexity and clarity to ambiguity. You are assertive without ego, collaborative without compromising standards. When something is not compliant, you speak up. When a process can be better, you improve it.

jobs.title: Project Controller

jobs.description:
Project Controller position available

The Chr. Michelsen Institute (CMI) has one, 100%, permanent Project Controller position available. CMI is a private research institute with English as the working language.

This position replaces a team member who is transitioning to a new role. 

The position is part of the Project Unit within the institute's Administration and reports to the Head of Projects. The Project Unit works across CMI to facilitate research and commissioned projects throughout their lifecycle by providing expert advice in grant management and project administration.

The preferred start date is January/February 2027. 


Job description and essential work tasks

As a Project Controller, you will work as part of the Project Unit at CMI with responsibility for a dedicated project portfolio, ensuring sustainable operations and continuous professional development of oneself and the unit.

The Project Unit is responsible for: 

  • The full lifecycle of research projects, including budgeting, financial monitoring, reporting, invoicing, contracts, and project close-out.
  • Compliance with funding regulations and legislation, contribute to the continuous development of grant management practices, and foster collaboration and knowledge sharing within the Project Unit and across the Institute.
  • Supporting application processes by providing administrative, financial, and compliance expertise.
  • Monitoring the market for commissioned research opportunities. 

Key work tasks in the Project Controller role

  • Provide financial and administrative oversight of research projects throughout their entire lifecycle, from the proposal stage to project completion.
  • Collaborate and communicate closely with researchers involved in the research projects within your assigned project portfolio.
  • Provide professional and administrative support for grant applications and tenders to national and international funding bodies and clients; contributing to the development of new project proposals.
  • Prepare project budgets, financial reports, invoices, and process financial documentation.
  • Manage the formal and legal aspects of agreements and contracts, including further developing and adapting contract templates.
  • Ensure the quality of administrative and financial reporting to funding agencies and clients.

What We Are Looking for in a Project Controller

Experience and Qualifications

  • A higher education degree in a relevant field.
  • Experience in project administration and financial control.
  • Understanding of grant compliance, funding regulations, and research administration.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English.
  • Experience with funding programmes from the Research Council of Norway and the European Union is an advantage.
  • Experience with commissioned work acquisition and bid management is an advantage. 

Personal skills

You are a proactive and solution-oriented professional who works effectively both independently and as part of diverse teams. 

You are organised, able to manage competing priorities and deadlines, communicate clearly and professionally, and are comfortable navigating digital systems and administrative processes. 

You enjoy learning, adapting to new requirements, and following through to deliver results.


CMI can offer you:
  • The opportunity to be part of a knowledge organization contributing to societal change. 
  • A vibrant and international working environment, with English as the primary working language.
  • Work-life balance and home office opportunities.
  • This position is placed either in the Adviser or Senior Adviser category, wage is determined by the position category and the candidate's experience. 
  • Salary for Adviser positions starts at NOK 688 271.-
  • Salary for Senior Adviser positions starts at NOK 787 831.- . 

Relevant staff benefits:

  • In addition to the annual 5 weeks holiday leave, CMI offers staff additional paid leave from the 24th of December to the 1st of January, and during the Easter week each year.
  • Support for gym membership.
  • Excellent travel insurance that covers both work and private travel (terms apply).
  • Defined contribution pension (innskuddspension). Contributions are paid with 7% of the salary up to 7.1 G and 25.1% of the salary between 7.1-12 G (2% are deducted from the employee, terms apply).

Location 

This position is located in Bergen, Norway. CMI is not in a position to offer remote working arrangements for new staff members. We offer home office agreements, allowing all staff to work up to two days a week from home office in Norway.


How to apply:

CMI only accepts applications through the JobbNorge recruitment system.

Please submit the following:

  • A cover page outlining your motivation for the position, and your qualification for the role
  • CV
  • Proof of highest degree received (i.e., copy of diploma or transcript)
  • A minimum of three references, including phone numbers and e-mail addresses

The application deadline is set to the: 15th of October 2026. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

CMI is an independent, development research institute based in Bergen, Norway, with around 110 staff members. In cooperation with partners from all over the world, we address key development challenges in Africa, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Latin America.

We combine high-quality research with an engagement to make knowledge accessible and used. We work in multi-disciplinary teams, where the main disciplines are economics, political science, and social anthropology. We have an international staff and an engaging working environment.

Our vision is 'research for a just and equal world', and our mission is to address global challenges by providing research-based knowledge that inspires and shapes policy and practice.

Our values are: inclusive & empathetic, collaborative, curious & bold and respectful. You can read CMI's strategy, vision, mission and values in full here: Who we are (cmi.no). 

CMI's strategic priorities for 2023-2028 are:

  • High-quality research: increasingly be internationally recognized for cutting edge, interdisciplinary academic and policy-relevant research.
  • Impact for societal change: To strengthen our influence, and shape public debates and policies in our fields of expertise.
  • Equal knowledge production: To be a role model in equal and inclusive partnerships in all of our endeavors.

CMI's structural priorities for 2023-2028 are:

  • An inclusive workplace: CMI must have an inclusive and healthy work culture that encourages and thrives on diversity, including in perspectives.
  • A developing & sustainable organization: CMI continues to adapt to changing needs and requirements by having sufficient staff with the right competencies, resources, and technology to support our operations.
  • Social responsibility: CMI works for sustainability in all areas of our operations, especially those focused on environmental, social and governance issues.

Looking for a dynamic, hands-on role that pairs packaging line operations with production scheduling and inventory flow? At Swedish Nutra in Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, we are seeking a detail-oriented team member to take charge of labeling, packing, and dispatching orders on time.

jobs.title: KRANMEKANIKER TIL SAWO I KØGE
jobs.description:
Kan du finde fejlen i en kran, få den løst og sende kunden sikkert videre? Vi søger en erfaren mekaniker, der kender sit håndværk.

Bliv vores nye kranmekaniker i Køge

SAWO i Køge søger en kollega med solid praktisk erfaring inden for service og reparation af kraner eller tilsvarende hydraulisk materiel. Du bliver en del af et værksted, hvor teknisk nysgerrighed og ordentligt håndværk gør en forskel for kunder, der er afhængige af, at deres udstyr virker.

Du får varierede opgaver og ansvar for at følge dem til dørs sammen med dygtige kolleger. Her er der brug for én, som kan tage fat fra første dag og samtidig har lyst til at lære SAWOs produkter grundigt at kende.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • udføre service, vedligeholdelse og reparation af lastbilmonterede kraner og beslægtet udstyr

  • fejlfinde systematisk på hydraulik, el og mekanik

  • udskifte og tilpasse komponenter samt teste og kvalitetssikre det færdige arbejde

  • dokumentere opgaverne og samarbejde med kolleger om den bedste løsning

  • bidrage til, at kunden får en driftssikker løsning og en god oplevelse

Fra fejl til driftssikker løsning

Fejlfinding → reparation → test → aflevering

Nogle fejl er ligetil. Andre kræver erfaring, tålmodighed og evnen til at se sammenhængen mellem hydraulik, el og mekanik. Du får plads til at bruge din faglighed og sparre med kolleger, når opgaven kræver flere øjne.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Erfaring er et krav. Du har arbejdet professionelt med kraner eller tilsvarende hydrauliske maskiner og kan selvstændigt udføre fejlfinding og reparation. Din uddannelse kan eksempelvis være som lastvognsmekaniker, entreprenørmaskinmekaniker, landbrugsmaskinmekaniker eller en anden relevant teknisk uddannelse. Om du har lært faget ad en anden vej, er mindre vigtigt end det, du kan i praksis.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

  • har solid forståelse for hydraulik og mekanik samt erfaring med elektrisk fejlfinding

  • arbejder grundigt, sikkert og tager ansvar for kvaliteten

  • kan planlægge dine opgaver og bevare overblikket, når noget driller

  • trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og faglig sparring

  • møder kunder og kolleger med en hjælpsom og professionel tilgang

Derfor skal du vælge SAWO

  • En varieret hverdag med teknisk krævende opgaver og ansvar

  • Et fagligt miljø, hvor du kan sparre med erfarne kolleger

  • En bred produktportefølje og mulighed for at udvikle din specialviden

  • Frihed under ansvar og fokus på ordentligt håndværk

  • Ansættelsesvilkår, der aftales efter kvalifikationer

Om SAWO

SAWO leverer, opbygger og servicerer kraner, hejs, ladopbygninger, lifte, medbringertrucks og specialudstyr til transport- og entreprenørbranchen. Siden 1962 har vi skabt driftssikre og skræddersyede løsninger. Med værksteder og servicepunkter over hele Danmark hjælper vi kunderne fra rådgivning og specialopbygning til service, reparation og reservedele.

Bag hver løsning står mennesker med høj faglighed, stærkt engagement og respekt for kundens forretning. Det gælder også dig, hvis du bliver vores nye kollega.

Klar til næste skridt?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Værkstedschef, Klæmint Christensen, kch@sawo.dk. Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte Klæmint Christensen på 27747626.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Master Thesis: Recycled aluminium in battery casing application – microstru
jobs.description:
This master thesis is part of the Net Zero Impact Innovation-funded BAALSCRAP project (BAttery casings from ALuminum alloys with low carbon emissions produced from SCRAP), which aims to enable the production of battery cell housings from recycled aluminum scrap and thereby support the transition towards a circular and net-zero automotive industry. The project investigates how alloying elements and impurities originating from recycled feedstock affect manufacturing processes and material performance.

The thesis will focus on the relationship between microstructure and weld properties of recycled aluminum alloys for battery casing applications. The work will involve detailed characterization of welds using light microscopy and scanning electron microscopy (SEM), with emphasis on precipitates, intermetallic particles, segregation, porosity, cracking, and other welding-related defects. The influence of recycled alloying elements and residual impurities on weld quality and performance will be assessed and correlated with material properties. In addition, property calculations (e.g. crack susceptibility) will be used to predict weld performance as a function of alloy composition. The modeling results will be compared with the experimental observations to improve the understanding of microstructure evolution during welding and to help explain the relationship between alloy chemistry, weld microstructure, and weld performance.

Desired Qualifications
We are looking for a highly motivated Master's student in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Materials Engineering, or a related field. The ideal candidate has an interest in experimental research and materials characterization, with a particular focus on microstructure-property relationships in metallic materials. Experience or coursework in microscopy, welding metallurgy, aluminum alloys, or electron microscopy is advantageous but not required.

Additional Information
The project is planned to be carried out during the spring semester of 2027 at Swerim in Stockholm. Upon successful completion of the Master's thesis (30 ECTS credits), Swerim will provide a compensation of SEK 50,000.

Contact
För ytterligare information om projektet, vänligen kontakta: Shirin Nouhi, shirin.nouhi@swerim.se

jobs.title: Software Engineering Productivity Lead
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate technologist to lead the ways of working across all of Bittium groups software development: about 300 developers building everything from firmware to web frontends. You will set the standard for how we build, review, test, document and ship software, and roll it out hands-on with the teams. You get real authority, direct access to R&D leadership and backing from group management.

You might be the person who

- argued the team into a better merge strategy, and was right.
- tried the new build tool the weekend it came out.
- replaced a team's creaking toolchain with something modern, and nobody wanted to go back.
- has been told no about a rewrite more than once.
- moved into a lead, architect or managerial role years ago and never stopped writing code or tinkering with the pipelines.
- has rolled a new way of working out across several teams, and knows the hard part was never the tooling.

If a couple of these sound like you, keep reading. Whether you are a senior engineer ready to take your first step into leading and owning change beyond your own team, or a leader who has done this before and still wants to get your hands dirty, this role is built for you.

What you will own

- You define what modern software engineering means at Bittium: the standard every team builds against, and you keep raising it as the industry moves.
- You set our group-wide engineering workflow: version control strategy, branching, code review and CI/CD, from commit to release, with room for what each product and team needs and built for agentic-first development.
- You decide the quality bar a release has to clear: what we require from test automation, documentation and review before software ships.
- You author an engineering handbook with our senior engineers: a practical guide to how we build software, clear enough that any team can pick it up and use it.
- You help shape how we measure engineering health.

Product teams choose the right technology for their product. You are the engineers' engineer: you define, and help build, the engineering infrastructure and ways of working they stand on: pipelines, quality gates, test and documentation tooling, ready to use and maintained like products. Adoption is supported, not dumped on the teams. The work does not end with the first rollout. The foundation keeps evolving, and you keep pushing it forward.

Your first six months

- Help write the first version of our engineering handbook: a practical guide to how we build software, in one place.
- Set the group's ways of working, starting with source control and CI/CD, with the first teams already building on it.
- Get the first shared pipeline, quality gates and documentation tooling live with real teams. Working, not a slide deck.
- Put the first release quality gates into production use.

Where we are headed

Our goal is simple: well-tested, well-documented software, built on a shared, modern development platform. Software development is shifting toward agentic workflows, and we want our codebases ready for that: modular, containerized and verifiable, so an agent can check one out, build it, run the tests and trust the result. You define what that readiness means in practice, together with our Head of AI. We are also investing heavily in hardware-in-the-loop test automation against real devices, and your standards set the bar there too.

What we ask

- A software engineering background strong enough to hold your own with our senior engineers.
- A track record of changing how teams work, whether as the engineer who pushed for better Git workflows and modern tooling and made it stick, or as the lead who ran that change across an organisation.
- Strong opinions and dirty hands. You prototype, build and fix things yourself, and you lead the change at the same time: you own the direction, carry it through and answer for the outcome.
- You know modern DevOps and the engineering platform behind it well: version control, CI/CD, test automation, developer documentation.
- Agentic software development has clicked for you. You work with coding agents daily, you see where this goes as agents take on whole tasks with less and less supervision, and you have opinions about what that demands from codebases, tests, environments and documentation.
- You can work across very different stacks. Ours include, among other things, C/C++, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, web frontends, embedded Linux and FPGA.
- Fluent Finnish and good English.
- Due to the nature of Bittiums business and our customers expectations, you are a Finnish citizen and able to pass security clearance conducted by the Finnish Security Intelligence Service (SUPO).

We do not count years of experience. Skill, will and passion decide.

What we offer

- Group-wide authority over engineering standards.
- Deep technology with real stakes, from military radios in national defence to ECG monitors in hospitals.
- Room to stay hands-on. Prototype, experiment, pick the best tools. IT supports the infrastructure.
- Hybrid work in Oulu, our headquarters software site, or Espoo. Flexible inside Finland. Competitive pay.

Interested?

Send us your application as soon as possible. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period.

About Bittium

Bittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provides healthcare technology products and services for biosignal measuring in the areas of cardiology and neurology. Net sales in 2025 were EUR 119.3 million and operating result was EUR 19.4 million. Bittium is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki

The AI-powered OS for beauty,
wellness and self-care

About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
 
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
 
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role overview
 
Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business.
 
Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact.
 
To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées.

  • Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities
  • Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets
  • Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes
  • Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve
  • Tele-prospecting - Previous experience in an outbound call environment or a related sales position preferred
  • Communication - Excellent and proven written, verbal and presentation skills
  • Innovative - Creative thinking and problem-solving mindset
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder

jobs.title: Administrativ koordinator hos Lejeboligmægleren i Aalborg?
jobs.description:
Der er travlt hos Lejeboligmægleren, og vi søger derfor en struktureret og initiativrig administrativ koordinator til vores afdeling i Aalborg.

Hvem er vi?

Lejeboligmægleren er en landsdækkende virksomhed med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Odense og Aalborg. Vi er specialiseret i udlejning af boliger og samarbejder med professionelle ejendomsinvestorer, ejendomsselskaber og private udlejere om alt fra enkeltstående boliger til større projektbyggerier.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst med ambitionen om at være den største og foretrukne lejeboligmægler i Danmark. Vi har en flad organisation, korte beslutningsveje og et stærkt socialt sammenhold. Vi lægger vægt på, at vores medarbejdere tager ansvar og bidrager til virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling.

Vi søger nu en ny kollega til Aalborg, som kan være med til at understøtte både ledelsen og den øvrige organisation og sikre, at opgaver og projekter bliver ført godt i mål.

Om jobbet

Som administrativ koordinator får du en central og alsidig rolle på vores kontor i Aalborg.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med virksomhedens direktør og får en bred kontaktflade på tværs af organisationen. Dine opgaver spænder fra administration og projektkoordinering til mindre HR-opgaver og understøttelse af vores udlejningsteams.

Det betyder, at du skal være indstillet på kundekontakt og på at håndtere kundehenvendelser, fremvisninger og andre udlejningsrelaterede opgaver, når der er behov for det.

En del af jobbet består i at hjælpe direktøren med den daglige drift. Det kan f.eks. være administrative, organisatoriske og salgsmæssige opgaver samt koordinering af forskellige projekter og initiativer. Du vil også få en rolle i forbindelse med mindre HR-opgaver.

Du skal derfor trives med en hverdag, hvor opgaverne varierer, og hvor planer indimellem ændrer sig. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men er samtidig klar til at give en hånd med, når der er travlt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Løbende administrative og koordinerende opgaver

  • Assistance til direktøren med administrative, salgsmæssige og organisatoriske opgaver

  • Koordinering og opfølgning på interne projekter og opgaver

  • Mindre HR-opgaver, herunder koordinering og administration i forbindelse med medarbejdere, rekruttering og onboarding

  • Hjælp til udlejningsteams med lejerhenvendelser og fremvisninger ved travlhed, ferie og sygdom

  • Diverse ad hoc-opgaver i en organisation, hvor dagene ikke altid er ens

Hvem er du?

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke det vigtigste for os. Det afgørende er, at du er ansvarsbevidst, selvstændig og trives i en rolle med stor variation og kontakt til mange forskellige mennesker.

Du er typen, der naturligt tager initiativ, får ting til at ske og sørger for, at opgaverne bliver afsluttet. Du kan prioritere mellem flere opgaver og bevare roen, når der opstår noget uventet og skal løses

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

  • Er god til at prioritere mellem flere samtidige opgaver

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager initiativ

  • Har gode kommunikative evner på dansk

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i kontakten med både kunder og kolleger

  • Er fortrolig med IT og almindelige administrative systemer

  • Har sans for detaljer uden at miste det overordnede overblik

  • Er fleksibel og trives med en bred rolle, hvor opgaverne kan ændre sig fra dag til dag

  • Har kørekort

Erfaring fra en lignende administrativ eller koordinerende stilling er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det kan f.eks. være som administrativ koordinator, PA, projektkoordinator, kontorassistent eller fra en anden stilling med lignende opgaver.

Hos os får du blandt andet:

  • En central rolle med tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens direktør

  • En varieret hverdag med mulighed for selv at præge rollen

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for gradvist at få mere ansvar

  • En flad organisation med korte beslutningsveje

  • En ung arbejdsplads med højt tempo og stærkt socialt sammenhold

  • Sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviteter på tværs af vores afdelinger

Stillingen er på fuld tid, og din daglige base bliver på vores kontor i Aalborg. Der kan være mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage.

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt.

Er du vores nye administrative koordinator?

Send din ansøgning og CV til HR-partner Lone Krogh, Jobvision – lokr@jobvision.dk – med emnet “Administrativ koordinator Aalborg”. Ved spørgsmål er du velkommen til at ringe til direktør Martin Winter Larsen tlf. 53 54 50 54.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at fjerne opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.
