jobs.title: Sachbearbeiterin Operations – Global Operations & Customer Service (m/w/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Spedition und Logistikdienstleistung)
jobs.description:
Sachbearbeiterin Operations – Global Operations & Customer Service (m/w/d).

Standort: Frankfurt/Main – Kelsterbach

Anstellung: Vollzeit

Start: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Du hast Lust auf internationale Logistik, koordinierst gerne und bist kundenorientiert?

Dann komm in unser Operations Team.

Als Sachbearbeiterin Operations bist du mittendrin im internationalen Tagesgeschäft:

Du koordinierst Anfragen, steuerst Containerbewegungen und sorgst gemeinsam mit deinem Team dafür, dass unsere Kunden weltweit zuverlässig versorgt werden. Dich erwartet ein abwechslungsreicher Job mit echten Einblicken in globale Luftfrachtprozesse, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem Team, das gemeinsam Lösungen findet.

Was dich erwartet

Du arbeitest im operativen Tagesgeschäft mit und übernimmst Verantwortung für reibungslose Abläufe.

- Abwicklung der Vermietung von Kühlcontainern an Airlines und Logistikdienstleister weltweit
- Disposition der Container für eine zuverlässige und termingerechte Bereitstellung
- Überwachung und Steuerung der globalen Bestände.
- Weltweite Positionierung der Container per Truck, Schiff und Flugzeug
- Abstimmung mit internen und externen Partnern zu Verfügbarkeit, Wartung und Reparaturen
- Pflege und Verwaltung aller relevanten Bewegungsdaten in unseren IT-Systemen

Was du mitbringen solltest

- Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise in Spedition, Logistik, Luftfracht oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
- Du organisierst dich gut, arbeitest zuverlässig und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig laufen.
- Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Ländern und findest kundenorientierte Lösungen.
- Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und lösungsorientiert.
- Du denkst mit, erkennst Zusammenhänge und hast Freude daran, Abläufe besser zu machen.
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Was wir dir bieten

- Ein internationales Umfeld in einem erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen mit kurzen Wegen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
- Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice.
- Laptop und iPhone.
- Regelmäßige Teamevents.
- Corporate Benefits mit attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten.
- EGYM Wellpass.
- Kostenfreie Parkplätze inklusive Wallbox.
- Moderne, helle Büroräume mit kostenfreiem Kaffee und Getränken.

Etwas über uns

DoKaSch TEMPERATURE SOLUTIONS GmbH ist ein mittelständisches, wachstumsstarkes Familienunternehmen mit besten Zukunftsaussichten und sicheren Arbeitsplätzen. Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein internationales Umfeld prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Wir entwickeln, bauen und vermieten temperaturgeregelte Spezialcontainer für die Luftfracht. Diese werden für den interkontinentalen Transport von hochwertigen, lebenswichtigen und temperaturempfindlichen Medikamenten eingesetzt. Unter unseren Kunden befinden sich viele namhaften Pharmakonzerne, Airlines und globale agierende Spediteure auf allen Kontinenten. Unsere Opticooler®-Container arbeiten autark und garantieren über alle Klimazonen hinweg eine ungebrochene Kühlkette.

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams!

So geht es weiter

- Bewerb dich bitte direkt online, indem du auf "Jetzt bewerben" klickst.
- Wir melden uns umgehend bei die und wenn uns Ihre Bewerbung gefällt, machen wir dir einen Terminvorschlag für einen Video-Call
- Bei Fragen vorab kannst du gerne Kontakt zu uns aufnehmen.

Klingt das gut? Dann bewerb dich jetzt. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Product Operations - (Logistics Service) (Business-Analyst/in)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Specialist, Product Operations - Logistics Service to join the Product Performance team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

In our Logistics Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

Our Service Product line is responsible for all customer support-related products, including our in-house agent-facing tools for customer issue resolution, our self-service engine and our global compensation application. Within the Product line, you will be responsible for the performance of our products and work very closely with our product, analytics and data science teams and different entities across the globe to optimize them in order to maximize the value (both cost and top-line) to the business.

- Contribute to improving customer retention and resolving post-delivery issues, with a focus on optimizing self-service experiences
- Run analyses on customer behavior, product usage, and issue resolution patterns to identify opportunities that increase retention, improve experience, and reduce operational costs
- Collaborate closely with product managers, analytics teams, and data scientists to design and evaluate A/B tests and build actionable insights
- Monitor and report on key performance indicators related to retention and post-delivery, ensuring data is accurate, timely, and relevant
- Support regional and local teams by delivering targeted insights, dashboards, and recommendations within your area of specialization
- Identify and communicate areas for product and process enhancements, contributing to prioritization discussions with cross-functional teams
- Contribute to regular reporting and insights for stakeholders and leadership, highlighting both impact and opportunities for efficiency gains

Qualifications

- 4+ years of relevant experience (not counting internships) in a consulting or tech company, working in functions like product operations, user retention, pricing or revenue management
- You have at least a Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative subject - e.g. computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering, social sciences, psychology
- Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to draw insights from complex data sets
- You are self-driven and communicative, independent and pragmatic in handling business challenges
- You are proactive, intellectually curious, and motivated by shaping product and business strategy in a high-stakes environment
- Excellent hands on knowledge of reporting tools (Tableau or Looker Studio) & strong hands on knowledge in SQL

Nice to have

- Experience using AI tools in everyday work to bring efficiency and automation
- Experience in a similar large scale tech or e-commerce environment

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

- You have very good written and spoken English skills and, ideally, experience with common collaboration and documentation tools.
- You hold a valid driver's license and are willing to work across locations as needed and to ensure 24/7 availability.

- You'll have the opportunity to work partially from home or remotely, allowing you to enjoy the benefits of a hybrid work model (flexible work)
- Team spirit and diversity
- Work-life balance
- Competitive compensation
- Employee benefits
- Diverse professional development opportunities
- Team and sports events

jobs.title: Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) (Personalreferent/in)
jobs.description:

Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

We are currently looking for a Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) for our Headquarters in Stuttgart / Germany.
The Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) is responsible for supporting the Vice President Compensation & Benefits and Mobility in designing, managing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving compensation and benefits programs to align across Exyte's global organization with the Global strategy. The role develops scalable, market-competitive, and compliant solutions that balance global consistency with local market and regulatory requirements. Working globally, this position partners with HR, Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external advisors to strengthen global job architecture, pay structures, incentive programs, benefits governance, and annual reward processes that support attraction, retention, engagement, and internal equity.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Global Reward Strategy & Program Design: Partner with the VP Compensation, Benefits & Global Mobility to develop and implement global compensation and benefits strategies, frameworks, and governance models that balance enterprise-wide consistency with local market, legal, and business requirements.
- Global Process Ownership & Execution: Lead and optimize global compensation and benefits processes, including annual salary reviews, bonus planning, pay decisions, budgeting, and benefits harmonization across multiple countries and regions.
- Global Analytics, Benchmarking & Technology: Drive global market benchmarking, reward analytics, pay equity assessments, workforce cost forecasting, and data-driven reporting to support strategic reward and workforce decisions.
- Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Establish and maintain robust global compensation and benefits policies, governance structures, and compliance frameworks while ensuring adherence to evolving regulatory and reporting requirements.
- Global Stakeholder Advisory & Change Enablement: Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders, leading global change initiatives, policy transformations, and reward program implementations.
- Vendor & External Partner Management: Own the global vendor strategy for Compensation & Benefits, including provider selection, contract management, service quality oversight, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Global Scope: Operate effectively across international regions, cultures, and time zones, fostering collaboration within a global environment and supporting business needs through occasional international travel.
- Program & Project Leadership: Lead complex global reward projects, including M&A integrations, job architecture initiatives, compensation technology implementations, pay transparency programs, benefits harmonization, and organizational change activities.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
- Multiple years of professional experience, including significant experience in global or multi-country compensation and benefits roles
- Deep expertise in global compensation and benefits strategy, job architecture, market benchmarking, salary structures, incentive design, and annual reward processes.

- Experience working across multiple countries and regions within a complex, matrixed multinational organization.

jobs.title: Junior Controller Product Costing & Inventory Valuation (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER (Buchhalter/in)
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Are you interested in accounting, controlling, manufacturing processes and understanding how product costs are built up? Then join our Product Costing & Inventory Valuation team. In this role, you develop expertise in Cost Accounting, Inventory Valuation and SAP S/4HANA processes while working closely with finance, controlling and operational teams worldwide.

- You support month-end and year-end closing activities, including Product Costing, Inventory Valuation and financial reporting processes.
- You analyze, validate and monitor standard and actual product costs in SAP, including the execution of product costing runs.
- Besides that, you investigate cost deviations, perform root cause analyses and collaborate with manufacturing, accounting and controlling teams to ensure accurate product cost calculations.
- In this role, you review, maintain and validate costing-relevant master data to ensure high data quality and accurate inventory valuation.
- Last but not least, you provide operational support for SAP S/4HANA Product Costing processes and contribute to process improvements, harmonization initiatives and automation projects.
- bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field

- good understanding of accounting principles, financial closing processes, cost accounting and inventory valuation, with a strong interest in manufacturing environments
- experience with SAP ERP, SAP CO, Product Costing, Material Ledger or SAP S/4HANA is an advantage
- structured and analytical way of working, strong attention to detail, and fluent English communication skills, additional European languages are a plus

WHAT WE OFFER

jobs.title: Plant Manager - Marl (Werkleiter/in)
jobs.description:
Der Plant Manager ist für die Gesamtleitung von zwei Produktionsstandorten in Marl verantwortlich. Der Schwerpunkt der Position liegt auf Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, operativer Effizienz sowie der Koordination der Logistik.

Die Position umfasst die Steuerung des täglichen Betriebs und stellt gleichzeitig die Einhaltung der EHS-Vorschriften, Qualitätsstandards, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und Unternehmensrichtlinien sicher. Der Site Manager führt das Standortteam und treibt die kontinuierliche Verbesserung in den Bereichen Produktion, Qualität, Kosten und operative Leistungsfähigkeit voran.

Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller geltenden EHS-Gesetze und -Vorschriften sowie der internen Group-Richtlinien an den Produktionsstandorten.
- Verantwortung für Produktionsleistung, Produktqualität, Durchsatz und termingerechte Lieferungen.
- Planung und Überwachung der operativen Budgets sowie Sicherstellung einer effektiven Kostenkontrolle.
- Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse unter Anwendung von Lean-Manufacturing-Prinzipien.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller lokalen und unternehmensinternen EHS-Anforderungen, einschließlich Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und arbeitsmedizinischer bzw. arbeitshygienischer Programme.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Anforderungen hinsichtlich des sicheren Betriebs und der Instandhaltung von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.
- Abstimmung der Produktionskapazitäten und Personalplanung mit den Anforderungen der Logistik.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Anforderungen und Ziele gemäß ISO 9001, ISO 14001 und ISO 50001.
- Verbesserung von Qualität, Ausbeute, Durchsatz, Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Kosten durch kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und OPEX-Projekte.
- Identifizierung von Investitionsmöglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Anlageneffizienz und Ausbeute.
- Sicherstellung, dass die Produktionskosten innerhalb der genehmigten Budgets bleiben.
- Erstellung regelmäßiger Betriebs- und Leistungsberichte für den zuständigen Vorgesetzten, einschließlich: - Operative Leistungskennzahlen
- Qualität der Fertigprodukte in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung
- Wesentliche Produktions- und Kostenkennzahlen
- Sicherstellung einer effektiven Instandhaltung zur Minimierung von Stillstandszeiten und Maximierung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit.
- Führung, Entwicklung, Coaching und Motivation des Standortteams.
- Bearbeitung von Leistungs- und Verhaltensangelegenheiten bei Bedarf.
- Organisation und Überwachung der vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Bestandsaufnahmen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Logistik, Qualität, Instandhaltung, EHS, Finanzen und HR.
- Nationale und internationale Reisetätigkeit nach Bedarf (ca. 5 %).

Anforderungen:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Bergbau oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in einem produzierenden, industriellen, bergbaulichen oder vergleichbaren Produktionsumfeld.
- Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich der Betriebs- und Produktionsabläufe, einschließlich Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, Qualität, Prozesse, Instandhaltung und Investitionsprojekte (CapEx).
- Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams sowie im operativen Management.
- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Entscheidungs- und Problemlösungskompetenz.
- Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einem dynamischen und schnelllebigen Umfeld zu steuern.
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit.
- Ausgeprägter Fokus auf Sicherheit, Qualität, operative Exzellenz und Kundenanforderungen.
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

jobs.title: Hero Support Specialist (Assistent/in - Personalwesen)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Specialist, Hero Support to join the People & Culture team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

- Your Role: As a Specialist in Hero Support, you will play a key role in managing HR operations, optimizing employee lifecycle workflows, and ensuring smooth service delivery across DHSE Central. You'll bring a blend of strong operational expertise and a continuous improvement mindset to keep our processes efficient, compliant, and candidate- and employee-friendly.
- Operations & Case Management: Act as a primary operational contact for employee and manager queries via Jira, Slack, and email, independently resolving mixed-complexity tickets per month while maintaining >90% SLA adherence.
- End-to-End Lifecycle Operations: Execute employee lifecycle processes including employment contracts, amendments, probation management, transfers, and terminations, supporting a wide range of teams across the organization.
- Data Integrity & Compensation Administration: Maintain accurate employee records in Workday and support pre-payroll data reconciliation, one-time payments, and compensation updates with 95% accuracy and strong attention to compliance.
- Stakeholder Collaboration & Advisory: Apply working knowledge of German labor law and company policies to partner effectively with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Legal, and People Partners, serving as a trusted consultative advisor to managers and stakeholders across the business.
- Process Improvement & Automation: Identify operational bottlenecks and drive workflow enhancements in Workday and Jira, implementing process improvements per quarter to continuously elevate the employee experience.
- Knowledge Management: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and self-service Knowledge Base resources for employees and managers.
- Projects & Operational Excellence: Support cross-functional initiatives across HR compliance, process digitization, and audit readiness to enhance scalability and service quality.

Qualifications

- 1–3+ years of hands-on experience in HR Operations or People Operations, managing end-to-end employee lifecycle processes in a fast-paced environment.
- Solid understanding of German labor law, social security regulations, and general HR administrative compliance.
- Strong proficiency with modern HR systems, particularly Workday and ticketing platforms like Jira or ServiceNow.
- A customer-centric, empathetic mindset with a strong focus on high-quality service delivery.
- Strong detail orientation, problem-solving skills, and ability to prioritize in a dynamic workflow.

jobs.title: Lead System Engineer (m/w/d) Automotive Entwicklung – Luxemburg / Remote (1720) (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
jobs.description:
Ihre Karriere in der Steuerung komplexer Systementwicklungsprojekte.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Entwicklung elektronischer Fahrzeugsysteme. Sie steuern die Systementwicklung von den Kundenanforderungen bis zur Systemfreigabe, koordinieren Releases und Entwicklungsumfänge und führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich. Der Tätigkeitsschwerpunkt liegt im Remote-Arbeiten mit regelmäßigen Projekteinsätzen in Luxemburg.

So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei

- Systementwicklung: Sie verantworten die termingerechte Bearbeitung der Systems-Engineering-Arbeitspakete von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zur Systemfreigabe
- Entwicklungsplanung: Sie planen Arbeitspakete, Zuständigkeiten, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcen, Termine und Meilensteine und steuern die Umsetzung über Releases und Sprints hinweg
- Releaseplanung: Sie definieren Produkt- und Release-Umfänge, koordinieren Änderungen und stellen die technische Reife für anstehende Releases und Meilensteine sicher
- Anforderungsmanagement: Sie steuern die Entwicklung von Stakeholder- und Systemanforderungen und gewährleisten deren Qualität, Priorisierung und durchgängige Rückverfolgbarkeit
- Systemintegration: Sie stellen die konsistente Umsetzung der Anforderungen und Architekturspezifikationen in Software, Hardware und Test sicher
- Schnittstellen: Sie koordinieren die technische Abstimmung mit Kunden sowie Software, Hardware, Test, funktionaler Sicherheit, Cybersecurity, Fertigung und weiteren Fachbereichen
- Teamsteuerung: Sie führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich, verfolgen Risiken und Entwicklungsfortschritte und vertreten den Systemstatus in Kunden-, Release- und Projektbesprechungen

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Systems Engineering: Solide Kenntnisse in Systems Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement, Systemintegration und Release-Prozessen sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken
- Normen: Kenntnisse relevanter Automotive-Standards wie ISO 26262 und Automotive SPICE
- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

- Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg
- Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Entwicklungsumfelds, das technische Verantwortung und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit fördert

HOPPE, europaweit Marktführer in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung von Beschlagsystemen für Türen und Fenster, ist mit rund 2.200 Mitarbeitern international tätig. Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)

- Aktive Mitarbeit in Produktentwicklungs-Projekten

Wissen

jobs.title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
jobs.description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Have we piqued your interest?

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

Do you have any questions? Then feel free to send us an email at malte.ruetten@softwareone.com.

jobs.description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. You’re a team player, authentic, open, and face challenges with a positive mindset? Then you’re a perfect fit for us!

  • With a comprehensive understanding of the relevant functional and technical concepts, you identify dependencies early and work closely with experts to develop and evaluate robust solutions.
  • Particularly during rollout, readiness, and go-live phases, you drive decisions and follow them through, ensure successful delivery, manage escalations, and represent the program confidently towards management, steering committees, and other relevant stakeholders.


Your profile

  • Consulting experience in leading complex international programs and projects within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry forms the foundation of your expertise.
  • Strong knowledge of MES and Manufacturing IT is complemented by hands-on experience in the implementation, integration, and multi-site rollout of corresponding solutions.
  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and their interfaces with Quality, Automation/OT, ERP/SAP, and other relevant systems are areas in which you are highly confident.
  • A solid understanding of GxP, Computerized Systems Validation, and pharmaceutical Quality processes enables you to translate regulatory requirements effectively into program planning, governance, and delivery.
  • Excellent German and English skills, combined with a willingness to travel internationally, enable you to operate confidently across complex global program environments.


Your start with us

At our company, you’ll find a work environment where initiative, collaboration, and mutual support are truly valued. You can expect exciting projects, a fair salary, plenty of development opportunities, and a flexible working model tailored to your needs.
 
Your journey with us starts with a well-structured onboarding, including two welcome days at our Frankfurt office, a buddy program, and access to internal networks to help you feel at home from day one. Our internal training curriculum, additional learning formats, and tailored development paths support your individual career goals. Regular events, cross-location networks, and our feedback platform miaX create space for exchange, ideas, and collaboration.

We work in a hybrid model: depending on the project requirements, you will work remotely, in one of our offices or directly at the customer's premises.

jobs.title: Responsable Approvisionnement Biomasse H/F
jobs.description:
MISSIONS :
- Rédige et tient à jour les procédures concernant la mobilisation sur chantier de défriche agricole, urbaine ou forestière, de récupération de connexes de scieries, de bois en fin de vie ou autre sourcing biomasse,
- Assure la prospection et la recherche de fournisseurs/ sous traitant de biomasse ou transporteur de biomasse,
- Pilote le choix, la négociation, et la contractualisation des achats de biomasse ou de gestion de chantiers de défriches ou forestiers en concertation avec sa direction,
- Soumet à sa direction les choix d'achats de biomasse,
- A un œil vigilant sur la conformité réglementaire de l'origine de la biomasse en lien avec sa direction,
- Planifie et organise les livraisons de biomasse (hebdomadaire, mensuel, annuel) pour assurer un approvisionnement permettant le fonctionnement de la ou des centrales en production,
- Planifie, contrôle et coordonne les activités d'exploitation forestières (abattage, débardage, broyage, transport, stockage) pour les chantiers de l'équipe de mobilisation,
- Organise les opérations de stockage/déstockage sur parc de rupture le cas échéant,
- Suit les contrats en communication permanente avec la responsable de parc à bois,
- Informe le Responsable de parc en cas de difficultés d'approvisionnement ou de changement de volume livré au jour le jour pour permettre la coordination appro/réception,
- Réalise les calculs de coût de biomasse réel/ chantier,
- Programme et organise les chantiers de défriche selon une stratégie définie et validé par la direction,
- Recherche des solutions à toutes situations problématiques rencontrées sur le terrain ou avec les parties prenantes en créant de nouvelle procédure au besoin.
- Fais de chaque expérience une analyse permettant d'améliorer les procédures dans l'ensemble.

PILOTAGE FINANCIER ET ADMINISTRATIF DE L'APPROVISIONNEMENT BIOMASSE :
- S'assure du respect des objectifs budgétaires fixés par la direction Providex et des objectifs d'approvisionnement de biomasse, il engage et suit les commandes de biomasse auprès des fournisseurs en concertation avec la direction,
- Tient à jours les indicateurs de coûts sur la biomasse en concertation avec la responsable de parc à bois qui suit la réception de la biomasse,
- Analyse les indicateurs, pointe les écarts et dysfonctionnements, propose des solutions à la direction.

MANAGEMENT DES ÉQUIPES DE L'APPROVISIONNEMENT BIOMASSE :
- Manage et anime l'équipe de mobilisation (mobilisateurs),
- S'assure de la continuité de service dans l'équipe mobilisateurs,
- Identifie, valorise et développe les compétences de ses collaborateurs en proposant des formations appropriées,
- Participe aux groupes de travail au sein de la centrale, destinés à améliorer l'appareil de production ou les conditions de travail,
- S'assure de la prévention des risques professionnels sur l'activité qu'il encadre en lien avec sa direction,
- Assure la mise en place de procédure adéquate avec le ou la SQE sur les chantiers de mobilisation.

SÉCURITÉ :
- Suit et veille à faire appliquer les recommandations du SQE  sur les chantiers,
- Informe la direction et QSEE de tout incident, accident ou situation à risque, et traite l'anomalie en conséquence,
- Veille à l'application de toutes les règles et procédures de sécurité établies.

ENVIRONNEMENT :
- Veille en permanence au respect absolu des normes environnementale sur chantier,
- Anticipe toutes anomalies à venir, agit et fait agir en conséquence.

QUALITÉ :
- Décline la politique qualité qui sera déployée,
- Applique et fait appliquer les procédures du SMI,
- Suit les non conformités, actions correctives et préventives,
- Renseigne et suit les indicateurs biomasse mis en place par la direction,
- Suit et applique les recommandations du QSEE,
- Informe le personnel de la politique et de l'application des dispositions Qualité qui seront mis en place.

Kuusamo Safaris on vuonna **1993 perustettu paikallinen perheyritys**. Järjestämme moottorikelkkasafareita ja muita luontoelämyksiä sekä vuokraamme moottorikelkkoja.

Haemme sesonkityöntekijää **kokoaikaiseen, määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ajalle 7.12.2026–11.4.2027.**

**Työtehtävät**

- Moottorikelkkasafarien vetäminen perehdytyksen jälkeen.

- Asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen, varustaminen ja opastaminen.

- Kelkkavuokraamon asiakaspalvelu ja käytännön tehtävät.

- Varusteiden ja kaluston valmistelu sekä käyttövalmiudesta huolehtiminen.

- Muut safaritoiminnan päivittäiset tehtävät.


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Reipasta, oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta.

- Asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä ja halua työskennellä erilaisten ihmisten kanssa.

- Viihtymistä ulkona talvisissa olosuhteissa.

- Englannin perustaitoja ja rohkeutta käyttää kieltä asiakastilanteissa.

- B-ajokorttia.

- Valmiutta myös ilta- ja viikonlopputyöhön.


**Aiempi kokemus safarien vetämisestä on eduksi, mutta ei edellytys. Tärkeintä on reipas asenne ja halu oppia – perehdytämme sinut tehtäviin.**

Myös muu kokemus asiakaspalvelusta, kelkkailusta tai luonnossa liikkumisesta on hyödyksi.

**Tarjoamme**

- Kokoaikaisen työn talvikaudeksi Rukalla.

- Monipuoliset työpäivät talvisen luonnon ja asiakkaiden parissa.

- Perehdytyksen tehtäviin ja työyhteisön tuen.

- **Kiinteän kuukausipalkan 2 100–2 700 €/kk** osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan sekä työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät ja korvaukset.

- **Apua sopivan asunnon tai majoituksen etsimiseen.**


**Kiinnostuitko? Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä!**

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi viimeistään **18.10.2026** osoitteeseen **info@kuusamosafaris.fi**. Kerro itsestäsi, osaamisestasi ja siitä, milloin voisit aloittaa.

Ensimmäiseen yhteydenottoon et tarvitse valmista CVä. Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana.

**Kuusamo Safaris · Ruka · kuusamosafaris.fi**

jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionThe Software Platform Senior Engineer / Lead Engineer, will be responsible for supporting a strong team of engineers working on hi-tech embedded applicative software in a provided project perimeter.



You will be part of Software Engineering Department which has multidisciplinary teams across multiple Safran sites working together to provide innovative, future products of high technological value in aeronautical, land and maritime industries.



You will work in close collaboration with the Reseach&Development headquarters of Safran Electronics and Defense in France. In the short term, you will join a task force dedicated to Low Level Testing.



You will have the responsibility of the Low Level Testing activities, by supporting your team directly. In this context you will be reporting directly to the Technical Manager and operationally to the Tech Lead.

Working with others, you shall responsible for:

- ensuring the highest level of quality for Team deliverables in compliance with DO-178C;

- providing help to the Team software engineers when stuck;

- handling the more complex pieces of software via Architecture/Integration/Development;

- challenge choices from the Management from a Technical standpoint by raising awareness on technical risks on challenging topics;

- train upcoming new engineers with knowledge learned from the Technical Management.



About Safran Electronics & Defence

Safran Electronics & Defence is an international company with over 14,000 employees mobilizing their expertise and team spirit to design high-tech solutions in aerospace, defence and space industries. By combining human and technological intelligence, the company develops products and services to help civilian and military players observe, decide and guide on land, at sea, in the sky and space thus contributing to safer world.

Safran Electronics & Defence's centre in Bengaluru is an upcoming centre of excellence to established to provide R&D and Engineering solutions to local (Make-in-India) as well as global requirements of the company.



Welcome to Safran, powering the aeronautical industry with trust.

Reference of excellence, open to the world, and part of the main characters of innovation, we share a common vision of a future for aviation.

Joining us is becoming part of the most challenging projects carried out in the field: propelling from the most pioneering Air Taxis startups to the legacy flagships counting HAL.

At Safran, we value long-term commitment from our collaborators, and promote an environment of trust at all levels, by empowerment.

jobs.title: Director Payment Integrity
jobs.description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

Du ønsker at blive en vigtig del af vores daglige drift, hvor opgaverne løses både selvstændigt og i tæt samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer på vores ejendomme i Aarhus området.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Daglige varierede service- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver både ude og inde.

  • Udførelse af faste driftsopgaver og ad hoc-opgaver samt mindre reparationer og kontakt med håndværkere.

  • Klargøring og opfølgning ved ind- og fraflytninger, herunder gennemførelse af ind- og fraflytningssyn med efterfølgende istandsættelsesplan.

  • Bidrage til et pænt, trygt og velfungerende miljø på vores ejendomme.

Om dig Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som vicevært, ejendomsfunktionær, håndværker eller lignende.

  • Har interesse for grønne områder og ved, hvordan man holder dem pæne og indbydende.

  • Arbejder med struktureret tilgang og har øje for detaljen.

  • Er praktisk anlagt og har en løsningsorienteret tilgang til opgaverne.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og samtidig være en god holdspiller.

  • Bevarer overblikket og det gode humør, også når tempoet er højt.

  • Er serviceminded og god til skabe positive relationer til lejere og samarbejdspartnere.

  • Er fortrolig med brug af IT og digitale arbejdsredskaber.

  • Har kørekort kategori B. 

Vi tilbyder

  • Et selvstændigt og ansvarsfuldt job, hvor din indsats bliver set, mærket og værdsat.

  • En alsidig hverdag med både faste, varierende ad-hoc arbejdsopgaver.

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

  • Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer.

Tiltrædelse Efter aftale, gerne hurtigst muligt.

Send din motiveret ansøgning og CV til job@nmejendom.dk Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter når rette kandidat er fundet.

jobs.description:
**Ryhmäliikunnan ohjaaja MTC:lle, Tampere (Lielahti)**

Etsimme MTC:lle innostavia ryhmäliikunnan ohjaajia, jotka osaa ohjata monipuolisia tunteja, esimerkiksi PUMP, RPV, kehonhuoltoa ja kuntopiirejä. Lisäksi haemme erityisesti myös Pilates ohjaajaa. Jos sinua kiinnostaa, voit halutessasi tehdä myös asiakaspalvelutunteja salillamme.

Valmennuskeskus MTC on matalan kynnyksen liikuntakeskus Lielahdessa, Tampereella. Meillä on lämminhenkinen ja yhteisöllinen meininki: asiakkaamme viihtyvät luonamme, ja moni tulee paikalle myös jutustelemaan, ei vain treenaamaan. Suurin osa asiakkaistamme on keski-ikäisiä ja eläkeikää lähestyviä naisia, joille tärkeintä on arjen toimintakyky ja hyvä olo. Meillä ei siis lasketa kaloreita eikä juosta maratoneja, vaan keskitytään kokonaisvaltaiseen hyvinvointiin ja mukavaan fiilikseen.

Työ koostuu ryhmäliikuntatuntien ohjaamisesta, ja jos kiinnostusta löytyy, mukaan on mahdollista ottaa myös asiakaspalvelua. Ryhmätunnit painottuvat iltapäiviin ja iltoihin, mutta tarjolla on myös aamupäivätunteja.

**Työn alkaminen:** Työ alkaa joustavasti syksyn aikana sopimuksen mukaan.

**Työn muoto:** Alkuvaiheessa työtä tehdään yrittäjänä tai kevytyrittäjänä laskuttaen.

Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Hotelis Spa & Wellness Hotels hledá člověka, který dá našemu marketingu jasný směr, styl a výsledky.
Do našeho týmu hledáme zkušeného a kreativního Marketing Managera / Marketingovou manažerku, který/á bude zodpovědný/á za rozvoj značky Hotelis, marketingovou strategii a podporu prodeje našich hotelů.
Hledáme někoho, kdo umí spojit kreativitu s čísly, má přehled v online marketingu, chápe hotelové prostředí a dokáže proměnit nápady v reálné kampaně, které přivádějí hosty.

Budete mít na starosti marketingovou komunikaci značky Hotelis a našich hotelů. Vaší rolí bude především:
• tvořit a realizovat marketingovou strategii v souladu s obchodními cíli společnosti,

• připravovat a koordinovat marketingové kampaně, promoakce, balíčky a speciální nabídky,
• spravovat a rozvíjet online komunikaci, webové stránky a sociální sítě,

• koordinovat grafické a propagační materiály,
• sledovat konkurenci, trh a zákaznické segmenty,
• vyhodnocovat efektivitu kampaní a připravovat reporting pro vedení společnosti,
• přicházet s návrhy, jak marketing dále zlepšovat a posouvat.

Koho hledáme
Hledáme člověka, který má:
• zkušenosti s marketingem, ideálně v hotelnictví, cestovním ruchu, wellness nebo službách,
• přehled v online marketingu a správě sociálních sítí,

• cit pro značku, vizuální styl a kvalitní obsah,
• analytické myšlení a schopnost vyhodnocovat výsledky,
• dobré organizační a komunikační schopnosti,
• samostatnost, spolehlivost a proaktivní přístup,
• chuť přinášet nové nápady a dotahovat věci do konce.

Nechceme jen správce sociálních sítí. Hledáme partnera pro marketing, který bude rozumět tomu, že dobrý marketing musí být nejen hezký, ale hlavně funkční.
Očekáváme profesionální přístup, odpovědnost, férovou komunikaci a schopnost spolupracovat s obchodem, revenue, provozem i vedením společnosti.

• mzda 60.000 Kč/měsíčně,
• zajímavou a samostatnou marketingovou pozici v hotelové skupině,

• možnost reálně ovlivnit podobu marketingu a komunikace značky.

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. If you have a strong foundation in software development, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a track record of delivering high-quality code, we want to hear from you. 



In this role you will:

 - Expand Replit's cloud infrastructure offerings: Launch new cloud products to be used by Replit Agent to build complex apps. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

 - Enhance reliability and scalability: Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths, and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems. Work closely with the SRE team to ensure high availability and minimal downtime. Enable our customers to seamlessly scale their applications to meet the demands of their growing user base.

 - Improve utilization of cloud infrastructure: Analyze our infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization. Implement strategies to reduce cloud expenses without compromising performance or reliability. This could involve techniques such as resource provisioning, auto-scaling, cost-aware scheduling, and data lifecycle management. Your efforts will directly contribute to the financial efficiency of our cloud services.



Required skills and experience:

 - Distributed systems: Track record of working with platform-as-a-service, distributed storage, or information retrieval systems. Experience in designing scalable architectures and optimizing systems for latency or cost. 

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex challenges pragmatically and devise effective solutions. You think radically but ship incrementally.

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Able to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects forward. You take ownership and initiative.

 - Versatility and flexibility: Able to wear multiple hats and tackle a wide range of challenges. You are comfortable working across different layers of the stack and adapting to the needs of the project.

 - Continuous learning and adaptability: Passionate about staying up-to-date with industry trends and expanding your skill set. You embrace change and adapt quickly.



Nice to have:

 - Experience working on cloud infrastructure or platform products, particularly in the areas of application deployment, serverless computing, or container orchestration.

 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools, such as GCE, GKE,, Cloud Run, or Cloud Storage.

 - Contributions to open-source projects related to cloud technologies, deployment frameworks, or developer tools. We love OSS!



Tools + Tech Stack for this role

This role may not be a fit if

 - You are a generalist backend engineer who hasn’t built scalable distributed systems.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The systems underneath that experience must support safe production changes, measurable reliability, and predictable performance as usage grows.

This Engineering Manager will lead SRE across observability, incident management, load testing, performance engineering, cloud cost and capacity, and rollout infrastructure. You'll lead and grow an existing team that builds and operates production platforms and works hands-on across application and infrastructure boundaries.

This is a software-building leadership role, not simply an incident-management function. You'll help teams ship safely, understand production behavior, and remove performance bottlenecks through concrete engineering improvements. You should be comfortable going deep on a rollout failure or performance investigation while developing technical leaders and sustainable ownership across a distributed team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Observability. Build and operate metrics, logs, traces, and alerting capabilities. Help teams establish meaningful SLOs and use production telemetry to diagnose problems and verify improvements.

 - Incident Management. Own incident tooling and practices, coordinate cross-team response, and turn incident reviews into engineering improvements that reduce recovery time and repeat failures.

 - Load Testing. Build and maintain load/failure testing capabilities. Validate critical paths under expected demand, quantify headroom, and test recovery and production readiness with service owners.

 - Performance Engineering. Lead deep engagements with internal teams on SLOs and end-to-end performance. Use profiling, telemetry, and load tests to identify bottlenecks and deliver improvements with service owners—not just recommendations.

 - Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools—including Replit—to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated changes.

 - Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Make distributed collaboration, mentoring, and backup coverage deliberate rather than relying on a few permanent escalation points.

 - Measure outcomes and close the loop. Track rollout safety, recovery time, repeat incidents, critical-path latency/throughput, test coverage, and improvements arising from cost/capacity analysis. Agree success measures and continuing ownership with partner teams.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team—not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

 - Software-oriented production systems depth. You have built and operated distributed systems or reliability platforms and can reason across deployment behavior, Kubernetes, telemetry, service dependencies, and recovery mechanisms.

 - Safe-change and performance judgment. You have led consequential migrations or incidents and used measurement to diagnose reliability or performance problems. You can distinguish symptoms from causes and validate fixes under realistic conditions.

 - Platform-product and cross-team judgment. You can build capabilities other teams adopt, lead hands-on engagements without absorbing every service's operations, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, performance, engineering effort, and cost.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with GitOps or progressive-delivery platforms such as Harness, ArgoCD, or Kargo.

 - Experience with observability, profiling, load-testing, and failure-testing systems, including OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling.

 - Experience with cloud cost attribution, capacity planning, and provider coordination, particularly on GCP.

 - Experience growing distributed teams and using AI tools to increase engineering output while preserving production safeguards.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Ads
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

Help turn “I built a business” into “I have customers.” As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll help shape Agentic Ads: an emerging area focused on using AI to make customer acquisition more accessible to businesses built on Replit.

 

This role focuses on intelligent, advertiser-facing software—not ad-serving infrastructure, an ad exchange, or a real-time bidding engine. You’ll tackle problems at the intersection of AI, business growth, measurement, and trustworthy automation, turning complex decisions into clear, useful experiences.

 

You’ll help define a new product area, working closely with product, design, and engineering to discover customer needs and deliver practical solutions. This is a hands-on Staff role: you’ll own architecture, lead delivery across teams, mentor engineers, and turn an ambitious vision into incremental customer value.




YOU WILL:

 - Set technical direction for Agentic Ads, translating customer needs into an architecture and roadmap that balance rapid learning with long-term reliability.

 - Build agent-powered experiences that help businesses make informed growth decisions, translating user goals into understandable recommendations and appropriately authorized actions.

 - Design extensible integrations with external services, using well-defined APIs and abstractions that accommodate changing provider capabilities and requirements.

 - Partner with product and data teams to establish reliable measurement, connect product activity to business outcomes, and address data quality, delayed feedback, and uncertainty.

 - Develop intelligent automation that learns from performance signals and helps users improve outcomes within their goals and constraints.

 - Make financial control a product requirement: scoped authorization, explicit approvals, budget limits, auditable decisions, clear reporting, and reliable pause controls. Distinguish recommendations from actions that commit customer spend.

 - Make cross-platform workflows reliable with durable state, idempotency, safe retries, reconciliation, observability, and recovery from partial failures, expired credentials, rate limits, and provider API changes.

 - Establish agent evaluations and production monitoring for plan quality, tool selection, policy compliance, spend safety, and verified execution. Partner on experiments that distinguish attributed results from incremental customer value.

 - Lead ambiguous initiatives across product, design, AI, data, security, and partnerships. Stay hands-on with implementation, define incremental milestones, mentor engineers, and own the quality and operation of what the team ships.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical leadership on complex customer-facing products or platforms: setting direction, resolving ambiguity, and delivering through launch and production operation across multiple teams.

 - Strong hands-on software engineering and system design skills across APIs, data modeling, distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, and customer-facing product experiences.

 - Experience building and operating third-party integrations that remain correct under duplicate requests, partial failures, rate limits, changing schemas, and inconsistent external state.

 - Practical experience shipping LLM-powered products or agentic workflows, including tool use, orchestration, evaluations, and safeguards for actions taken against external systems.

 - Strong data and measurement judgment: experience using instrumentation and experiments to evaluate product outcomes, and the ability to reason about noisy data, delayed feedback, uncertainty, and correlation versus causation.

 - Sound judgment around systems that act on a user’s behalf, including authentication, authorization, sensitive data, approval boundaries, and limits on consequential actions.

 - Demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams, explain technical trade-offs, mentor engineers, and drive execution without relying on reporting authority.

 - A product-minded approach to simplifying complex workflows for non-experts, with hands-on ownership from prototype through reliable production operation.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building advertiser-facing products, marketing automation, campaign-management tools, growth platforms, or software that helps businesses acquire customers.

 - Experience integrating advertising or marketing APIs; familiarity with account onboarding, campaign lifecycles, and platform requirements.

 - Working knowledge of conversion tracking, attribution, customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, budget pacing, and the limits of optimizing with low conversion volume.

 - Experience with experimentation, incrementality measurement, constrained optimization, recommendation systems, or decision-making under uncertainty.

 - Experience building permissioned, multi-tenant products with approval workflows, budget controls, audit trails, and privacy-aware handling of customer and conversion data.

 


BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience with agent tooling, durable workflow execution, delegated authorization, or evaluation frameworks for agents that take consequential actions.

 - Experience connecting application events or server-side conversion signals to advertising platforms, or integrating creative generation and landing-page experimentation into growth workflows.

 - Experience building for small businesses or first-time advertisers, where clear guidance, limited budgets, and sparse data shape the product.

 - These are additional strengths, not a checklist. Experience with every ad platform is not expected; ad-serving infrastructure experience and an ML research background are not prerequisites.




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Customer outcomes: success means helping a business acquire qualified leads and customers—not merely connecting an account, launching a campaign, or increasing spend.

 - User control and trust: agents explain recommendations, act within explicit authority, and make budgets, costs, and consequential changes understandable.

 - Evidence over activity: we validate measurement, acknowledge uncertainty, and test whether a change improves business outcomes rather than treating attribution as proof of causality.

 - End-to-end ownership: we own the journey from a business goal through campaign execution, measurement, and ongoing improvement.

 - Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on existing ad platforms, ship focused increments, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter.

 - Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed.

jobs.description:
Glavne odgovornosti:

  • Savjetovanje i podrška: Putem telefona i e-maila savjetuješ tvrtke na francuskom tržištu – isključivo na francuskom jeziku – o tome kako najbolje iskoristiti našu platformu za preuzimanje visokokvalitetnih potencijalnih klijenata (leadova).
  • Analiza i rast prodaje: Analiziraš poslovne ciljeve klijenata, predlažeš optimalna rješenja unutar platforme i pratiš rezultate kako bi im osigurao/la kontinuiran rast prodaje.
  • Optimizacija rezultata: Redovito analiziraš uspješnost obrade leadova kod klijenata te pružaš strateške preporuke kako bi povećali stopu konverzije i ostvarili bolji povrat investicije.
  • Customer Support & Feedback: Brzo i profesionalno rješavaš sve upite, reklamacije i prijedloge klijenata, djelujući kao spona između njih i naše platforme.
  • Rad iz ureda: Posao se obavlja isključivo iz našeg ureda u Splitu (nije remote), što nam omogućuje bržu internu komunikaciju i bolju timsku sinergiju.

Uvjeti:

  • Izvrsno znanje francuskog jezika u govoru i pismu (minimalno razina C1) – s klijentima komuniciraš tečno i prirodno, na razini izvornog govornika, bez primjetnog naglaska
  • Iskustvo u korisničkoj podršci, account managementu ili telefonskoj prodaji (računamo i studentski rad)
  • Empatija i sposobnost slušanja: razumiješ potrebe klijenata i pretvaraš ih u konkretne korake
  • Organiziran/a si, voliš timski rad i motiviraju te jasni ciljevi

Što nudimo:

  • Strukturirani onboarding, kontinuirane edukacije i mentorstvo
  • Motivirajući bonusi povezani s rezultatima tima i portfelja
  • Ured s prijateljskom atmosferom i povremenim team building aktivnostima

Zašto se pridružiti:

  • Tržište smo lansirali nedavno – sudjeluješ u izgradnji od samog početka, imaš priliku ostaviti svoj trag i rasti zajedno s platformom
  • Napredovanje svakih 12 mjeseci
  • Vikendi i večeri su slobodni – rad-život balans nam je važan – radimo samo do 16 h radnim danom
  • Moderna oprema, besplatna kava i tim koji dijeli znanje i iskustvo

Osiguravamo ti između 20 i 30 dana odmora, ovisno o tvojoj dobi i stažu unutar naše firme. Posebno cijenimo tvoje slobodno vrijeme, stoga potičemo korištenje dužeg godišnjeg odmora tijekom ljetnih mjeseci kako bi u potpunosti napunio/la baterije.

  • izvršavanje aktivnosti i radnji potrebnih za obavljanje prethodno opisanih poslova radnog mjesta
  • odgovoran je za povjerena sredstva i predmete rada te za uredno, pravodobno i točno izvršavanje radnih zadataka prema pravilima struke
  • obavlja druge poslove i izvanredne radne zadatke po nalogu Voditelja IT odjela i Uprave u okviru svoje stručne spreme i stečenog znanja
  • Obvezno provodi mjere zaštite na radu, zaštite od požara, zaštite okoliša i sigurnosti objekata,
  • Dosljedno provodi sve procedure i propise,
  • Obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog

Tražimo osobu koja je pedantna i odgovorna u svom radu, koja ima izraženu sklonost samostalnom obavljanju zadataka, ali dobro funkcionira i u timskoj organizaciji poslova.

Istovremeno nudimo rad u dinamičnom i lijepom okruženju, te razne mogućnosti usavršavanja i stalnog educiranja.

Također, ističemo da društvo Olympia Vodice u svojstvu poslodavca aktivno se zalaže za jednake mogućnosti i jednako postupanje prema svim svojim zaposlenicima, bez obzira na rasu, boju kože, spol, jezik, dob, nacionalnost, seksualnu orijentaciju i identitet, invaliditet, vjeru, političko ili drugo uvjerenje, imovinu, rođenje ili bilo koji drugi status. Svjesni smo naše uloge velike organizacije te odgovornosti utjecaja na živote svih naših zaposlenika, korisnika naših usluga i društva u cjelini. Svim budućim zaposlenicima poručujemo da svoju društvenu odgovornost shvaćamo ozbiljno, uz poduzimanje mjera za borbu protiv bilo kojeg oblika diskriminacije, zlostavljanja i seksualnog uznemiravanja.
