jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.


Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Kantineansvarlig til uddannelsesinstitution i Odense C
jobs.description:
Kan du skabe en kantine, som elever og ansatte glæder sig til at besøge? Hos The Cantina søger vi en kantineansvarlig, der vil stå i spidsen for den daglige drift og sætte sit præg på maden og oplevelsen omkring den.

Kantinen er et naturligt omdrejningspunkt på uddannelsesinstitutionen. Vi ønsker, at den skal være et inspirerende sted at træde ind: med god service, indbydende mad og idéer hentet fra det grønne køkken og alle verdenshjørner. Vi prioriterer økologiske råvarer, hvor vi kan.

Du får det daglige ansvar for kantinen og arbejder sammen med en kollega i fleksjob, som hjælper med kassebetjening, opvask og mødevogne. Du har samtidig tæt kontakt med institutionen og The Cantinas ledelse om kantinens udvikling.

The Cantina er en lille familieeget virksomhed hvor du indgår som en del af ledelsesteam på 6 ledere på tværs af vores virksomhed.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Planlægge og tilberede kantinemad og mødeforplejning

  • Skabe variation med grønne retter og inspiration fra forskellige madkulturer

  • Sikre, at mad, præsentation og service holder en høj kvalitet

  • Samarbejde med institutionen om møder og arrangementer

  • Bestille varer og stå for egenkontrol

  • Udvikle kantinen i samarbejde med The Cantina

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra køkken eller kantine og trives med at tage ansvar

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og har overblik, også når der er travlt

  • Har lyst til at arbejde kreativt med grøntsager og økologiske råvarer

  • Møder elever, ansatte og kolleger med godt humør og god service

  • Bidrager til et trygt og godt samarbejde i hverdagen

Hos os får du mulighed for at præge en kantine med en central plads i huset. Du bliver en del af The Cantina, hvor vi vægter samarbejde og faglig udvikling. Stillingen er på fuld tid med arbejde mandag til fredag og enkelte arrangementer om aftenen. Løn efter overenskomst.

Send din ansøgning til os, vi venter gerne på den rette.

jobs.title: Lønbogholder til barselsvikariat – deltid
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med lønadministration, sans for detaljer og trives du med at være den, kollegaerne går til, når de har spørgsmål til løn og overenskomster?

Så kan det være dig, vi søger til et barselsvikariat i en veletableret produktionsvirksomhed i Langeskov.

 

Vi søger en lønbogholder på deltid, som kan blive en del af økonomifunktionen og være med til at sikre en korrekt og effektiv lønadministration for virksomhedens medarbejdere.

 

Om jobbet

Som lønbogholder får du en central rolle i virksomhedens lønteam, hvor du sammen med en lønbogholderkollega får ansvaret for den daglige lønadministration.

Du bliver en del af økonomiafdelingen, som består af ca. 8 medarbejdere inden for bogholderi og controlling, og du vil referere til Finance Manager.

Stillingen har en bred kontaktflade, og du kommer til at samarbejde med forskellige afdelinger i organisationen. Du bliver samtidig en del af en supportfunktion, hvor du bidrager med specialistviden inden for løn og hjælper kollegaer med at finde løsninger på løn- og overenskomstrelaterede spørgsmål.

 

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Lønkørsel for timelønnede og funktionærer i lønsystemet Lessor

  • Registrering og bogføring af timer i ERP-system

  • Lønafregning og lønafstemning

  • Vedligeholdelse af stamdata

  • Sikre korrekt håndtering af overenskomster samt vejlede organisationen om løn- og overenskomstspørgsmål

  • Håndtering af refusionsansøgninger

  • Diverse indberetninger til Danmarks Statistik, pensionsselskaber og myndigheder

  • Ajourføring af lønrelaterede statistikker

  • Ad hoc-opgaver samt mulighed for at bidrage til øvrige opgaver inden for økonomi, HR og reception

 

Din profil

Vi søger dig, som har erfaring med lønadministration og gerne har arbejdet med ERP- og lønsystemer.

Du arbejder struktureret og grundigt og har en naturlig sans for detaljer. Du forstår vigtigheden af, at løndata er korrekte hele vejen gennem processen, og du tager ansvar for, at opgaverne bliver fulgt til dørs.

Da lønfunktionen har en bred kontaktflade i organisationen, er det samtidig vigtigt, at du har gode kommunikative evner. Du trives med at hjælpe og vejlede dine kollegaer og kan formidle regler og komplekse problemstillinger på en letforståelig måde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med lønadministration

  • Har kendskab til Lessor eller et tilsvarende lønsystem

  • Har erfaring med ERP-systemer

  • Har arbejdet med overenskomster

  • Er struktureret og detaljeorienteret

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og ansvarsbevidst

  • Trives med en bred kontaktflade og med at yde intern support

 

Virksomheden tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en solid og veletableret produktionsvirksomhed med base i

Langeskov, tæt på motorvejen.

 

Virksomheden tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Et spændende og alsidigt barselsvikariat

  • Deltidsansættelse

  • Fleksible arbejdstider

  • Mulighed for delvist hjemmearbejde efter endt oplæring

  • Sundhedssikring

  • Kantineordning

  • Aktiv personale- og idrætsforening

  • Fritvalgskonto

  • Feriefridage

  • Bonusordning baseret på virksomhedens samlede omsætningsmål

 

Om virksomheden

Virksomheden er en veletableret aktør i den nordeuropæiske stålbranche og har mere end 400 medarbejdere samt omfattende produktionsfaciliteter.

Virksomheden arbejder med kundetilpassede løsninger og har et stærkt fokus på medarbejdernes engagement og trivsel. Samtidig er bæredygtighed og den grønne omstilling centrale fokusområder, hvor stålets muligheder for genanvendelse spiller en væsentlig rolle.

Du bliver en del af en organisation, hvor samarbejde, faglighed og ansvarlighed er en naturlig del af hverdagen, og hvor økonomifunktionen spiller en vigtig rolle i at understøtte resten af organisationen.

 

Ansøgning:

Matcher ovenstående dine kvalifikationer, hører vi meget gerne fra dig. Send en ansøgning og CV på mail@vkconsulting.dk. Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når rette match er fundet. Ved evt. spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at henvende dig til VKCONSULTING på tlf. 70201512 alle hverdage. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

 

Bemærk, alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt og med stor diskretion. Med henvisning til reglerne omkring GDPR modtages ansøgninger kun via linket i stillingsannoncen. Kan du ikke uploade din ansøgning via ansøgningsknappen, bedes du kontakte os. Vores annonce bliver automatisk og løbende fornyet på jobportalerne, indtil stillingen er besat. En fornyelse af et stillingsopslag er dermed ikke et udtryk for genopslag, men blot en automatisk fornyelse af annoncen.

jobs.title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

Etsimme asiakkaallemme monitaitoista ja reipasta puhdistustyöntekijää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tässä työssä päivät eivät ole samanlaisia! Työtehtäviisi kuuluu erilaisia siivous- ja puhdistustöitä sekä tuholaistorjuntaa. Lisäksi tarpeen mukaan pääset tekemään myös toimistotöitä ja muita yrityksen arjen tehtäviä.

Etsimme henkilöä, joka ei hätkähdä, vaikka päivän aikana tehtävä vaihtuu useamman kerran. Sinulla on monipuolista osaamista, tartut rohkeasti uusiin haasteisiin ja viet hommat loppuun asti.

- voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia
- hyvää suomen kielen taitoa
- reipasta ja rempseää asennetta
- oma-aloitteisuutta ja itsenäistä työotetta
- halua oppia uutta ja tarttua erilaisiin tehtäviin
- yrittäjähenkistä asennetta – näet mitä pitää tehdä ja ryhdyt toimeen

Aikaisempi kokemus siivous-, puhdistus- tai tuholaistorjuntatehtävistä on eduksi, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme monipuolisuutta, tekemisen meininkiä ja asennetta.

Tässä työssä pääset olemaan todellinen moniosaaja!

Jos olet tyyppi, joka sanoo onnistuu mieluummin kuin ei kuulu mulle, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Tarjoamme vakituinen työsuhteen, monipuolisen työn ja mahdollisuuden oppia jatkuvasti uutta.

Hakeminen ja lisätiedot

About the role

In this role, you will work at the intersection of business operations and IT, taking end-to-end ownership of a portfolio of digital services and applications supporting large-scale hydropower operations. You will act as a crucial link between business stakeholders, architects, internal delivery teams, and external suppliers, ensuring that IT services remain secure, cost-efficient, reliable, and continuously evolving.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with a strong possibility of extension. The position offers a flexible hybrid work model (2–3 days a week at the office) and is based in Espoo. Occasional travel within the Nordic countries is expected.

We offer:
- High-impact ownership: Direct end-to-end responsibility for digital services supporting critical hydropower infrastructure
- Professional growth: A supportive, expert community where you are trusted to challenge yourself and develop your skills
- Hybrid work model: Flexibility to combine remote work with office presence (2–3 days a week at Espoo office)

Work tasks
- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of a portfolio of Hydro IT services and applications
- Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, translating operational needs into clear service roadmaps and action plans
- Drive service performance, availability, cybersecurity, compliance, and user experience
- Lead supplier collaboration, overseeing service quality, vendor commitments, contracts, and costs
- Prioritize development initiatives in close alignment with business owners, architects, and delivery teams
- Ensure all services align with internal IT service management standards, architecture principles, and continuity requirements

We are looking for

- A relevant academic background (Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field)
- Solid experience in IT service management, application management, or digital service delivery
- Good understanding of ITIL practices, agile development, and the lifecycle of business-critical applications
- Practical experience in supplier management, service governance, and cost tracking/budgeting
- Proactive, structured, and self-driven mindset with the confidence to take ownership of complex entities
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
- Full fluency in English (written and spoken)

It is considered a strong advantage if you have:
- Experience within the energy sector, operational technology (OT), or industrial digitalization
- Proficiency in Finnish or Swedish

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, Pispan kotihoito
jobs.description:
Pispan kotihoidossa on asiakkaita noin 130 neljässä eri hoitotiimissä. Moniammatillisen työyhteisömme yhteinen tavoite on tarjota asiakkaillemme laadukasta hoitoa ja tukea heidän omannäköistä arkeaan kotona. Hyödynnämme työssämme aktiivisesti hyvinvointiteknologiaa ja kehitämme kotihoidon palveluja yhdessä. Kotihoidon tavoitteena on edistää asiakkaan kokonaisvaltaista perusturvallisuutta, kuntoutumista sekä arjessa selviytymistä.

Lähihoitajana teet tärkeää työtä kohdatessasi asiakkaan hänen omassa kodissaan ja mahdollistamalla hänen selviytymisensä arjessa. Työsi on itsenäistä, liikkuvaa ja päivät ovat erilaisia. Kotihoidossa tehtäviisi kuuluu mm. lääkehoito, kirjaaminen sekä muut monipuoliset ja ihmisläheiset hoito- ja hoivatyöt. Jokapäiväisessä käytössämme on myös työtä tukevaa teknologiaa, kuten lääkeautomaatteja ja kuvapuhelimia.

Miksi hakea meille?
Saat meillä hyvän perehdytyksen sekä tuen työkavereilta ja esihenkilöltä.
Pystyt vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi, jotta vapaa-ajan ja työn yhdistäminen olisi mutkatonta.
Tarjoamme hyvät työsuhde-edut kuten vuosittaisen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedun Epassilla, työnantajan lounasedun ja tyhy- sekä Virkisty Vapaalla ry:n toimintaa.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?
Olet nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja (sosiaalihuolto) tai perushoitaja.
Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvasti suomea.
Sinulla on B-luokan ajokortti, auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi. Käytössämme on leasing-autoja ja sähköpyöriä helpottamaan kulkemista asiakaskohteidemme välillä.
Sinulla on LOVe - lääkehoidon verkkotesti suoritettuna hyväksytysti (LOVe LOP, PKV, KIPU1, GER 1). Tarvittaessa voit suorittaa lääkehoidon osaamisen myös työpaikalla, heti työsuhteen alussa.
Katsomme eduksi aiemman työkokemuksen kotihoidosta.

Aloitus tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan. Toivomme, että voit aloittaa tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian. Tehtävä on määräaikainen 31.12.2026 asti. Koeaika on puolet työsuhteen kestosta. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, keskimäärin 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa. Työhön sisältyy aamu- ja iltavuoroja. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista. Lisäksi suosittelemme vahvasti tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Pispa on rempseä ja huumorilla höystetty tiimi, joka ottaa avoimesti vastaan uusia työntekijöitä. Jätä hakemuksesi Kuntarekryssä heti, haastattelemme jo hakuajalla!

jobs.title: POSTDOCTORAL OR DOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN PHOTOCATALYTIC RADICAL CHEMISTRY
jobs.description:
POSTDOCTORAL OR DOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN PHOTOCATALYTIC RADICAL CHEMISTRY
The University of Helsinki, Department of Chemistry, invites applications for a postdoctoral or doctoral researcher position in photocatalytic radical chemistry at the newly established Lahdenperä Group. Initially, the position is fixed-term for 12-months with a possibility of an extension.
Position description
The successful candidate will join an organic chemistry research group at the Department of Chemistry located at Kumpula campus. The research group aims to develop new concepts for controlling radical reactivity in photocatalytic transformations. The project focuses on the development of new approaches for controlling radical reactivity through hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) at surfaces and interfaces.
The project will involve:
* Development and optimisation of photocatalytic radical transformations
* Mechanistic studies of radical reactions and detailed investigation of HAT processes.
* Surface functionalization and interface chemistry.
* Design and synthesis of organic molecules.

The postdoctoral researcher will additionally be expected to contribute to the supervision of students and participate in future funding applications.
Requirements
Postdoctoral Researcher
Applicants must hold a PhD degree in chemistry or a closely related field by the start of employment, or be close to completion of their doctoral studies.
Consideration will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:
* synthetic organic chemistry.
* photocatalysis, radical chemistry, hydrogen atom transfer processes.
* reaction mechanism studies.
* flow chemistry.

The successful candidate should demonstrate the ability to conduct independent research and publish scientific results in international peer-reviewed journals.
Doctoral Researcher
Applicants must hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in chemistry or a closely related discipline that qualifies them for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki.
Previous experience in organic synthesis, photochemistry, catalysis or related experimental chemistry is advantageous but not required.
Selected candidates for the interview process will be required to provide a copy of their university transcript before interview date.
For both positions
We are looking for candidates who are:
* highly motivated and scientifically curious.
* willing to develop new experimental skills.
* persistent and independent in tackling challenging research questions.

Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.
Salary and benefits
The salary follows the salary system of University salary system and is based on the researcher's qualifications, experience, and stage of doctoral or postdoctoral career.
For postdoctoral researchers, the starting salary will be approximately 3900–4200 €/month.
For doctoral researcher the starting salary will be approximately 2600–2800 €/month.
University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
A diverse and equitable study and work culture is important to the University of Helsinki. That is why we do our best to promote an inclusive university community. We encourage all qualified applicants from different gender identities, linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and minorities to apply for the position. You can read about the accessibility and inclusivity of our university via this link.
How to apply
Applications should include:
* Curriculum vitae, including a publication list (if applicable).
* A concise motivation letter describing your research interests, relevant experience, reasons for applying and career plans. Please indicate your desired starting date in the application.
* Degree certificate (PhD for postdoctoral applicants; Master's degree for doctoral researcher applicants).

If you are interviewed, you will be asked for contact details for two references.
The deadline for applications is October 16th, 2026.
Ideally, the selected candidate will start as soon as possible, although flexibility in the starting date can be arranged. Regardless, candidates who are unable to start immediately are still encouraged to apply. The selected applicants will be given support to apply for available grants or fellowships.
Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until a suitable candidate is found. Interviews may start before closing date 16.10.2026.
Additional information
Further information about the position can be obtained from Dr. Antti Lahdenperä, antti.sk.lahdenpera@helsinki.fi.

jobs.title: Tilkaldevikar søges til Opholdsstedet SAFE
jobs.description:
Opholdsstedet SAFE søger engagerede og fagligt kompetente tilkaldevikarer til arbejdet med børn og unge i alderen 9–17 år.

SAFE er et privat børn- og ungehjem, hvor vi tilbyder en tryg, struktureret og udviklingsstøttende hverdag for børn og unge, som blandt andet kan have erfaringer med omsorgssvigt, traumer, skolevægring, social kontrol, relationsvanskeligheder eller andre belastende livsomstændigheder.

Vores mål er at skabe stabile og forudsigelige rammer, hvor børnene og de unge mødes med respekt, nærvær og tydelighed, og hvor deres ressourcer, udviklingsmuligheder og individuelle behov er i centrum.

Vi arbejder ud fra et fælles fagligt fundament med blandt andet mentalisering, anerkendende relationsarbejde, LØFT og ADL. I hverdagen arbejder vi målrettet med relationer, struktur, skolegang, fritid, selvstændighed, følelsesmæssig udvikling og sociale kompetencer.

Vores børn og unge er som udgangspunkt ikke kendetegnet ved udadreagerende adfærd, men flere har behov for voksne, som kan være rolige, stabile og vedholdende i relationen. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan være en tydelig og omsorgsfuld voksen, som kan skabe tryghed uden at presse, og som kan bevare overblik i forskellige situationer.

Om arbejdet

Som tilkaldevikar bliver du en del af den daglige pædagogiske indsats og vil blandt andet skulle:

  • skabe trygge og stabile relationer til børnene og de unge

  • støtte den enkelte i hverdagsstruktur, skole, fritid og sociale relationer

  • arbejde målrettet med individuelle mål og delmål

  • deltage i aktiviteter, måltider og praktiske opgaver i huset

  • støtte børnene og de unge i ADL og udvikling af selvstændighed

  • arbejde mentaliserende og anerkendende i kontakten

  • dokumentere fagligt og præcist i vores journalsystem

  • samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse

  • følge husets faglige procedurer og pædagogiske retningslinjer.

Arbejdstiden kan ligge på både hverdage, aftener, nætter, weekender og helligdage. Der kan forekomme længere vagter afhængigt af husets behov.

Hvem søger vi?

Det er vigtigt for os, at du har en relevant faglig baggrund. Vi søger derfor primært dig, som er uddannet eller under uddannelse inden for det pædagogiske eller socialfaglige område, eksempelvis som:

  • pædagog

  • pædagogisk assistent

  • socialrådgiver

  • anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelse.

Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du har erfaring med eller kendskab til børn og unge, som har været udsat for omsorgssvigt, traumer eller andre sociale belastninger.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • kan arbejde relationsorienteret og professionelt

  • har ro, tålmodighed og tydelighed

  • kan arbejde struktureret og ansvarligt

  • kan følge aftaler, handleplaner og procedurer

  • kan indgå i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde

  • kan dokumentere fagligt og reflekteret

  • er fleksibel i forhold til vagter.

Introduktion og SAFE Akademiet

Som ny medarbejder eller vikar bliver du tilbudt et struktureret introduktions- og kompetenceforløb gennem vores eget SAFE Akademi.

SAFE Akademiet består af 8 faglige moduler, som skal sikre, at alle medarbejdere arbejder ud fra et fælles fagligt grundlag og har kendskab til vores målgruppe, metoder, dokumentationskrav og arbejdsgange.

Inden din første introduktionsvagt skal du have gennemført og bestået de første to moduler. Herefter starter du med introduktions- og følgevagter, hvor du bliver introduceret til huset, børnene og de unge samt vores daglige pædagogiske praksis.

De resterende moduler skal gennemføres inden for en fastsat tidsfrist efter ansættelsen.

Den tid, du bruger på at gennemføre SAFE Akademiet, er betalt arbejdstid.

Vi tilbyder

Hos SAFE får du:

  • et meningsfuldt arbejde med børn og unge

  • en grundig introduktion til målgruppen og huset

  • kompetenceudvikling gennem SAFE Akademiet

  • betalt tid til gennemførelse af de faglige moduler

  • mulighed for løbende vagter

  • et fagligt miljø med fokus på udvikling, refleksion og samarbejde

  • mulighed for at gøre en konkret forskel i børn og unges hverdag.

Ansættelsesproces

Vi indkalder løbende relevante kandidater til samtale, og stillingerne besættes, når vi har fundet de rette profiler.

Som led i ansættelsesprocessen indhenter Opholdsstedet SAFE straffeattest og børneattest for alle medarbejdere, inden ansættelsen kan gennemføres.

Send gerne dit CV og en kort motiveret ansøgning, hvor du beskriver din uddannelsesbaggrund, relevante erfaring og motivation for at arbejde med vores målgruppe.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an experienced Go-To-Market (GTM) Recruiter in Tokyo to partner closely with our Japan leadership team to attract, engage, and close top talent from an array of backgrounds. In this role, you’ll help build our Japan organization in a high-ownership, high-growth environment. We will look to you to advise and consult with hiring managers and interviewers, proactively source and engage future Notinos, and design a rigorous hiring processes while ensuring a delightful candidate experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the Japan recruiting process for GTM roles, primarily for Solutions Consultants (direct sales) and other GTM roles.

 - Operate autonomously across the end-to-end cycle, from direct sourcing and screening through close, while ensuring a thoughtful candidate experience at every step.

 - Run role kick-off meetings, define profiles, and align interview plans and scorecards to drive consistent, high-quality decisions.

 - Utilize internal hiring metrics and external market data to proactively propose recommendations and solutions to leaders.

 - Drive our diversity and inclusion strategy forward, with a heavy emphasis on sourcing and maintaining a well-balanced and diverse top-of-funnel candidate slate.

 - Build and nurture future talent pipelines for priority Japan GTM roles.

 - Establish trusted partnerships with the Japan leadership team to ensure Notion hires the right talent at the right time to achieve the company’s ambitious goals.

 - Ensure scalable, structured hiring plans for all roles with a strong sense of urgency and agency, while building repeatable processes and creative solutions that help the recruiting team scale for years to come.

 - Inspire candidates throughout all stages of the interview process, and build a customized close for each candidate.

 - Collaborate closely with peers and cross-functional partners, including Recruiting Coordinators, HRBPs/People Partners, Compensation Partners, Recruiting Operations, Executive Operations Partners, and Revenue Operations.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You have at least 5 years of recruiting experience, preferably in a high-growth, in-house environment. Agency background is also welcome if you have full-cycle IT/SaaS sales hiring experience.

 - You have a track record of directly sourcing, qualifying, and closing exceptional GTM talent (e.g. Sales, Customer Success, Pre-Sales, Professional Services) based in Tokyo.

 - You can partner with, manage, and influence leadership stakeholders effectively. You have coached and guided hiring managers and interviewers through the full recruiting process.

 - You have built diverse candidate pipelines and helped hiring managers build inclusive teams.

 - You have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills in both English and Japanese (written and spoken fluency in both are required.)

 - You have a relentless focus on delivering a high-touch, high-quality recruiting experience, while respecting candidates’ and hiring managers’ time.

 - You can multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.

 - You’re a team player with an optimistic attitude, and you’re comfortable wearing many hats in a smaller organization.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have owned the end-to-end hiring process at global SaaS companies.

 - You have managed roles and candidates across regions outside of Japan.

 - You’re a Notion power user!




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Työtä tarjotaan vaihtelevasti 8 h/vko päivittäisiin toimiin ja 30 h/kk vapaa-aikaan. Työtunnit jaetaan toisen avustajan kanssa sopimuksen mukaan. Työvuorot suunnitellaan työsuhteessa.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, ruuan laittoa ja ulkoilussa avustamista. Lisäksi työnantaja tarvitsee apua hiusten pesussa ja laittamisessa. Tarvittaessa asioinnissa ja vapaa-ajan toiminnassa avustamista. Työn luonteen vuoksi toivotaan naisavustajaa.

Palkkaus: Heta TES A 13,23 €/h + mahdolliset kokemuslisät

Työsuhteet ovat aina yksityisiä. Työsuhteeseen valittu henkilö on työsuhteessa avustettavaan/avustettavan edunvalvojaan.

Haastatteluun / työsuhteeseen valitulle tieto ilmoitetaan henkilökohtaisesti.

Työntekijän toivotaan olevan oma-aloitteinen, itseohjautuva, positiivinen ja joustava työaikataulujen suhteen. Tärkeintä on, että työnantajan ja avustajan yhteistyö sujuu.

Työ alkaa sopivan avustajan löydyttyä.

Työnantajalla on oikeus pyytää iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työhön valitulta työntekijältä rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi kerran työsuhteen alkaessa (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

Rikosrekisteriote on salassa pidettävää tietoa ja sitä ei tule lähettää hakemuksen yhteydessä.

Hae työpaikkaa lähettämällä hakemuksesi osoitteeseen havu.keskus@hyvaks.fi. Liitä hakemukseesi tämän työpaikkailmoituksen oma viitetieto. Välitämme hakemuksesi työnantajalle.

jobs.title: Telecom Core Network Expert (PS Core / CS Core)
jobs.description:
This is a temporary, project-based assignment supporting a leading telecom consultancy in a mobile core network performance audit. The role is ideal for an experienced consultant, freelancer, or senior telecom professional looking for an interesting short-term engagement with high-impact work.

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

About the Assignment

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

The project is expected to start during October and run for approximately two months. The work can be performed primarily remotely, with potential limited travel if required.

We are open to finding:

- One expert with both PS Core and CS Core expertise,
- or Two specialists covering the respective domains separately.

Responsibilities

Depending on your area of expertise, your work may include:

PS Core Network Audit

- Auditing GPRS/EPC core network architecture and performance Analyzing SGSN, MME, GGSN, SGW and PGW performance
- Assessing interfaces, capacity, redundancy and security
- Evaluating DNS and IP backbone implementations
- Reviewing legacy and cloud-native core deployments
- Investigating alarms, faults, logs and performance KPIs
- Analyzing user mobility and session management performance

CS Core Network Audit

- Auditing Circuit Switched Core architecture and topology
- Assessing MSC, MGW, HLR, HSS and related core elements
- Reviewing traffic routing principles and signalling performance
- Analyzing capacity, utilization and service quality KPIs
- Evaluating virtualized and legacy core implementation
- Supporting fault analysis and network optimization recommendations

You will work closely with experienced audit professionals while providing expert guidance throughout the analysis and reporting phases.

What We Are Looking For

We expect you to have:

Extensive experience with (#Ericsson) mobile core networks (2G/3G/4G/5G environments)

- Strong expertise in either PS Core, CS Core, or both
- Knowledge of both legacy and virtualized/cloud-based core network architectures
- Proven ability to identify network issues, bottlenecks and performance challenges
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
- Previous experience in telecom consulting, auditing, or operator network assessments
- Ability to work independently and provide actionable recommendations
- Professional-level English communication skills
Experience working directly with mobile operators is considered a strong advantage.

What We Offer

- Flexible remote working model
- Collaboration with leading telecom experts
- An interesting, specialist-level project assignment
- Possibility to participate in similar future assignments based on project needs and performance
Interested?

Submit your CV and wanted information to our candidate database as soon as possible. We review candidates continuously and aim to identify suitable specialists quickly.

More information arja.martikainen@barona.fi

jobs.title: Anæstesisygeplejerske til elektiv kirurgi – primært i dagtimerne
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge din anæstesifaglighed i et elektivt hospital med korte patientforløb, tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og primært arbejde i dagtimerne?

Capio Privathospital Odense søger en anæstesisygeplejerske til en fast stilling på 28–32 timer om ugen.

 

En arbejdsdag med anæstesi og opvågning

Du bliver en del af vores anæstesiteam og arbejder cirka 75 % med anæstesi og 25 % i opvågningen. Vi varetager elektiv kirurgi inden for blandt andet ortopædkirurgi, rygkirurgi og mave-tarmkirurgi.

Arbejdet ligger mandag til fredag, primært i dagtimerne og med enkelte vagter frem til kl. 20.00.

Hos os arbejder læger, sygeplejersker og øvrige faggrupper tæt sammen om sikre, effektive og trygge patientforløb. Vi er et mindre hospital med korte beslutningsveje, hvor der er mulighed for at få indflydelse på både hverdagen og den fortsatte udvikling af området.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på 28–32 timer om ugen

  • Primært arbejde i dagtimerne på hverdage

  • Cirka 75 % anæstesi og 25 % opvågning

  • Elektive og veltilrettelagte patientforløb

  • Et fagligt stærkt og tværfagligt miljø

  • Grundig introduktion til hospitalet og vores arbejdsgange

  • Synlig ledelse og korte beslutningsveje

  • Løn efter DSR-overenskomst samt sundhedsforsikring

  • Personaleparkering under hospitalet

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er uddannet anæstesisygeplejerske

  • Arbejder fagligt sikkert og selvstændigt

  • Trives med både anæstesi og opgaver i opvågningen

  • Bidrager til et godt samarbejde og hjælper, når dagens program kræver fleksibilitet

  • Møder patienter og kolleger med respekt, ro og hjælpsomhed

  • Har lyst til at bidrage til udviklingen af vores faglige praksis

Er du forholdsvis ny i specialet, hører vi også gerne fra dig. Det vigtigste er, at du har et sikkert fagligt fundament og lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Om Capio Odense

Capio Privathospital Odense er et elektivt hospital med fokus på patientsikkerhed, høj faglig kvalitet og gode patientoplevelser.

Vi arbejder ud fra værdierne ansvar, respekt, hjælpsomhed og fleksibilitet. For os handler en god kultur om, hvordan vi samarbejder i hverdagen og løser opgaven sammen omkring patienten.

Har du lyst til at høre mere?

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning. Send dit CV og nogle få ord om, hvorfor stillingen interesserer dig.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

Ved ansættelse indhenter vi børneattest og straffeattest.

jobs.title: Vi søger Servicemedarbejder til rengøring i Helsingør
jobs.description:
Ansøgningsfrist: 23. oktober 2026

 

Er du serviceminded, ansvarsbevidst og kan du lide at arbejde selvstændigt? Vi søger lige nu servicemedarbejder til rengøring hos to af vores kunder i Helsingør.

 

Som vores nye kollega vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver være kontorrengøring og øvrige faciliteter. Erfaring med rengøring er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har en positiv indstilling, er omhyggelig og ønsker at levere en god service.

Din oplæring vil bestå af sidemandsoplæring, hvor du grundigt bliver introduceret til arbejdsopgaverne og de enkelte lokationer. Efter oplæringsperioden vil du arbejde selvstændigt med ansvar for dine daglige opgaver.

 

Arbejdstider

På den ene lokation udføres rengøringen uden for kundens normale arbejdstid. Arbejdet skal derfor enten være afsluttet inden kl. 08.00 eller påbegyndes efter kl. 16.00.

  • 4,75 timer ugentligt

  • Fleksibel arbejdstid inden for de angivne rammer

Den anden lokation er døgnåben, og rengøringen kan udføres på det tidspunkt, der passer bedst. Der er afsat 30 minutter dagligt, svarende til 2,5 timer ugentligt.

For at kunne arbejde på lokationen er det et krav, at du gennemfører kurset "Pas på banen". Kurset kan gennemføres på én dag og kræver, at du kan forstå dansk eller engelsk.

Kurset består af:

  • En online del på cirka 1 time

  • En fysisk undervisningsdag hos Banedanmark i Ringsted

 

Skab værdi med din service

Vi ønsker at levere den bedste service til vores kunder. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er imødekommende, ansvarsfuld og fokuseret på kvalitet i dit arbejde.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med rengøring, gerne kontorrengøring, men det er ikke et krav

  • Er serviceminded, hjælpsom og positiv

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for egne opgaver

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorienteret

  • Har sans for detaljen og leverer et højt kvalitetsniveau

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Er villig til at gennemføre "Pas på banen"-kurset

 

Vi tilbyder

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til opgaverne

  • Selvstændigt arbejde med fleksible arbejdstider

  • Arbejdstøj og nødvendige arbejdsredskaber

  • Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og god service

 

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og eventuelt en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt via linket "Ansøg nu" senest d. 23. oktober 2026. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Service Manager Nedzhati Nizamiev Hasanov på mail: nedzhati.hasanov@dk.issworld.com 

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Faglært/ufaglært smed/maskinoperatør til kørsel med transportsneglemaskine
jobs.description:
Faglært/ufaglært smed/maskinoperatør søges til opstilling og kørsel med transportsneglemaskine.
Der findes kun én maskine til dette formål i Nordeuropa og du skal lære at betjene, opstille og fremstille sneglespiraler til vores egen produktion og salg.

Du vil blive oplært af folk med flere års erfaring og undervejs lære at svejse, bruge skærebrænder, vinkelsliber og flere andre smedemæssige opgaver. Det tager ca. 1-2 år at bliver rigtig dygtigt til at betjene maskinen og der vil være meget manuelt smede- og opstilling og vedligeholdelses arbejde, hvor du bliver sort på hænderne.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har tålmodighed og gåpåmod også selvom arbejdet driller og ikke lykkedes første gang. (Vigtigt!)

  • Du er ansvarsbevidst, struktureret og har en positiv indstilling til teamwork.

  • Du er klar på at arbejde i et lille sammensluttet team med erfarne og gode kollegaer, hvor der er mulighed for at få råd, hjælp og vejledning i forhold til dine opgaver og udarbejdelse af transportsnegle.

  • Arbejdet kan til tider kræve god fysik.

  • Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Mulighed for at lære en helt speciel niché inden for smedefaget som kun få i verden er gode til.

  • Mulighed for gode lønvilkår som ufaglært.

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med fast arbejdstid.

  • Løn der matcher dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

  • En arbejdsplads, der vægter samarbejde og godt kollegaskab højt.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og specialisering inden for transportsnegle.

  • Mulighed for at deltage i spændende fremtidige projekter og udvikling af maskiner inden for udarbejdelse af snegle.

Arbejdstider:
Mandag til onsdag kl. 7.00-15.30, torsdag 7.00-14.45, fredag 07.00-14.30

Om Arni Maskinfabrik.

Lille familievirksomhed med 8 ansatte placeret ved Eskilstrup på Falster. 
Vores speciale er Transportsnegle, udarbejdelse af sneglevindinger og profilvalsning.
Besøg gerne vores hjemmeside eller Facebook for at se eksempler på vores projekter.
https://arni.dk/
https://www.facebook.com/ArniMaskinfabrik

Virksomheden fyldte 90 år i 2025 og gennemgår i disse år en opdatering hvad angår lokaler og maskiner.

Ansøgning:
Send ansøgning og CV til Søren Lund på e-mail: sl@arni.dk
Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter når den vi finder den rette.

Med venlig hilsen
Arni Maskinfabrik

4863 Eskilstrup

Tlf.: 54436312

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Model Capabilities
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has been at the cutting edge of AI since before ChatGPT launched. The job of the Model Capabilities team is to keep us there. We own the model layer of Notion AI: integrating frontier models as they ship, keeping inference reliable and economical at scale, and building new capabilities that other teams take advantage of.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Bring new frontier models into production quickly, making them available for our users and our engineers.

 - Make inference reliable: better error categorization, self-healing retries, and cross-provider failover.

 - Own observability for the model layer, driving down both time to detection and time to fix.

 - Build new model-level capabilities and help product teams adopt them.

 - Act as connective tissue across Notion's AI teams: find the gaps, unblock people, and make sure fixes land with the right owner.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Comfort with a moving frontier: The model landscape changes monthly. You keep up with it, form your own view of what's real, and stay pragmatic about what's worth adopting now.

 - AI fluency as a practitioner: You use AI tools seriously in your own work and have opinions about where they help and where they don't.

 - Production AI systems experience: You've built and operated systems on top of LLM APIs, not just prototyped with them. You understand token economics, streaming, tool calling, context limits, and how each of these fails in production.

 - Measurement before conviction: You don't ship a prompt or model change on vibes. You define what "better" means, build or use the evaluation to test it, and are willing to be proven wrong by your own data.

 - Cost and performance instincts: You treat latency and dollars as product qualities, not afterthoughts, and you can reason about the tradeoff between them and output quality.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $255,000 – $300,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Partner & Client Services Senior Officer - Swedish Market
Customer Operations - Findel, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

About Utmost International

Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

About Utmost Luxembourg S.A.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role - Are you ready for a challenge?

The Senior Account Officer - Swedish and Norwegian Market is responsible for assisting in the timely and effective day to day processing of servicing activities for Swedish and Norwegian policies. Ensuring that all work items are processed in accordance with compliance obligations and within agreed service standards.
The Account Officer may help the team to support additional/exceptional workload.
The ideal candidate will be flexible in handling daily operations related to servicing existing clients and policyholders along with custodian account processing requirements.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

The Senior Account Officer - Swedish and Norwegian Market is accountable for:
• Providing daily support to Partners, Clients and Sales colleagues;
• Handling daily workload in an accurate and timely manner meeting, exceeding where possible the Service Standards;
• Accurate and timely processing of policy transactions, servicing and query resolution during the life cycle of a policy, including document management;
• Proactively following up and monitor all transactions and queries received from both internal and external parties;
• Managing risk within your area of responsibility including adherence to Corporate Policy on Compliance and Risk;
• Respecting the planning established by your line manager in relation to business activities;
• Following instructions and process information accurately and in a timely manner;
• Prioritising multiple tasks while remaining calm and positive under pressure;
• Maintaining an on-going awareness of service, propose suggested improvement to your line manager and ensure quality improvements are made, as agreed.

Your profile - Have you got what it takes to become our Senior Account Officer?

• Experience of working within the Financial Sector with a minimum of 4 years' experience, ideally within Private Banking or with Independent Financial Advisors;
• You enjoy working in a challenging, fast paced environment and look for the opportunity to excel in all aspects of your role;
• Take personal pride in delivering high quality service to internal and external clients;
• Good communication skills: being able to build effective relationships and adapt communication style to the counterpart, always in a professional manner;
• Ability to listen to other opinions as well as being confident of your own and find balanced solutions;
• Be able and willing to look beyond the obvious and seek alternative solutions;
• Ability to work independently while keen to work as part of a team and assist colleagues;
• Willing to make the extra effort as required;
• Knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering regulations;
• Native-level Swedish speaker and fluency in English is a must, any other European language is an asset, particularly Norwegian.

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

• Studies or initial experience in a combination of risk management, information security, and IT roles;
• At least 4-5 years of experience in Information Security or IT Security;
• Technical background in the field of security technologies and architectures;
• Knowledge of technological trends and developments in the area of IT and Information Security;
• Good communicator, ownership, problem-solving, solution oriented, service oriented, ability to adapt to a fast-paced environment, team work;
• Understanding of risk assessment and audit processes and techniques, specifically within the domain of financial information security;
• Basic knowledge of network and application security, as well as authentication, identity management and penetration testing technologies;
• Experience with DLP, NAC, SIEM, PAM and intrusion detection software;
• Understanding of advanced security protocols and standards;
• Understanding of software and security architectures and principles of secure network design;
• Have good understanding of anti-virus software, firewalls and similar products;
• Knowledge of generic software development lifecycle processes;
• Fluent English is a must. Any other European language would be considered as an asset.
• Professional certification, such as a CISSP, CISM, CISA or other information security credentials, is an asset;
• Working knowledge of security and control frameworks, such as ISO 27001, CobiT, COSO and ITIL.

jobs.title: Group General Counsel - International Company (m/f)
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Group General Counsel

Reporting line: Chief Executive Officer, with dotted reporting line to the Board.
Contract: permanent, full-time (40 hours per week). Location: Luxembourg, hybrid, with regular international travel.

1 The business and the role

The company operates an international online subscription and creator platform, with exposure to adult content, and which operates across the United Kingdom, the European Union and the US. The Group General Counsel is the most senior legal officer of the group.

2 Main responsibilities

1. Legal function leadership and Board support

• Build, staff and lead the group legal function, including recruitment, budget, external counsel panel and legal operations.
• Act as principal legal adviser to the Board, the founders and the executive team, and attend Board and committee meetings.
• Set and own the group's legal risk appetite, escalation framework and legal reporting to the Board and to investors.
• Manage disputes and litigation across jurisdictions, including instruction and supervision of external counsel.

2. Corporate, M&A and governance

• Lead corporate and M&A transactions end to end, including target assessment, due diligence, transaction documentation, signing, closing and PMI.
• Support fundraising rounds, investor documentation, shareholder arrangements and cap table matters.
• Own corporate governance across a multi-jurisdictional holding structure, including entity management, board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filings, registers of beneficial owners, delegated authority frameworks and group policies.
• Act as secretary to the Board and to group entity boards, or supervise that function.
• Coordinate with finance and tax on group structuring, intragroup agreements, transfer pricing documentation and substance requirements.

3. Data protection, artificial intelligence and digital regulation

• Own the group's data protection compliance programme under the EU GDPR and the UK GDPR, including records of processing, transfer mechanisms, data protection impact assessments, data subject rights, breach response and supervisory authority engagement.
• Advise on US privacy legislation applicable to the group's user base, including state level comprehensive privacy laws and applicable wiretapping and tracking technology claims.
• Own the group's artificial intelligence governance framework, including the classification of AI systems, transparency obligations for synthetic and AI generated content, model and vendor due diligence, training data and intellectual property questions, and readiness for the EU AI Act.
• Advise on the EU Digital Services Act and the UK Online Safety Act, including notice and action mechanisms, trusted flaggers, transparency reporting, risk assessment obligations, illegal content duties and children's access assessments.
• Advise on the EU Digital Markets Act, the audiovisual media services framework and platform to business regulation as applicable to the group's distribution channels.

4. High risk industry, trust and safety, and content compliance

• Advise on the legal and regulatory framework applicable to adult oriented and creator monetization platforms, including age assurance and identity verification, performer consent and record keeping obligations, nonconsensual intimate image takedown, CSAM prevention and reporting, and content moderation and appeals.
• Design and maintain creator terms, model releases, content licences, revenue share arrangements and agency and management arrangements.
• Advise on advertising, affiliate and performance marketing arrangements, influencer marketing rules and consumer protection requirements in the EU, the UK and the US.
• Manage intellectual property, including trademarks, copyright enforcement and anti-piracy programmes.

5. Payments, financial crime and sanctions

• Own the legal side of the group's payments stack, including acquirer and payment service provider agreements, alternative payment methods, payout and creator disbursement arrangements and merchant of record structures.
• Advise on card scheme rules as they apply to high risk and adult merchant categories, including high brand risk and integrity risk registration programmes, prohibited content rules, chargeback thresholds and remediation plans.
• Advise on PSD2 and strong customer authentication, electronic money and payment institution perimeter questions, and the implications of the EU instant payments and payment services reform.
• Own the group's KYC, AML, CTF and sanctions framework, including creator onboarding, transaction monitoring, and screening against EU, UK, US OFAC and other relevant measures.

6. Commercial and employment

• Negotiate the group's material commercial agreements, including technology, content, distribution, partnership and vendor agreements.
• Support the people function on employment law across multiple jurisdictions, including contracts, contractor classification, incentive schemes and internal investigations.

3 Required profile

The following are requirements (must-haves):

• Law degree from an EU or EEA or UK university.
• Admission in good standing to the bar of an EU or EEA Member State or UK.
• A minimum of 20 years of PQE legal experience, of which at least 10 years in a senior in house legal leadership role (General Counsel, Head of Legal or equivalent).
• Demonstrable experience of building and leading an international in house legal team across diverse jurisdictions.
• A track record of leading cross border M&A transactions in the US, UK and/or EU jurisdictions.
• Corporate governance experience in complex international structures.
• Recognised privacy certification (IAPP CIPP/E or equivalent) and hands on ownership of a GDPR compliance programme.
• Direct working knowledge of the EU/UK digital regulatory framework, including DSA, DMA, OSA, the AI Act, AVMS.
• Substantive experience in high risk regulated industries, and specifically in adult entertainment or creator platform compliance.
• Substantive experience of payment processing and billing for high-risk merchant categories.
• Experience in entertainment and media.
• Tax, KYC/AML and sanctions experience in a regulated or high risk environment.
• Experience advising founders, C level executives and Boards in a venture backed, high growth environment.
• English at level C (native/bilingual/proficient user).

The following are advantages (nice to haves):

• Postgraduate business qualification (MBA or equivalent).
• Formal training or certification in AI
• Recognised corporate governance certification (e.g. ILA CGO).
• Qualification or formal training in international taxation and in corporate compliance.
• Experience of a Luxembourg holding structure and of Luxembourg corporate and employment law.
• Additional languages, in particular Spanish, French, Portuguese, German or Luxembourgish.
• Prior experience in a matrix organisation or in the country or regional unit of a multinational group.

4 Personal attributes

• Commercial and pragmatic. Comfortable taking a risk-based position and defending it to the Board.
• Comfortable operating hands on in a lean team while also delegating and developing others.
• Able to work across cultures and time zones, and to hold credibility with founders, investors, regulators and counterparties.
• Willing to work in a business whose content categories include adult material.

5 Terms

• Contract: permanent (contrat à durée indéterminée), governed by Luxembourg law.
• Working time: full time, 40 hours per week, flexible arrangement.
• Place of work: [LuxCo address], Luxembourg, with hybrid working and regular travel, principally to London.
• Remuneration: gross annual salary between EUR 150,000 and EUR 250,000.
• Start date: as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Tech Lead - Digital Transformation Factory Vie

Location Leudelange
Experience Level Professionnels
Home Office Oui

Votre job en bref

Au sein de la Digital Transformation Factory Vie, vous portez la vision technique des solutions digitales du domaine Vie et accompagnez l'équipe dans la conception, le développement et l'exploitation de solutions robustes, sécurisées, simples et maintenables.
En tant que point de référence technique, vous veillez à la cohérence des choix réalisés avec les besoins métier, l'écosystème IT, les standards de l'entreprise et les principes d'architecture. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, les Business Analysts, le Product Owner, les architectes et les équipes d'exploitation, tout en conservant une dimension opérationnelle avec environ 50 % de votre activité consacrée au développement, selon les priorités de l'équipe.

Ce qui vous attend

Type de contrat : CDI
Type d'emploi : temps plein

• Vision et architecture : définir les orientations techniques locales en cohérence avec l'architecture d'entreprise et les architectes solution, promouvoir des solutions simples et maintenables, et garantir la cohérence entre les frontends Angular, les services REST backend .NET, les microservices de support et les échanges Kafka.
• Analyser en amont les impacts, dépendances et risques techniques, documenter les décisions structurantes et contribuer à la roadmap technique.
• Consulter les architectes et débattre avec eux de toute décision ayant un impact sur plusieurs applications ou équipes.
• Qualité logicielle : garantir la qualité des développements, la conformité aux standards techniques et la maîtrise de la dette technique ; intégrer les risques techniques et accompagner leur résolution.
• Réaliser des revues de code, prototypes et preuves de concept, intervenir sur les développements structurants ou complexes, veiller au respect des quality gates SonarCloud et promouvoir les tests automatisés.
• Accompagnement de l'équipe : faire progresser les membres sur les pratiques de développement et DevOps, contribuer au recrutement et à la montée en compétence, accompagner les choix de conception et d'implémentation, faciliter les décisions collectives et arbitrer lorsque nécessaire.
• Industrialisation : assurer une veille technologique, maintenir et améliorer les pipelines d'intégration continue dans Azure DevOps Services et collaborer sur les processus de déploiement continu gérés dans Jenkins.
• Garantir un niveau d'observabilité adapté grâce aux logs, métriques, tableaux de bord et alertes, et participer aux mises en production nécessitant l'intervention de l'équipe technique.

Ce que nous attendons

• Diplôme supérieur en informatique ou en ingénierie logicielle.
• Expérience significative en développement logiciel dans l'écosystème .NET et avec Angular, ainsi que dans un rôle de point de référence ou de leadership technique incluant l'accompagnement de développeurs.
• Très bonne maîtrise de C#, de .NET et de son écosystème, notamment EF Core et SQL Server, idéalement sur une version récente telle que .NET 10.
• Très bonne maîtrise d'Angular et de TypeScript.
• Bonne connaissance de Git, des revues de code et des stratégies de gestion des branches, notamment Gitflow.
• Expérience dans la conception d'API, de microservices, d'architectures distribuées et de solutions de messaging avec Kafka.
• Maîtrise des enjeux de performance, de scalabilité, de résilience applicative, de sécurité et d'observabilité.
• Expérience d'Azure DevOps Services pour l'intégration continue et connaissance de Jenkins pour le déploiement.
• Leadership technique, pragmatisme, autonomie, écoute et esprit d'équipe ; capacité à communiquer, coacher, décider et gérer plusieurs priorités sans posture autoritaire.
• Français et anglais courants ; l'allemand et le luxembourgeois constituent des atouts.
• Une expérience dans les secteurs financier, assurantiel ou de la gestion de patrimoine constitue un atout.

À propos de Baloise

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Outre nos activités financières classiques, nous cherchons à innover et à créer des liens générateurs de valeur avec des partenariats et des start-ups. Nous considérons l'ère numérique comme une opportunité et aspirons à ce que notre offre de demain soit encore plus durable, plus innovante et plus orientée client. Vous voulez y participer ?

Nous vous donnons la liberté de poursuivre vos idées... Investissez-vous ! Remettez-nous en question ! Continuez à évoluer et à nous faire évoluer !  Tout ceci est possible grâce à notre culture de l'apprentissage et de l'erreur ainsi qu'à une communication d'égal à égal. Parce que ce n'est qu'ensemble que nous pourrons aller de l'avant.

  • koordinacija potrebnih aktivnosti kako bi se osiguralo nesmetano i pravovremeno odvijanje projekata

Razmatrane će biti samo pravovremene i potpune prijave (životopis i dokazi o ispunjenju uvjeta) pristigle pristigle na naznačenu e-adresu.
