jobs.title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals
jobs.description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor / Associate Professor, and Curator of Mammals at Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark wishes to appoint a Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals (mammalia) with a great vision for natural history museums in a changing world. Duties are divided equally between collection-based research and other museum duties including curation of the mammal collections, research-based teaching and supervision of students, public engagement work, and to act as the museum's liaison with relevant Danish natural history communities. The successful applicant will be expected to establish and develop an externally funded collection-based research programme/group and publish in influential journals. We particularly encourage applications from applicants with a collection-based research specialization on mammalogy. The successful applicant will be expected to curate the museum’s historically important mammal collections (56.000 specimens) requiring a thorough understanding and practical knowledge of mammal classification. We value collaboration across disciplines and professions. All applicants are expected to demonstrate interdisciplinary thinking and a commitment to working together to create solutions to global challenges. This also goes for collection work. Curators develop the collections that they are responsible for through research, field work, loan activities, digitization, acting as scientific host for visiting researchers, and increasing accessibility for everyone. This curatorial position in Mammalogy at the Natural History Museum Denmark will be filled at either the Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level. All curators at the Natural History Museum Denmark are expected to take a leading role in society as advocates for science and nature, creating impact at all levels while actively promoting the museum’s Vision and Values (https://snm.dk/en/about-museum). Further details of qualifications required for appointment at the museum are detailed below.

The position is available starting March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Qualifications
Tenure-track assistant professor
Applicants at the tenure track assistant professor level are expected to have an academic record demonstrating the potential to deliver high profile internationally competitive research in the area of specialization. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have experience with collection-based research. Previous experience curating natural history collections and university teaching experience would be advantageous but is not a requirement at the time of hiring for tenure-track assistant professors. Documented interest in and experience with public engagement and community-based activities is expected. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar institution is an advantage.

Associate professor
Applicants at the associate professor level are expected to have a strong publication record in high-level, international, peer-reviewed venues in the area of specialization and a track record of successful external research funding. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have significant experience with collection-based research. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar is expected. Curatorial expertise and considerable previous experience and impact with curating and developing natural history collections is required at associate professor level. Broad experience and a compelling vision for public engagement and community-based activities is essential. Candidates are also required to have documented university-level competencies in delivering high-quality undergraduate/graduate teaching and must be able to explain and reflect upon their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

Assessment of applicants
Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research as well as their curatorial experience and potential to curate one or more of the museum’s collections. Teaching and public engagement qualifications and experience will be considered according to career level. The overall fit for the Natural History Museum will also be considered.
Ideal applicants will have the following qualifications:

  • An outstanding reputation for high-quality research within Mammalogy
  • A record of scientific use of museum collections and/or data
  • A proven track record of interdisciplinary research
  • Scientific expertise that ensures ability to curate Mammalia collections held by the museum
  • Curatorial experience improving and developing natural history collections
  • Experience from a natural history museum or similar
  • Participation in national and international museum collaborations through organizations and programs.
  • A vision for how digital, genomic, and other new technologies will drive advances in natural history science
  • Ability to work at a strategic level
  • A track record of public engagement and creating impact beyond academia
  • Experience working on museum exhibitions, interpretation, and/or public engagement
  • Experience in fundraising and ability to attract research funding from external sources for research, digitization and collection development.
  • Supportive and collaborative people skills and commitment to an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and respect for everyone with equality and opportunity for all
  • A passion for the vision and values of the Natural History Museum Denmark
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Confidence in ability to provide advocacy for the museum with multiple stakeholders
University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor/associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.
For tenure-track assistant professors
For associate professors

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

Information on the tenure-track programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period, tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

About the Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark is the Danish national museum for nature. We work to empower citizens to connect with nature with the aim to create positive change for people and planet. We want to inspire, engage, and enable people to enjoy, understand, and care for the diversity of the natural world. The impact of climate change and anthropogenic forces on biodiversity has reached a critical point. We firmly believe that natural history museums can and should play a key role towards a more sustainable relationship with nature. We are opening a new Danish national museum for nature in spring 2027. One big museum site, in the Botanical Garden, in the centre of Copenhagen, will host state-of-the-art laboratories, outstanding research collections, new public galleries, and combined facilities for programming, education, and citizen science. It is an ambition for the museum to enhance natural history and inspire curiosity, knowledge, and empowerment for the future. The Botanical Garden was founded in 1600, and the museum’s collections date back to Ole Worm’s Cabinet of Curiosities from around 1620. With 14 million preserved specimens and living plants of 8,000 different species in the Botanical Garden, it is the largest museum collection in Denmark. It covers our planetary history with botanical, zoological, and geological specimens from all over the world. Read more about the Mammalia collection here.

The Natural History Museum Denmark is part of the University of Copenhagen, which was founded in 1479 and is the largest university in Denmark. Read more about the museum here.
Inquiries about the position can be made to Museum Director Nina Rønsted (e-mail: nronsted@snm.ku.dk).

Affirmative action
The Natural History Museum Denmark is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or disabled status. We are actively promoting a strategy to improve the gender balance among scientific staff. Copenhagen is a highly diverse and international Scandinavian capital with a green profile. Education is free and childcare is subsidized. Public transport is well developed, and most Copenhageners take their bike to work. There are lots of green areas in and around Copenhagen, the water in the harbor is clean enough for swimming, and the city has multiple museums and other cultural venues.

Terms of employment
Employment is as tenure-track assistant professor/associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The successful applicant is expected to take Danish lessons if there is no prior knowledge of Danish language. The International Office at the University of Copenhagen can help.
This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. jobs.title: Material Coordinator
jobs.description:
Brænder du for koordinering, logistik og materialestyring? Er du struktureret, serviceminded og trives med mange kontaktflader i en dynamisk hverdag? Så er du måske vores nye Material Coordinator.

Rolle og ansvarsområder

Som Material Coordinator bliver du en vigtig del af OMC-teamet, hvor du får en central rolle i at sikre effektiv håndtering af materialer, udstyr og logistiske processer mellem offshore-installationer, varehus, indkøb, leverandører og interne interessenter.

Stillingen er på 30 timer.

Primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Håndtering og koordinering af backload-processer mellem offshore og onshore lokationer.

  • Opfølgning på leveringstider og dialog med indkøb om fremrykning af materialer.

  • Koordinering med bådtransport og varehus ved modtagelse og afsendelse af materialer.

  • Sikre hurtig returnering af lejeudstyr til leverandører.

  • Oprettelse og koordinering af serviceordrer til reparation af udstyr, herunder:

  • Assistere med lukning af Repair-ordrer for at sikre korrekt håndtering af økonomiske commitments.

  • Rådgivning og support ved spørgsmål omkring materialerouting til offshore-destinationer.

  • Sparringspartner for Unisol-teamet i forbindelse med forbedringer, fejl og optimering af SAP-processer.

  • Oprettelse af manuelle Purchase Requisitions til materialeindkøb.

  • Opfølgning på kvalitetskontrol (QC) for frigivelse af materialer i samarbejde med indkøb og leverandører.

  • Gennemføre materialegennemgang på kampagnebåde samt koordinere pick/pack-aktiviteter med planlæggere, varehus og bådpersonale.

  • Opfølgning på hasteordrer og kritiske materialebehov fra offshore.

  • Koordinering af reparationer på udstyr modtaget fra offshoreinstallationer.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af transporter via vejtransport.

 

Hvem er du?

  • Har erfaring inden for logistik, supply chain, materialestyring eller lagerfunktioner

  • Har erfaring med SAP eller tilsvarende ERP-systemer

  • Er struktureret og god til at holde overblik over mange opgaver samtidigt

  • Trives med koordinering på tværs af flere afdelinger og interessenter

  • Er løsningsorienteret og har en proaktiv tilgang til opgaver

  • Kommunikerer professionelt på dansk og engelsk, både skriftligt og mundtligt

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og god kundeservice

 

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag i et dynamisk miljø.

  • Tæt samarbejde med offshore, indkøb, lager, logistik og teknikere.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og stor indflydelse på arbejdsprocesser.

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på samarbejde, videndeling og kontinuerlige forbedringer.

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Deltidsstilling 30 timer, med 1 ugentlig fridag i rul med resten af teamet.

Om NorSea

House of Offshore Innovation er et kontorfællesskab med både nationale og internationale virksomheder fra energiindustrien. Vi udlejer kontor- og mødelokaler og deler husets ressourcer og viden med hinanden.

NorSea Denmark er en del af NorSea Group, og er ejet af Wilhelmsen. Vi opererer Danmarks største offshore supply base. Gennem vores one-stop-shop koncept servicerer vi energisektoren med totale supply chain løsninger.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, der hele tiden forsøger at udvikle os gennem innovation. Vores vigtigste aktiv er vores medarbejdere, og vi har det som vores mission at være Best Place to Work. Vi bor i vores nyrenoverede domicil, House of Offshore Innovation i Esbjerg. Hér tilbyder vi vores medarbejdere attraktive vilkår, herunder; personalerestaurant, fitnesslokale, aktiv personaleforening m.m.

NorSea Denmark is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to the maritime and offshore industry. The group operates 12 supply bases in the North Sea, and our base in Esbjerg is Denmark’s largest. We are part of the NorSea Group - a global provider of base operations and full service logistics solutions with 50 years of experience.

NorSea Group is owned by one of the world’s largest maritime industrial group, Wilhelmsen. As an experienced and reliable one-stop-shop, we at NorSea Denmark aim to set new industry standards for efficiency and safety. We deliver all types of logistics and base solutions to the offshore sector. With a deep understanding of our customers’ commercial interests and needs, we innovate safe and profitable solutions.

Interesseret?

Er du klar til at blive en vigtig del af forsyningskæden og sikre, at de rette materialer er tilgængelige på rette tid og sted? Så ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Michael Zdrinka Clausen, Warehouse Manager på michael.clausen@norseagroup.com eller +45 21946317

Ansøgningsfristen er den 9. oktober eller når den rette kandidat er fundet.

jobs.title: Specialiseret butiksmedarbejder/knivspecialist. Specialist retail assistent - Japanese as working language
jobs.description:
Arbejdssted: København Location: Copenhagen

Arbejdstid: Fuldtid 37 timer om ugen. Working hours. Full-time, 37 hours per week.

Ansættelsesform: Fastansættelse Employment: Permanent position.

Om stillingen:

Vi søger en engageret medarbejder til vores specialiserede butik med fokus på japanske kvalitetsknive og japansk knivhåndværk.

Stillingen er en kombination af salg og kundeservice, arbejde med slibning af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

Stillingen kombinerer salg og kundeservice med praktisk arbejde, slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

En væsentlig del af stillingen indebærer direkte kommunikation med japanske producenter og leverandører. Derfor er gode japanske sprogkundskaber en nødvendighed kompetence i stillingen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

Salg og rådgivning af kunder om japanske kvalitetsknive og tilbehør.

Kundeservice og vejledning om valg, brug og vedligeholdelse af knive.

Slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive, samt indgravering i hånden.

Modtagelse, kontrol og håndtering af varer.

Vare- og lagerstyring.

Kommunikation med japanske leverandører og producenter,

Håndtering af profuktinformation, ordrer, specifikationer og leverancer.

Oversættelse og videreformidling af information mellem virksomheden og japanske leverandører.

Bidrage til den daglige drift og præsentation af butikken.

Vi forventer, at du:

Taler og skriver japansk på højt niveau.

Kan kommunikere proffesionelt med vores japanske leverandører både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Har interesse for japanske knive, håndværk og kvalitet.

Har gode kundeservice- og salgsevner.

Er omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst.

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

Har interesse for eller erfaring med knivslibning.

Behersker engelsk, så du kan kommunikere med kolleger og kunder.

Erfaring med knivslibning, salg eller arbejde med japanske knive er en fordel. Erfaring med håndgravering er ligeledes en fordel. Oplæring i virksomhedens produkter og arbejdsmetoder vil blive givet efter behov.

Japansk er et nødvendigt arbejdssprog, da medarbejderne vil have løbende kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører, vedrørende blandt andet produktinformation, bestillinger, specifikationer og leverancer.

Vi tilbyder:

Fast ansættelse på 37 timer om ugen.

En alsidig stilling i en specialiseret butik.

Arbejde med japanske kvalitetsprodukter og knivhåndværk.

Direkte kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører.

Oplæring i produkter, knivtyper og slibeteknikker.

Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og god kundeservice.

Løn: Efter aftale.

Ansøgning:

Send CV og ansøgning til tess@foodgear.dk.

Fortæl gerne om din baggrund og erfaring med japansk håndværk, samt dine sprogkundskaber.

Regarding the position:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and service-minded employee to join our specialized shop, focusing on high quality Japanese knives and Japanese knife craftmanship.

The position combines sales and customer service with practical work, involving knife sharpening and maintenance, as well as ongoing communication with our Japanese suppliers and business partners.

A significant part of the postion involves direct communication with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers. Therefore, a high level of Japanese language proficiency is an essential requirement for the position.

Your responsibilities:

Selling and advising customers on Japanese high quality knives and accessories.

Providing customer service andguidance on the selection, use and maintenance of knives.

Knife sharpening, maintenance and hand engraving.

Receiving, checking and handling goods.

Stock and inventory management.

Communication with Japanese suppliers and manufacturers.

Handling product information, orders, specifications and deliveries.

Translating and communicating information between the company and Japanese business partners.

Contributing to the day-to-day operation and presentation of the shop.

We expect you to:

Speak and write Japanese at a high level.

Be able to communicate professionally with Japanese suppliers, both verbally and in writing.

Have an interest in Japanese knives, craftmanship and quality.

Have good customer service and sales skills.

Be detail oriented and quality conscious.

Be able to work independently and take responsibility.

Have an interest in or experience with knife sharpening.

Have a good command of English for communication with colleagues and customers.

Experience in sales, knife sharpening or working with Japaneseknives is an advantage. Experience with hand engraving of knives is also an advantage. Training in the companys products and working methods will be provided as required.

Japanese is an essential working language, as the employee will have regular contact with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers regarding product information, orders, specifikations, deliveries and other matters related to our Japanese products.

We offer:

A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week.

A varied position in a specialised retail shop.

The opportunity to work with high-quality Japanese products and traditional knife craftmanship.

Direct contact with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers.

Training in products, knife types and sharpening techniques.

A working environment focused on quality, expertise and excellent customer service.

Salary: Salary and employment terms according to qualifications and experience.

How to apply: Please send an email with your CV and application to tess@foodgear.dk

Please include information about your experience with Japanese products, knives, sales, customer service as well as your Japanese and English skills.

This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolysers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University, and research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
You will develop and validate digital-twin and optimization methods for electrolysis systems, working both independently and collaboratively with the group and with academic and industrial partners. In particular, you will:

  • Develop and validate physics-based, data-driven, or hybrid digital twins of Electrolysis systems, capturing their electrochemical, thermal, flow, and system-level behaviour for system monitoring, state estimation, and performance prediction.
  • Build computationally efficient models suitable for monitoring, performance prediction, optimization, and control, and evaluate their accuracy, robustness, computational efficiency, and practical applicability. They could also be implemented in real-time systems.
  • Investigate interactions across operational timescales (Multi-timescale optimization) — from short-term power, thermal, and flow management to longer-term production scheduling and energy-system operation — connecting fast system dynamics with slower operational decisions.
  • Develop optimization strategies to improve Electrolyzer performance, efficiency, flexibility, and economic operation under variable electricity supply and renewable-energy integration.
  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project activities.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies 
We expect you to have:

  • A relevant master's degree in energy engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, control engineering, or a related discipline.
  • A strong foundation in at least one of: electrochemical or energy-system modelling, dynamic modelling and control, mathematical optimization, or data-driven modelling.
  • Experience with numerical modelling, simulation, optimization, control, or engineering-data analysis.
  • Good programming skills in Python, MATLAB/Simulink, or a comparable scientific computing environment.
  • A fundamental understanding of energy-conversion systems, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, heat and mass transfer, electrochemistry, or control engineering.
  • The ability to conduct independent, systematic, and scientifically rigorous research while working effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Experience with some of the areas of electrolyzer technologies, digital twins, model order reduction, system identification, power electronics, model predictive control, multi-objective optimization, machine learning, renewable-energy integration, experimental testing, or hardware-in-the-loop implementation would be an advantage. You are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are
The PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based in Aalborg.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. How to apply

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)

  • A project description (3–5 pages) outlining your initial thoughts and ideas on the project applied for, including a brief state-of-the-art with a short list of references, a time schedule, and how you intend to address the project objectives.

jobs.title: Postdoc Position in System Optimization Using Digital Twin for Power-to-X processes
jobs.description:
Take the next step in your research career at the intersection of digital twins, multi-timescale system optimization, and integrated Power-to-X systems with special focus on the electrical engineering parts. This position offers a unique opportunity to drive the development of system-level digital-twin and optimization methodologies—integrating electrolyzer models with renewable generation, power electronic conversion, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand—to enable more efficient, flexible, and economically viable Power-to-X operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolyzers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University — research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
This two-year postdoctoral project focuses on the system-level integration and optimization of electrolyzer digital twins within CAPeX — considering how component-level electrolyzer models and digital twins can be incorporated into broader Power-to-X systems involving renewable generation, power conversion, power system integration, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand. In particular, you will:

  • Develop an integrated, system-level digital-twin framework connecting electrolyzer models with relevant Power-to-X components and energy-systema.
  • Develop system-level optimization and energy-management methods for coordinating electrolyzers with renewable generation, power conversion, storage, downstream processes, and hydrogen demand.
  • Apply and evaluate these methods under technical constraints and varying renewable generation, electricity prices, and hydrogen demand, considering system efficiency, flexibility, production, and operating costs.
  • Validate and benchmark the developed framework using project data, high-fidelity simulations including hardware in the loop, and relevant industrial case studies, assessing its robustness and computational performance.
  • Collaborate with researchers and industrial partners, contribute to the coordination and supervision of related research activities, and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project deliverables.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies
We expect you to have:

  • A PhD in electrical engineering, energy engineering, mechanical engineering, control engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience in energy-system modelling, mathematical optimization, control, digital twins, or related areas.
  • Strong programming and numerical modelling skills using Python, MATLAB/Simulink, Julia, hardware in the loop implementation or comparable tools.
  • Experience with one or more relevant methods, such as multi-objective optimization, model predictive control, mixed-integer optimization, stochastic optimization, energy management, or production scheduling.
  • Good knowledge of integrated energy systems; experience with electrolyzers, hydrogen technologies, renewable-energy integration, storage, or Power-to-X systems would be an advantage.
  • A strong scientific publication record appropriate to your career stage.
  • The ability to conduct independent research, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively with academic and industrial partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

You are not expected to be a specialist in every electrolyzer technology or optimization method. Strong system-level modelling and optimization competence, together with the ability to work across component and system boundaries, is particularly important.

The position will be based in the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). jobs.description:

Location Luxembourg

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level
• An excellent academic track record demonstrating both scholarly excellence and leadership potential
• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply
Online application should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to the Dean, Katalin Ligeti
• CV, including periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks
• Statement of future research, teaching and other activities (max 5 pages)
• Short description of the three most important scholarly achievements (max. 2 pages)
• List of publications, research projects acquired, and PhD theses supervised (if applicable)
• List of teaching activities
• Copy of the PhD diploma
• The names, contact information and present position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by of 29/04/2026.

• Gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies and real-world business challenges.

Amazon's Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. You'll help us optimise our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.
As AMXL EU Sr. Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Execution, you will be responsible for managing significant operational and service growth across our European operations as well as implementing standardised process and quality for our Amazon two-person / special handling delivery service. To succeed in this role, you need to be comfortable making business decisions in a fast-paced and evolving work environment and partnering with various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organisation. This role will include a mix of long-term strategic projects and short-term tactical scope. You will bring strong business judgment, deep curiosity about how things work, strong written and oral communication skills, and a passion for creating effective processes and mechanisms that scale.
The role is responsible for the Production Planning, Labour Planning, and Capacity Execution function for AMXL EU, and is located in our Luxembourg Amazon HQ office, with Barcelona corporate offices also available as an option.
You will collaborate with and present to senior stakeholders to shape network-level strategic decisions. You will bring an analytical background that enables you to support network planning and demonstrate the ability to think broadly and strategically about operational initiatives. You will experience a wide range of problem-solving situations, requiring extensive use of data collection and analysis, in partnership with teams including fulfilment operations leadership, HR, finance, supply chain, transportation, and global system development.

Key job responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Be responsible for Fulfilment Centre, Sort Centre, and Inbound Cross-Dock Labour and Production Planning, Capacity Execution, as well as cost and service optimisation for the EU AMXL network
• Partner with and present to senior leadership, business and finance stakeholders to gather and share data-driven insights
• Support input forecasting using trend analysis and statistical modelling to support decision-making
• Build short, medium, and long-term operational plans to minimise variable costs associated with staffing
• Analyse and solve business problems with a focus on understanding root causes and identifying forward-looking opportunities
• Communicate complex analysis and insights to stakeholders and business leaders, both verbally and in writing
• Participate in global operational and production planning initiatives and project rollouts to support growing business needs
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote process improvement and standardisation across all sites in the network

A day in the life

Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You'll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You'll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to help Amazon achieve new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you'll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.
As a Supply Chain Manager, you'll need to help with both operational tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site's resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you'll be able to learn something new every day.
This role is based at one of our European headquarters in Luxembourg, or at our Barcelona corporate offices.

About the team

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy and bulky items like furniture and large home appliances. Our team manages the entire service, from supply chain fulfilment, to delivery and returns. What sets this service apart from others is the extra level of customer care. Not only do we deliver large items, but we unpack, assemble and install them, and take away old items where needed. With a focus on safety, productivity and innovation, we're changing the way customers buy and receive large goods for the better.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
- Experience working with databases and SQL
- Experience in project or program management
- Experience with operations/supply chain
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, managing end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements
- Knowledge of SQL at an intermediate level, including: compile queries, subqueries, aggregation/grouping, data modification, etc.

jobs.title: Information Security Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Nous recherchons actuellement un(e) Information Security Officer (m/f/n)


Vos missions:

Déployer et faire évoluer la stratégie, les politiques et le cadre de gouvernance cybersécurité de l'entité.  
Identifier, évaluer et suivre les risques cybersécurité et à la protection des données ainsi que les plans de remédiation associés.  
Assurer la conformité aux exigences réglementaires, aux politiques internes et aux obligations liées à la protection des données.  
Piloter la gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information et de la protection des données de DEEP France, en veillant à leur alignement avec les exigences du Groupe et les obligations réglementaires applicables.  
Animer les comités locaux de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données, produire les indicateurs de pilotage et assurer l'alignement avec les instances de gouvernance de DEEP France et de POST Telecom.
Conseiller la Direction et les équipes métiers sur les enjeux de sécurité, de conformité et de gestion des risques.  
Définir et promouvoir les mesures organisationnelles et techniques nécessaires à la protection des systèmes d'information.  
Développer la culture cybersécurité à travers des actions de sensibilisation et de formation.  
Contribuer à la définition et à l'exécution du plan de contrôle annuel de sécurité et de protection des données, en assurer le suivi et le reporting des résultats.
Piloter les audits de sécurité et de conformité, suivre les plans de remédiation et coordonner la mise en œuvre des actions correctrices liées aux non-conformités identifiées.
Contribuer, en binôme avec l'Information Security Officer de POST Telecom et les équipes Compliance, au maintien, à l'amélioration continue et aux audits de certification ISO/IEC 27001 du SMSI.  
Contribuer à la gestion des incidents de sécurité, à la continuité d'activité et à la reprise après sinistre en collaboration avec les équipes spécialisées.  
Assurer une veille réglementaire et technologique et représenter l'organisation auprès des autorités et parties prenantes concernées.  
Favoriser la cohérence des pratiques de sécurité entre DEEP France et POST Telecom et maintenir une proximité avec les équipes via des déplacements réguliers sur les différents sites.


Votre profil:

Diplôme de niveau Master (ou expérience équivalente) en Informatique, Cybersécurité ou Sécurité de l'information.
Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle lié à la cybersécurité, à la gouvernance SSI ou à la gestion des risques.
Bonne maîtrise des technologies de l'information et des principes de sécurité des systèmes d'information.
Connaissance des référentiels et normes de sécurité (ISO 27001, ISO 27005, ISO 22301) ainsi que des réglementations et standards du marché.
Une ou plusieurs certifications en cybersécurité, gestion des risques ou gouvernance SSI constituent un atout.
Esprit d'analyse, de synthèse et d'amélioration continue.
Capacité à proposer des solutions innovantes, pragmatiques et à faire preuve d'initiative.
Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles, d'écoute et de communication.
Français et anglais courants. L'allemand et/ou le luxembourgeois constituent un atout.

jobs.title: Kontorleder søges
jobs.description:
OFFICE MANAGER WANTED FOR OUR OFFICE IN ØSTERBRO

Are you service-minded, organised, and the kind of person who keeps the office running smoothly – even when things get busy?

We are looking for a dedicated Office Manager for a permanent position at our office in Østerbro, Copenhagen.

As our Office Manager, you will be a central part of our day-to-day operations and play an important role in ensuring that the office runs professionally and efficiently.

We operate a staffing agency where the pace can be fast. Phones are ringing, candidates are coming and going, and there are always people, appointments, and tasks that need to be coordinated.

That is why we are looking for someone who thrives on responsibility, enjoys working with people, and appreciates a varied working day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

You will be responsible for the day-to-day running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Daily office administration and coordination
• Welcoming candidates, temporary workers, clients, and other visitors
• Answering phone calls and emails
• Managing calendars and coordinating meetings and interviews
• Preparing meeting rooms and office facilities
• Ordering office supplies, refreshments, and other necessities
• Handling post, parcels, and deliveries
• Liaising with suppliers and business partners
• Providing practical support with the onboarding of new employees and temporary workers
• Updating and maintaining administrative information and documents
• Planning internal events and social activities
• Handling administrative and practical ad hoc tasks

You will also be an important source of support for our consultants and management team, helping to create structure and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

WHO ARE YOU?

Above all, we are looking for someone who takes ownership of the office and wants to make a positive difference in the workplace.

You notice what needs to be done, take initiative, and make sure tasks are followed through from start to finish.

We imagine that you:

• Are organised and have a strong sense of overview
• Are outgoing, positive, and service-minded
• Take responsibility and are comfortable working independently
• Enjoy working with people and communicate professionally
• Are able to manage several tasks at the same time
• Thrive in an environment where the day does not always go according to plan
• Have good IT skills
• Communicate confidently in Danish and preferably also in English
• Contribute positively to the atmosphere and sense of community in the office

Previous experience as an Office Manager, receptionist, administrative coordinator, PA, or office assistant is an advantage. However, your personality, way of working, and willingness to take responsibility are just as important to us.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

You will have a permanent base at our office in Østerbro and become an important part of our internal team.

At the same time, we believe in flexibility and freedom with responsibility. Depending on your tasks and by prior agreement, there will therefore be an opportunity to work from home a few days per week. Tasks that require your physical presence will, of course, be carried out from our office in Østerbro.

With us, you can expect a working day filled with people, responsibility, and plenty of variety. There is a short path from idea to action, and you will have the opportunity to shape both your role and the way we run our office.

We offer:

• A permanent position based at our office in Østerbro
• The opportunity to work from home a few days per week
• Flexibility and freedom with responsibility
• A central role with responsibility and influence
• A varied working day
• Close collaboration with both colleagues and management
• An informal, fast-paced working environment
• Opportunities for professional and personal development

Location: Østerbro, Copenhagen / opportunity to work from home
Position: Full-time
Start date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Salary: Based on qualifications

COULD YOU BE THE PERSON WHO KEEPS OUR OFFICE RUNNING SMOOTHLY?

Send your CV and a short application to info@manora.dk.

Please tell us a little about yourself and why you could see yourself becoming part of our team.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

PLEASE NOTE: APPLICATIONS AND ENQUIRIES WILL ONLY BE ACCEPTED IN WRITING.

jobs.title: DIPLOMIRANI INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA-INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA -PROJEKTANT
jobs.description:
PROJEKTANT HIDROTEHNIČKE STRUKE (m/ž) Želite raditi na projektima koji imaju stvaran utjecaj na razvoj gradova i infrastrukture? PRONING DHI d.o.o. traži diplomiranog inženjera građevinarstva / inženjera građevinarstva – projektanta (m/ž) koji želi svoje znanje razvijati kroz rad na složenim hidrotehničkim projektima u Hrvatskoj i regiji. Ako vas zanimaju hidrotehnika, projektiranje, modeliranje i suvremene tehnologije, a želite raditi u stručnom timu i sudjelovati u projektima od koncepcije do realizacije, voljeli bismo vas upoznati. TKO SMO MI? PRONING DHI je privatno projektno društvo iz Zagreba, osnovano 1994. godine. Više od 30 godina bavimo se projektiranjem i konzaltingom u području:
  • urbane hidrotehnike
  • hidrotehnike riječnih slivova
  • eko-inženjerstva.
Sudjelovali smo u izradi kompleksnih hidrotehničkih projekata u Hrvatskoj i regiji – od master planova kanalizacijskih sustava Zagreba, Ljubljane i Osijeka do projekta odvodnje EKO-Kaštelanskog zaljeva. Posebnu pažnju posvećujemo primjeni suvremenih tehnologija. U radu koristimo i razvijamo 1D i 2D matematičke simulacijske modele, a bavimo se i razvojem sustava za predviđanje poplava u realnom vremenu. ŠTO ĆETE RADITI? Kao član našeg projektnog tima sudjelovat ćete u:
  • izradi i vođenju tehničke dokumentacije u području komunalne hidrotehnike
  • razvoju koncepcijskih rješenja te izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata
  • izradi studija izvodljivosti
  • ishođenju akata za građenje
  • koordinaciji i suradnji s različitim stručnjacima i sudionicima u procesu projektiranja
  • drugim stručnim poslovima iz područja hidrotehničkog projektiranja, ovisno o vašem iskustvu i stručnosti.
Drugim riječima, ne tražimo samo izvršitelja zadataka, već stručnjaka koji želi sudjelovati u razvoju kvalitetnih projektnih rješenja. KOGA TRAŽIMO? Tražimo osobu koja ima:
  • VSS – dipl. ing. građ. / mag. ing. aedif. ili VŠS – ing. građ.
  • iskustvo u izradi hidrotehničkih projekata
  • dobro poznavanje tehničke i zakonske regulative iz područja građevinarstva
  • napredno znanje rada u MS Officeu, AutoCAD-u i Urbanu
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • znanje hrvatskog i engleskog jezika.
Prednost, ali ne i uvjet, predstavljaju:
  • najmanje 5 godina radnog iskustva
  • poznavanje SWMM-a i EPANET-a
  • poznavanje GIS alata poput ArcGIS-a i QGIS-a
  • ovlaštenje za inženjera i upis u imenik ovlaštenih inženjera strukovne komore s položenim stručnim ispitom.
Nemate sve navedene kvalifikacije? Ako ste građevinski tehničar s relevantnim radnim iskustvom, također ste dobrodošli prijaviti se. ZAŠTO PRONING DHI? Kod nas ćete imati priliku: RADITI NA SLOŽENIM PROJEKTIMA Sudjelovat ćete na domaćim i internacionalnim projektima u području hidrotehnike. KORISTITI SUVREMENE TEHNOLOGIJE Radit ćete s modernim alatima i tehnologijama, uključujući matematičko modeliranje hidrotehničkih sustava. RAZVIJATI SVOJE ZNANJE Omogućujemo stručno usavršavanje i razvoj kroz rad na različitim projektima. BITI DIO STRUČNOG TIMA Radit ćete u poticajnom i dinamičnom okruženju, uz suradnju s različitim stručnjacima. IMATI STABILNE UVJETE RADA Rad se uglavnom odvija u našem uredu u Zagrebu, uz povremene terenske obilaske i neradne vikende. Uz osnovna primanja nudimo i dodatke na plaću u skladu s ostvarenim rezultatima, božićnicu, uskrsnicu i potporu za godišnji odmor. MJESTO RADA Zagreb – ured PRONING DHI Povremeni terenski obilasci prema potrebama projekata. Vrsta zaposlenja: rad na određeno vrijeme, uz mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja nakon isteka probnog perioda. ZAINTRIGIRALO VAS JE? Ako želite svoje znanje iz građevinarstva i hidrotehnike usmjeriti prema složenim projektima, suvremenim tehnologijama i stručnom razvoju, pošaljite nam svoj životopis. Prijava treba sadržavati:
  • CV / životopis s kontakt podacima
  • motivacijsko pismo.
Prijave se šalju na: info@proning-dhi.hr PRONING DHI d.o.o. Otona Kučere 5, 10000 Zagreb www.proning-dhi.hr

jobs.title: PROJEKTANT/PROJEKTANTICA
jobs.description:
PROJEKTANT (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih i građevinskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske i građevinske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih radova.

jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
About KPI Solutions

KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients.

Position SummaryÂ 

The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â 

This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration & Commissioning (SI&C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â 

Key ResponsibilitiesÂ 

On-Site DeliveryÂ 

  • Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â 
  • Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI&C team.Â 
  • Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â 
  • Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â 
  • Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â 

Remote / Office DeliveryÂ 

  • Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â 
  • Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â 
  • Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â 
  • DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â 
  • Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â 
  • Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â 
  • Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â 

Project Configuration & DeploymentÂ 

  • Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â 
  • Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â 
  • Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â 
  • Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack & Hold).Â 
  • Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â 
  • Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â 
  • Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â 

Scope & IndependenceÂ 

This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â 

  • Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â 
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â 
  • Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â 
  • Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â 
  • Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â 
  • Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â 
  • Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â 
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â 

Preferred QualificationsÂ 

  • Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â 
  • Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â 
  • Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â

jobs.title: VP Pricing & Packaging
jobs.description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities â including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines â assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

What You Will Own

  • Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling.

  • Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure.

  • Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it.

  • Monetization for new categories: NHI governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, consumption-based licensing.

  • Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product.

  • The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement.

  • Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function.

  • A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench.

  • Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body.

  • Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization).

  • Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance.

Strongly preferred

  • Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management.

  • Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription.

  • Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus.

Why Now

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager Mexico
jobs.description:
All roles at JumpCloudÂ® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloudÂ®

JumpCloudÂ® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

 

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Customer Success Manager based in Mexico to own and manage a portfolio of high-value Enterprise, Commercial and SMB accounts.

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to IT executives (CIOs, CISOs, VPs/Directors of IT), driving deep product adoption, customer retention, and long-term value realization. You will partner closely with Sales, Account Management, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product teams to champion customer needs, mitigate churn risks, and unlock expansion opportunities.

\n

  • Onboarding & Time to Value: Partner with Implementation and Professional Services teams to guide onboarding initiatives, ensuring swift time-to-value and adoption across hybrid IT environments.

  • Adoption & Risk Mitigation: Proactively monitor portfolio health, user engagement, leverage AI and data to address adoption bottlenecks and potential churn risks early.

  • QBRs / Executive Business Reviews (EBRs): Prepare and facilitate strategic, metrics-driven quarterly and executive business reviews with key client leaders to showcase ROI, benchmark health, and align on strategic roadmaps.

  • Growth & Commercial Partnership: Partner closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to develop Customer Success Plans, identify expansion/upsell opportunities, and drive strong Net Retention Rates (NRR)

How Success Will Be Measured :

  • Net Retention Rate (NRR) & Gross Retention Rate (GRR) across your assigned portfolio

  • Customer Health, Platform Adoption, and Product Engagement

  • Onboarding Time-to-Value (TTV) for key accounts

  • Identification and pipeline contribution of qualified Expansion/Upsell opportunities


Weâre Looking For:

  • Experience: 7+ years of customer-facing experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success or Strategic Account Management, managing Enterprise or high-ARR Commercial accounts 

  • Technical Acumen: Strong industry background with SaaS Products with preferred domain knowledge in IT infrastructure, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Directory Services, SSO/MFA, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Zero Trust, and Security/System Administration.

  • Executive Presence: Proven track record of building trust and commanding credibility with key Business and IT stakeholders, C-suite IT leaders, VPs, and technical stakeholders.

  • Analytical & Strategic Mindset: Ability to synthesize complex customer requirements, evaluate account health metrics, and construct actionable success plans.

  • Communication: Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills, with an ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes.

  • Proactive Problem Solving: A self-starter with strong organization, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills in a high-growth, remote-first environment.

  • Education: Bachelorâs degree or equivalent practical experience.


Location & Work Requirements :

  • Must be authorized to work in Mexico without restriction.

  • Proficient in English and Spanish

\n

To be considered for a role at JumpCloudÂ®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Youâll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

 

One of JumpCloudÂ®'s three core values is to âBuild Connections.â To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
