jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN FIRST-PRINCIPLES MODELLING OF MULTIFERROIC MATERIALS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The LIST AI Initiative, supported by the LIST Board of Directors, aims to expand LIST's AI capabilities and maximise the impact of AI innovation both within LIST (AI applied to scientific research in all LIST RDI units and AI applied to improve the performance of LIST corporate support functions) and outside LIST (AI applied to improve products, services and processes of private and public organisations through collaborative projects and/or contract research).
One of the key areas of interest in the LIST AI initiative is that of Frugal AI, understood in a very broad sense: from the analysis of “frugality” of current AI models to the selection/adaptation of models to be deployed in constrained resources (in terms of energy, memory…) depending on the client requirements as part of the design process of a new software system with sustainability concerns.

In this context, LIST is seeking to recruit an AI experienced researcher with a strong specialization and interest in the field of Frugal AI (and similar terms: green AI, low-resource AI, constrained AI, …).

You will join the LIST AI Initiative team as a member of the SWRDI research group and collaborate with peers in a dynamic and evolving research environment within the SWRDI group, the HANDS unit and, in general, with other LIST units requiring expertise in the Frugal AI field.

The SWRDI team specializes in the design and development of smart (i.e. AI-enhanced) software systems. We believe energy concerns should be part of the software design from its early stages and therefore, we believe there is the need to specify resource requirements as part of the requirements engineering phase. These requirements will be then analysed against the energy/memory requirements of AI models to optimize the system behaviour while minimizing the resources consumed by the AI components in it.

We'll expect from you to lead research and innovation (RDI) activities in Frugal AI. As an experienced researcher, you will take the lead in:
• Delivering Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) activities.
• Developing and coaching the LIST RDI teams in this topic; and
• Maximising the impact of Frugal AI initiatives through externally funded projects with public or private organisations.

• Frugal AI / Green AI and, in general, the design and deployment of AI models in low-resource environments.
• Generative AI, including large language models (LLMs), multimodal foundation models, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning and optimisation techniques for LLMs.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You'll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system purpose-built for second-level controls on NAV computation in investment funds. The system must retrieve relevant regulatory methodology, replicate calculation steps, detect discrepancies against fund accounting outputs, and produce control reports that are traceable, auditable, and defensible under regulatory scrutiny.
You will contribute to a system where precision, explainability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

Code Development (60%):
·          Build retrieval pipelines optimised for structured regulatory methodology documents (CSSF circulars, ESMA guidelines, fund prospectuses), with adaptive weighting to surface the specific calculation rules relevant to each control query
·          Implement numerical validation pipelines that compare LLM-derived NAV calculation outputs against fund administrator figures, applying configurable tolerance bands and discrepancy flagging logic
·          Implement chunking strategies optimised for fund accounting reports and regulatory circulars, preserving the structure of calculation tables, formula references, and numbered regulatory provisions.
·          Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports
·          Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published

Research & experimentation (25%):
·          Benchmark embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline, with a focus on sensitivity to numerical and regulatory language in fund accounting contexts
·          Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance
·          Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels
·          Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions.

System integration (15%):
·          Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output
·          Implement comprehensive logging, structured audit trail generation, and monitoring dashboards that allow compliance officers to review and challenge control decisions

Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, User Database Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

You’ll build the systems that let any knowledge worker leverage fast, scalable databases without having to become a DBA.

You’ll be a hands-on technical leader, helping set the architectural direction and roadmap as we take a new product from early alpha to general availability. You’ll work directly with early customers to shape foundational technical and product decisions. Then, together, we’ll work on scaling as adoption and workloads grow.

This is a backend-leaning role with work spanning the stack. You might build the systems that provision and manage a fleet of customer Postgres instances, design how user-defined schemas evolve safely, or make complex queries execute efficiently. You’ll also follow those systems into the product: improving how a table loads, how users understand a slow operation, or how an agent safely works with their data.

You’ll help shape the architecture and the product together. Some problems call for a better abstraction, others for a better default, and others for rethinking what we ask the user to do in the first place. You’ll work with teammates and customers to find those answers, ship practical solutions, and evolve them as usage grows.



Our stack includes Postgres, Go, TypeScript, Node.js, and React.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

The people who understand a business best aren’t always the people who can build its software. A support lead knows how tickets should be triaged. An operations manager knows how inventory should move. But turning that knowledge into a reliable system often means finding an engineer, provisioning a database, and building an application.

We’re building database infrastructure for everyone else. We want everyday knowledge workers to bring their data into Notion, connect it, and build workflows around it. And do so with the power of a real database (Postgres!) and the approachability of a tool they already know.

AI agents make that opportunity even bigger: helping people build and operate systems they couldn’t have created on their own.

For our team, this is much more than putting a friendly interface on Postgres. It means making hard database problems disappear from the user’s workflow without sacrificing correctness, performance, or flexibility. How do you let someone reshape a live database as easily as editing a document? Make the right indexes exist without asking someone to become a DBA? Let a weekend experiment grow into a company’s system of record without anyone having to rearchitect it?




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take a new product from alpha to general availability. Work with early customers to understand what matters, iterate on feedback, and help shape what we ship.

 - Make real customer workloads fast. Improve query execution, indexing, and client data loading so performance holds up as datasets grow and workflows become more demanding.

 - Build systems businesses can trust with their data. Make schema changes, concurrent writes, permissions, and recovery reliable enough for customers to build essential workflows on top.

 - Make powerful capabilities approachable. Turn database provisioning, migrations, and indexes into a reliable, easy-to-use product experience that gives people the power of a database without the burden of managing one.

 - Build for the customers who come next. Automate database provisioning and fleet operations, strengthen observability, and evolve the architecture so we can serve many, many customers.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production relational database experience (e.g., Postgres or MySQL). You’ve made decisions about schemas and indexes, analyzed database performance, and debugged issues involving transactions, locking, or concurrency. Your experience goes beyond accessing a database through an ORM.

 - Engineering experience and technical leadership. You bring 10+ years of experience building and operating production software, with a track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, cross-team initiatives from concept through delivery. You identify the most important problems to solve, turn ambiguous goals into a technical strategy, and align engineers and partner teams around a practical plan. You stay hands-on while helping others make better decisions through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical guidance.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals. You’ve built services that need to remain correct under concurrency and failure. You can reason about retries, partial failures, consistency, and the trade-offs involved in reliable reads and writes.

 - A systematic approach to performance. You use query plans, traces, profiles, and experiments to find bottlenecks and verify improvements. You’re willing to follow a problem across storage, services, and client code rather than stopping at a team boundary.

 - Product judgment. You’re interested in who will use what you build, not just how it works. You can turn a customer’s problem into a technical approach and recognize when a better default or simpler workflow would solve it more effectively.

 - Willingness to work across the stack. You bring backend depth, but you’re comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and working in client code when that’s what delivering a good experience requires.

 - Fluency with AI-assisted engineering. You use AI to accelerate exploration, implementation, and testing while taking responsibility for understanding and validating the result.

jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!

The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 

While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.

This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
  • Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
  • Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
  • Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
  • Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
  • Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
  • Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
  • Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
  • Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
  • Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
  • Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
  • Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
  • Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.description:
Tražimo junior content creatora / video editora Rvstica (sapunerija.com) traži vrijednu i odgovornu osobu koja voli snimati i montirati video sadržaj. Moguće korištenje mjera aktivne politike zapošljavanja. Uvjeti radnog mjesta:
  • Puno radno vrijeme
  • Fleksibilno radno vrijeme
  • Plaća 1100 eura neto, dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije ostvarene putem videa koje osoba snimi i montira.
  • Početak rada 1.10. 2026.
  • Potreban vlastiti prijevoz, zato je dobro imati osobni automobil.
Opis posla:
  • Snimanje kratkih video sadržaja za Reels, TikTok i Stories: proizvodnja sapuna, uživo radionice izrade sapuna, priroda, "behind the scenes", UGC videi s korištenjem proizvoda, priče o proizvodu.
  • Montiranje videa u CapCutu, uz dinamične rezove, titlove i ubacivanje slika.
  • Pisanje scenarija prema zadanim edukacijama, uz praćenje trendova na Instagramu i TikToku i predlaganje ideja za sadržaj.
  • Snimanje se odvija u Tučepima, dok se video montaža radi kod kuće.
Koga tražimo:
  • Osobu s osjećajem za vizualno pripovijedanje i ritam montaže, s iskustvom ili jakim interesom za CapCut i format Reels/TikTok.
  • Kreativnu, samoinicijativnu osobu s okom za detalje, vrijednu i marljivu, spremnu puno učiti i savladati edukacije koje odredimo. Prethodno profesionalno iskustvo nije potrebno.
  • Poželjno je poznavanje osnova marketinga društvenih mreža, fotografije i rada s kamerom, mobitel je dovoljan za početak. Zanimanje za prirodnu kozmetiku, održivost i "slow living" estetiku predstavlja prednost ali nije nužno.
Poslodavac nudi:
  • Rad na autentičnom, vizualno bogatom terenu (proizvodnja sapuna, maslinici, radionice izrade sapuna, konoba), kreativnu slobodu u oblikovanju sadržaja, plaćene edukacije video editinga i marketinga općenito, te dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije videa.
  • Osobi koja pokaže rezultate i želju za razvojem nudimo mogućnost napredovanja unutar brenda, povećanje plaće uz kontinuirano mentorstvo i vođenje kroz edukacije.

jobs.title: Julgestustöötaja/ tegevusjuhendaja
jobs.description:
Töö asukoht Valga maakonnas Valga vallas (tööandja pakub majutust, hüvitab transpordikulud).

Tööülesanded: Julgestustöötaja/ tegevusjuhendaja on vahetu töötaja, kelle tegevuse eesmärk on luua turvaline, struktureeritud ja toetav keskkond, mis arvestab kliendi individuaalsete eripäradega.
Tööülesannete täitmine eeldab head füüsilist vormi ja aktiivset kaasamõtlemist teenuse arendamisel ning loomulikult kliente toetavat hoiakut.

Omalt poolt pakume: Motiveerivat töötasu; meeldivat meeskonda; vahetustega töögraafikut (paindlik tööaeg); vajadusel tasuta ööbimisvõimalust asutuses (tuba jagatakse); sõidukompensatsiooni igal kuul; tööalaseid koolitusi; kohapealset väljaõpet; tasuta toitlustust.

Muud nõuded: Otsime inimesi, kes on loomult rahulikud, kannatlikud ja järjepidevad, samas aktiivse hoiakuga ning uuendusmeelsed.
Tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe ei ole otseselt tööle saamisel nõutav, küll aga eeldame valmidust õppima asumiseks ning kvalifikatsiooni omandamiseks. Ka tööandja pakub koolitamisvõimalusi. Oluline on vähemalt keskhariduse olemasolu ja kasuks tuleb eelnev töökogemus sotsiaalvaldkonnas, loomulikult ka varasemalt läbitud vastav väljaõpe. NB! Isik ei tohi töötada tegevusjuhendajana, kui teda on karistatud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest, mis on suunatud isiku vastu (nt vägivald) või mis seab ohtu teiste inimeste elu ja tervise. Tööle asumisel kontrollitakse alati karistusregistri väljavõtet.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Betoonitööde brigadir
jobs.description:
Otsime laialdase kogemusega brigadiri, kes meeskonna tööd juhiks platsil.

Tööülesanded: Tööde planeerimine ja juhtimine: Brigaadi igapäevatöö organiseerimine, ülesannete jagamine ja jooksvate probleemide lahendamine.
Kvaliteedi ja tehnoloogia kontroll: Raketiste paigalduse, armeerimise, betoneerimise ja betooni järelhoolduse vastavuse kontrollimine ehitusprojektile ning normidele. Tööohutuse tagamine: Ohutusnõuete täitmise jälgimine ehitusplatsil ja tellingutel. Materjalide ja tööriistade haldus: Vajalike materjalide (betoon, sarrused, raketised) ja seadmete õigeaegse olemasolu ning säästliku kasutamise tagamine. Aruandlus: Tehtud tööde mahu ja töötundide arvestuse pidamine ning info edastamine objektijuhile.

Omalt poolt pakume: Konkurentsivõimelist palka, mis vastab Sinu oskustele ja kogemustele
Alati õigeaegselt laekuvat töötasu ja ametlikku vormistamist. Stabiilset ja aastaringset tööd (meil on objektid olemas ka talveperioodil). Ametiautot või isikliku auto kompensatsiooni objektide vahel liikumiseks.Vajadusel tasuta majutust ja transporti ettevõtte poolt, kui objektid asuvad kodukohast kaugel. Võimalust rääkida kaasa tööprotsesside parendamisel ja meeskonna komplekteerimisel.

Muud nõuded: Vajalikud oskused ja omadused:
Erialane pädevus: Pikaajaline praktiline kogemus betoonitöödel (raketised, armatuur, valu, viimistlus) ja jooniste lugemise oskus. Juhtimisoskus: Võime meeskonda motiveerida, delegeerida ja konflikte lahendada. Pingetaluvus: Ehitusplatsil muutuvad olud kiiresti (ilmastik, tarneajad), mis nõuab kiiret reageerimist. Keeleoskus: lisaks eesti keelele ka vene keele oskus, et suhelda eri rahvusest töölistega.

jobs.title: Design Engineer (Web & Brand)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a Design Engineer with strong visual taste to help drive our creative initiatives across web and brand. When it comes to design and code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story—what we're building and why it matters—as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

What you'll do

 - You will be responsible for building complex and interactive UI web/app experiences

 - Build beautiful, responsive websites, landing pages, and internal tools

 - Implement creative animations and interactions in code

 - Explore visual design in Figma and translate it to web-native experiences

What we're looking for

 - Eye for good design

 - Strong frontend engineering skills

 - Experience building end-to-end websites and landing pages

 - Experience with React and TypeScript

 - Experience using agentic coding tools as part of the design process (from exploring ideas to building production-quality interactions)

 - A portfolio or Twitter profile showcasing a range of technical skills, a creative use of code, and prototyping skills

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

 - Paid lunch and coffee during work days

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks paid vacation

 - 4 months paid parental leave

Learn how we think and work

 - Part I https://linear.app/blog/a-design-reset and Part II https://linear.app/blog/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui of how we redesigned the Linear UI

 - Read me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we use AI in design https://designerfund.substack.com/p/ai-design-linear feature of Linear's design team

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear https://accel.com/noteworthy/our-investment-in-linear Accel Series B blog post

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.

This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.

You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.

As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.

 - Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.

 - Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.

 - Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.

 - Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.

 - Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.

 - Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.

 - Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.

 - Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.

 - Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.

 - Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.

 - Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.

 - Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.

 - Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.

 - Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.

 - Strong hands-on Python development experience.

 - Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

 - Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.

 - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.

 - Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.

 - Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.

 - Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.

 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.

 - Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.

 - Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.

 - Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.

 - Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.

 - Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.

 - Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.

 - Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.

 - Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.

 - Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

In your first 90 days, you will:

 - Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.

 - Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.

 - Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.

 - Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.

Within your first six months, you will:

 - Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.

 - Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.

 - Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.

 - Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.

 - Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.




LOCATION:

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.title: Team Leader Nurse Team
jobs.description:
Lead a Team of Registered Nurses Providing Medical Assistance Worldwide

Are you an inspiring leader who wants to make a difference every day?

At Viking Travel Care, we help travellers who become ill or injured while abroad. From our offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain, we provide travel and medical assistance services 24/7, 365 days a year to customers and travellers worldwide.

We are now looking for a Team Leader for our Medical Assistance Coordinator (Nurse) team.

Our Nurses are experienced Registered Nurses from the Nordic countries. They assess medical reports, coordinate treatment, communicate with healthcare providers around the world, handle own medical cases, and support travellers during some of life's most challenging moments. They also serve as an important medical resource for colleagues across the Travel Care operation.

As Team Leader, you will have day-to-day personnel responsibility for a team of highly skilled nurses, supporting their development and helping ensure that the Medical Assistance team works in a structured, professional, and reliable way.

You will work closely with Viking Travel Care's Medical Management and Operations Management teams, as well as fellow Team Leaders, to support the continued development of our medical assistance services. In this role, you will act as an important link between the Medical Assistance team and management, helping translate strategic priorities into daily operations, quality improvements, and employee development.

This is a unique opportunity to combine healthcare expertise with people leadership in an international and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

    Personnel responsibility for a team of Medical Assistance Coordinators (nurses)
    

    Conduct performance reviews, development conversations, and regular follow-up meetings
    

    Drive employee engagement, professional development, and competence building within the team
    

    Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members
    

    Ensure delivery of agreed service levels, KPIs, and quality standards
    

    Monitor workloads, staffing, and operational priorities
    

    Support daily operations and assist with complex cases when needed
    

    Handle administrative responsibilities such as scheduling, absence follow-up, and workforce planning
    

    Promote high clinical and documentation standards
    

    Ensure compliance with SOPs, routines, and quality requirements
    

    Support the implementation of new processes, routines, and quality initiatives within the Medical Assistance team
    

    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects across Travel Care

Qualifications Required

    Experience from healthcare, medical assistance, travel assistance, insurance, customer service, operations, or another relevant field.
    

    Fluent in one of the Nordic languages and English
    

    Strong communication and interpersonal skills
    

    Comfortable working in a dynamic and international environment
    

    Strong IT skills and ability to quickly learn new systems
    

    Clean criminal record

Preferred

    Relevant experience in people leadership, team coordination, employee development, or similar responsibilities.
    

    Registered Nurse holding a valid nursing licence recognised within the EU, with a minimum of three years of clinical nursing experience
    

    Experience from travel assistance, insurance medicine, emergency care, intensive care, ambulance services, acute care, or similar fields

What can we offer the right candidate?

    Competitive salary and employment conditions
    

    Permanent employment contract under Spanish labour law
    

    Employer-provided laptop and mobile phone
    

    Comprehensive onboarding and training programme
    

    A supportive and collaborative work environment with highly skilled colleagues
    

    Social activities and team events
    

    Modern offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola
    

    The opportunity to work in an international organisation helping travellers worldwide

Are you the one we're looking for?

The right person for this position is a positive and approachable leader who enjoys helping others succeed. You thrive in a dynamic environment, balancing operational priorities with employee development. You are organised, solution-oriented, and focused on creating clear and reliable ways of working for your team. You enjoy working closely with others while also taking ownership and acting independently when needed.

Most importantly, you believe that great customer care starts with strong teamwork, professional judgement, and clear, friendly communication.

About Viking

Viking Assistance Group is a leading roadside and travel assistance company in the Nordics. Viking Travel Care is the group’s travel and medical assistance division, providing assistance services 24 hours a day, 365 days a year to travellers and employees abroad. Across our services, we aim to make assistance easy to access, reliable in delivery, and friendly in every interaction.

Workplace

The position will be based at Viking Travel Care in Torrevieja or Fuengirola, Spain.

Working Hours

The role follows the Team Leader rotation and includes day, evening, and occasional weekend shifts, with flexibility needed to support a 24/7 operation when required.

Start Date

As soon as possible.

Deadline

Please apply before September 30th

jobs.title: Junior Payroll Assistant
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Mission of the role

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
  • Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
  • Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows.

Must-have attributes

Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: HR Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Title: HR Operations SpecialistÂ 

Type: Independent ContractorÂ 

Location: Remote | South Africa

About Us

The Law Offices of Sabrina Li, P.C. is a leading, full-service U.S. immigration law firm with offices in Los Angeles, Pasadena, Santa Ana, and Dallas, as well as international operations across Asia, Africa, and Central and South America. We are dedicated to helping individuals, families, and businesses navigate complex legal challenges with skill, compassion, and integrity.

We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 Inc. Best Workplaces honoree, a distinction that reflects our intentional investment in our people and workplace culture. Our firm prioritizes professional development, clear career pathways, and a culture of accountability and respectâcreating a workplace where high performers can build meaningful, long-term careers.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a tech-savvy, proactive HR professional with excellent communication skills to support our HR team across recruitment, onboarding, compliance, and training. You'll work alongside firm leadership to keep day-to-day HR operations running smoothly and help identify smarter, more efficient ways to manage HR processes using AI and automation.

If you enjoy variety in your work, thrive on process and organization, adapt quickly to new tools, and want to grow with a firm that invests in its people, this role is a great fit.

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations & Compliance

  • Support the employee onboarding process, helping new hires get set up and proficient with the firm's technology stack within their first week.
  • Assist with HR document, process, and compliance audits, and monitor completion of required documentation, certifications, training, and policy acknowledgements.
  • Follow up with employees and managers on outstanding compliance items.
  • Maintain accurate HR records within Rippling and other HR systems.

Recruitment & Talent Support

  • Support sourcing for open roles, including candidate outreach and headhunting for hard-to-fill positions when standard applicant pipelines fall short.
  • Help manage candidate pipelines and keep hiring managers updated on status.
  • Assist with background and reference checks and credential verification.
  • Participate in candidate interviews alongside hiring managers.

Training & Development

  • Help maintain and update the firm's training curriculum, onboarding materials, and learning resources.
  • Assist in creating SOPs, workflow documentation, process maps, and training materials as needed.
  • Support the development of assessments and knowledge checks to track training completion.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to streamline HR workflows through automation and AI-powered tools.
  • Help maintain workflows within monday.com and other operational platforms.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field (required).
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools, systems, and platforms (required).
  • Excellent written and spoken English with strong, proactive communication skills â comfortable flagging issues, asking questions, and following up without being prompted (required).
  • Proactive and self-directed, able to anticipate needs and take initiative in a fast-paced, fully remote environment (required).
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in HR operations for a U.S.-based company, including onboarding, compliance, or employee lifecycle support (required).
  • Experience using monday.com and HRIS platforms such as Rippling (required).
  • Experience creating clear documentation, SOPs, or process materials.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to support content creation, documentation, and process efficiency.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Preferred: recruitment or sourcing experience, including candidate outreach, vetting, and interviewing.
  • Preferred: experience with Canva or similar tools for training or communication materials.

Why Join Our Team?

  • Stable, remote opportunity to work with a well-established U.S.-based law firm that values continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based bonuses.
  • Fully remote role within a diverse global team.
  • Paid time off, including U.S. federal holidays, sick leave, and annual leave.
  • Pacific Time-aligned working hours with reasonable flexibility.
  • Opportunity to grow with the firm's HR function as it scales.
  • Structured onboarding and clear expectations from day one.
  • Stable, long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. law firm.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment built on accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Thoughtful company culture, including birthday recognitions and team appreciation initiatives.

Working Hours

  • Full-time role, 8 hours per day (excluding a 1-hour break).Â 
  • Schedule details may be discussed during the final stages of the hiring process.Â 
  • Scheduling is flexible; however, team members are required to maintain a minimum of 5â6 hours of overlap with the firm's operating hours in Pacific Time (PT), subject to operational needs and team coordination.

Application Process

Candidates may be asked to complete the following during the recruitment process:

  • Most recent Resume/CV (required).
  • Communication and presentation assessment, including a practical assignment relevant to HR operations, recruitment, or training material creation.
  • Proof of qualifications and professional references. To ensure fairness and accuracy, compensation verification may be conducted for shortlisted candidates.

Additional Information

  • This is a fully remote, South Africa-based role.
  • Engagement is as an independent contractor; tax compliance is the contractor's responsibility.
  • A 3-month probationary period will apply to support onboarding and performance alignment.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, contacting our offices by phone, email, or social media regarding this position is strictly prohibited. Any inquiries about application status through these channels will result in automatic disqualification from the hiring process. Our hiring team carefully reviews every submission and will contact qualified candidates directly.

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.
